name: Stellar Jade
backgroundDescription: A fleeting gleam arrowing across the night sky. Catch it before it's gone. Maybe it can be used to barter?\n\n"Some say that the lights are wishes of sentient beings. While insignificant and elusive, they did light up the pocket of sky around them, right?"

name: Credit
description: This currency, used by the Interastral Peace Corporation to settle accounts with its customers, is now widely accepted as the hard currency for space travel.
backgroundDescription: "People run around fighting and trading for numbers in a terminal, but the truly precious cannot be bought."

name: Oneiric Shard
backgroundDescription: Crystallized lights floating in the sea of stars, pulsing with the residual dream of an ancient Leviathan. Everything of the old world turned in the end into candlelight that illuminates the darkness ahead.

name: Star Rail Pass
backgroundDescription: Astral Express Universal Pass. Travel as far as the Star Rail stretches.\n\n"Map worlds, meet people, make memories."

name: Star Rail Special Pass
backgroundDescription: Direct ticket for the Astral Express with coordinates of specific worlds, suitable for passengers who just want to go from point A to point B.\n\n"Need to catch up with an old friend? Hop on and see the universe with him/her/it/THEM!"

name: Fuel
description: Item used to replenish Trailblaze Power. Provides <unbreak>60</unbreak> Trailblaze Power.
backgroundDescription: Fuel canisters filled up with the dreams and courage of the Nameless.\n\n"Idealism? I prefer to call it the observer effect and human self-actualization."

name: Travel Encounters
description: Experience material for characters. Provides <unbreak>1000</unbreak> Character EXP.
backgroundDescription: A travel diary with messy handwriting and random content. It's not of much use to you.\n\n"Dan Heng, hurry up and finish reading it so you can throw it away."

name: Adventure Log
description: Experience material for characters. Provides <unbreak>5000</unbreak> Character EXP.
backgroundDescription: A neatly organized collection of educational adventure notes containing countless illustrations and texts entailing adventures from beginning to end, as well as valuable information and survival-related techniques. "Why not just digitize it and save it on a photolith disk? That'd be much more convenient." "Advanced technology is far more fragile than you'd think when faced with stellar storms and neuron flow eruptions. Besides, I'm sure the author of this book wanted people to read it in the simplest of ways."

name: Traveler's Guide
description: Experience material for characters. Provides <unbreak>20,000</unbreak> Character EXP.
backgroundDescription: Required reading for world exploration. Press the "Read" button to tune in to an attractive voice in a language you understand, telling you about the legendary encounters of renowned adventurers across different worlds as well as the precious wisdom and knowledge that they have gathered. "All-new series of the Traveler's Guide, The Chef's Manual to Galactic Cuisine, is now available for purchase." "For submissions, please connect to synesthesia beacon ERD-23θ to contact an Intelligentsia Guild representative. Method of payment can be arranged to your convenience."

name: Sparse Aether
description: Enhancement material for Light Cones, provides <unbreak>500</unbreak> Light Cone EXP.
backgroundDescription: An imaginary substance that shouldn't exist in reality. The basic material to create Light Cones. The images contained in the Light Cones become clearer when infused with this substance. "I see, so this is the supposed 'memoria' of the Garden of Recollection. No wonder the Memokeepers can set off on galactic voyages with memories."

name: Condensed Aether
description: Enhancement material for Light Cones, provides <unbreak>2000</unbreak> Light Cone EXP.
backgroundDescription: A can of Aether refined through special techniques.\n\n"Handle with care, do not drop or place pressure upon it. If damages and leaks occur, please refer to chapter II of the Leak Disaster Response Manual for emergency response."

name: Refined Aether
description: Enhancement material for Light Cones, provides <unbreak>6000</unbreak> Light Cone EXP.
backgroundDescription: A canister of aether that has been extracted and distilled using special procedures.\n\n"The Garden looks forward to recreating a past glory, but it is a 'past glory' selected by them. Do you understand?"

name: Lost Lightdust
description: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides <unbreak>100</unbreak> Relic EXP.
backgroundDescription: Lightdust permeated the Fragmentum, carrying what seems to indicate the existence of another civilization.\n\n"Theosophy holds that the database used to store information of the material world is called the Akasha Records. I don't necessarily support this, but... these dust indeed store information from the past. They are like... seeds? When you water them, they can yield bountiful fruit."

name: Lost Gold Fragment
description: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides <unbreak>500</unbreak> Relic EXP.
backgroundDescription: Carefully collected Fragmentum dust with irregular shapes. Under the right conditions, they can express specific forms of relics.\n\nWhen the stars return to the right position... Ha! Just kidding.

name: Lost Crystal
description: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides <unbreak>1000</unbreak> Relic EXP.
backgroundDescription: A Fragmentum dust crystal that had densified after being reduced to its original form.\n\n"This must not be placed together with the ores offered to the Amber Lord. This is a creation of the Stellaron and goes against the will of Preservation."

name: Lost Essence
description: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides <unbreak>2000</unbreak> Relic EXP.
backgroundDescription: A large Fragmentum dust crystal that had densified after being reduced to its original form.\n\n"It can even recreate our deceased mother if it has enough information! It really can! Even if it was only for 26 seconds... I just have one question after I completed the experiment: Just why was the Fragmentum created?"

name: Relic Remains
description: Material salvaged from Relics.
backgroundDescription: Broken parts of a relic that are one step away from decomposing into the Lightdust floating in the Fragmentum.\n\n"Don't take them for mere scraps. I can restore them to their original state."

name: Self-Modeling Resin
description: A rare material used for customizing Relics. When synthesizing, you can designate 1 Main Stat from the possible options. With additional consumption, you can further designate 1 to 2 Subsidiary Stats.
backgroundDescription: This unknown resin is as smooth to the touch as finely-grained dust. It seems to be from the Fragmentum, and has been shaped into the form of a wish by an invisible hand.\n\n"Based on the Guild's research, the Self-Modeling Resin may be the basis of the Fragmentum's capacity to replicate entities..."

name: Wishful Resin
description: Matchless materials used to customize Relics. Can be used to specify up to 2 Subsidiary Stats when synthesizing.
backgroundDescription: An unknown resin that shines like crystals. It seems to have originated from within the Fragmentum. When you draw near, it will resonate strongly with the wishes within your heart.\n\n"It tried to use the Fragmentum's duplicative ability to satisfy human desires, but alas, the gulf is insatiable."

name: Variable Dice
description: Use to re-assign the upgrade counts for Subsidiary Stats of fully-enhanced 5-star Relics and randomize their values.
backgroundDescription: A die formed from probability spins alone in the void. The bundled uncertainty ignites and goes out like the birth and death of stars. The universe is filled with variables. If even stars have a chance at resurrection, then what say a Relic?\n\n"Attention: Hazardous variable. Be mindful when you roll the die. If you are not careful, a treasure could turn to trash."

name: Interference Key
description: When using Variable Dice to reassign Subsidiary Stats of a 5-star Relic, you can select one Subsidiary Stat to block, preventing it from being enhanced during this reroll.
backgroundDescription: The integrated circuits within the encryption key are operating at full capacity, emitting interference factors that intercept countless light rays and correct their trajectories. In the information light screen occupying the entire sky dome, a small dark zone appears: a place even destiny must avoid.\n\n"A discordant note emerges in the rapids of probability, refusing to go with the flow, driving itself like a nail into the marrow of destiny."

name: Tracks of Destiny
description: Advanced level-up material for Traces.
backgroundDescription: Your victory is secured by countless failures, and the small steps you have taken led you to the turning point of fate.

name: Lucent Afterglow
description: Used to exchange for rewards at the Light Cone Manifest shop.
backgroundDescription: An afterimage of bygone days, invaluable to the Garden of Recollection.\n\nThe Garden of Recollection has its own rules: Exchange time for time and memory for memory. The Garden of Recollection can even bring back to you a lost, irrevocable past for the right cost...

name: Herta Bond
description: A reward from the Simulated Universe. Can be used to buy items from Herta's Store.

name: First Voyage's Blessing
description: Use to gain <unbreak>60</unbreak> Trailblaze Power and a 1:1 replica.
backgroundDescription:
A blessing offered to those starting their journey.

May you embrace the skies and give the greetings of your first voyage to the endless starry seas.
May you cross the snowstorm and ignite an eternal flame at the end of the frigid winter.
The footsteps you leave behind will one day become a road upon which stars would shine.

name: First Voyage's Blessing
backgroundDescription:
A blessing offered to those starting their journey.

May you embrace the skies and give the greetings of your first voyage to the endless starry seas.
May you cross the snowstorm and ignite an eternal flame at the end of the frigid winter.
The footsteps you leave behind will one day become a road upon which stars will shine.

name: Wayfare's Blessing
backgroundDescription:
A blessing offered to wayfarers on the journey.

May you navigate through the delves and behold how fathomless wakespans paint the scintillating beauty of life.
May you explore the Sea of Dreams and play a rousing melody for the enchanting land of fantasia.
Your traces there will condense into the memories that overflow the very river of stars.

name: Golden Blessing
backgroundDescription:
A blessing bestowed upon those who embark on the Flame-Chase Journey.

May you dance with the gods, reigniting the fallen giant with the fire of heroes.
May you overthrow fate, illuminating the world and all living beings with the light of dawn.
Your journey here will forever be etched into the ancient ballads of legend.

name: Phantasia's Blessing
backgroundDescription:
A Blessing for the Protagonist

May you strike down injustice, unafraid to shatter false Masks with your true self.
May you carry the hopes of all, raise the sail of trailblazing under a thousand stars.
Your Traces in this realm shall echo across the cosmos as the joy of the arcadia.

name: As Tomorrow Became Yesterday
description: Letter in Memory
backgroundDescription: {NICKNAME}: Hey, I miss you. Maybe this feels a bit out of the blue, but I just wanna take a look back one last time. The journey of Trailblaze must be filled with unknowns. So, I thought... why not leave you one more surprise? A ripple of memories, along with a touch of fairy magic. Before we knew it, we've shared such a long walk together. I wonder what story you'll write at the next stop on your journey. I will be in your memories, longing... Whenever I close my eyes, I can see yours, carrying the whole universe... Like waves of wheat rustling in the breeze, or the tomorrow where stars shine ♪ Cyrene

name: Tears of Dreams
description: Sealed thoughts and feelings. Can substitute Path Materials when they are insufficient. The substitution ratio of Tears of Dreams varies depending on the materials' rarity.
backgroundDescription: The unresolved resentment, the unsolved puzzle, the places never reached, the achievements never attained... All the regrets that make the human soul bend its knees are sealed into these tears condensed by time. \n\n"Believe me, everything is possible in dreams..."

name: Shattered Blade
description: Weapon fragments left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: This brand represents their rank and accomplishments in the name of Destruction. The master of this weapon rides on a scarlet horse to ignite cities, to take peace from humankind, and to bring down nations akin to anthills. "The bearer of this brand is tasked with driving peace out of nations."

name: Lifeless Blade
description: Weapon remnants left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: This brand represents their rank and accomplishments in the name of Destruction. The master of this weapon carries a strong hatred for all sentient beings. They relish in the lament of intelligent beings as sweet melodies and topple civilizations with millennia of history in the blink of an eye. "The bearer of this brand is tasked with stopping breath among the living."

name: Worldbreaker Blade
description: Broken weapon left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: This weapon represents its owner's rank and accomplishments in the name of Destruction. The owner of this weapon makes their appearance at the end of a war to fan the embers to consume the world. Regardless of the glories of the past or the blessing of its deities, this planet is destined to return to the ashes it came from, and to wither away in the depths of the starry sky. "The bearer of this brand is tasked with purifying the world."

name: Arrow of the Beast Hunter
description: An arrowhead forged with Frost Steel by the craftsmen of Xianzhou. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: A gift that parents give to their children who've successfully hunted their first prey at their coming of age ceremony. It is a blessing that their life would be as successful and true as an arrow heading towards its mark.\n\n"May the arrow on your waist and the sword in your sheath stay true and always find its target."

name: Arrow of the Demon Slayer
description: An arrowhead forged with Stellaris Essence by the craftsmen of Xianzhou. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: An arrow narrower than a finger's width. It can be loaded into an electromagnetic crossbow or a thermal seeking bow as ammunition. Its power is enough to penetrate the tough shells of abominations with just one strike.\n\n"The celestial banished arrives from afar, great distances journeyed 'twixt oceans of stars. Like rain falls a cloudburst of arrows below, in a helmet reflected the bright lunar glow."

name: Arrow of the Starchaser
description: A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Hunt</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The remains of a divine construct that ordinary humans can rarely behold. What kind of force can shatter stars that are light-years away? Humanity can only imagine the power of the Lux Arrow from the ashes it left behind. Only the Furnace Master, chief of the Xianzhou artisans, has the rights to reforge the shards for those who are worthy. "The death of a star shall shine bright for ages to come."

name: Key of Inspiration
description: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the Meditative Scholars. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: It can unlock inspirations hidden deep within the conscience. To take hold of the key is to grasp at the darting embers of thought that lead to the forward path. "Eureka!"

name: Key of Knowledge
description: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the sages of the worlds. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: It can unlock the mysteries binding the truth of the world and grants knowledge beyond the understanding of humans. No matter how the wielder attempts to display their possession of the key, no one but themselves can see its form. Some people believe that to be a gift from the heavens, while others think it's a sign of mental disorder. "I had a dream of molecules coiling up into a loop like a snake biting its own tail. I woke up realizing that this is the answer I've been looking for all along!"

name: Key of Wisdom
description: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the greatest prodigies of the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: This is the proof of invitation to the halls of the Nous Temple. Finding the door of which this key opens is a far more arduous task than obtaining the key itself. Those who pass through the doors will immediately realize the impossibility of returning to this side. "The Erudition does not have answers to the universe, but it will teach you how to ask the right questions."

name: Endurance of Bronze
description: A crude but durable ancient hand-held bronze shield. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Preservation</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Ancient legends entail a war where humans exhausted all primitive methods, following the gods into battle against overwhelmingly powerful beasts. This shield is a witness to that war. "There's no choice but to stop it, even if the efforts are futile."

name: Oath of Steel
description: A shield forged with irreplaceable craftsmanship from an unknown alloy. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Preservation</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: It may be a large shield, but it feels as light as a feather. Even after taking on a full charge, no marks can be seen on the face of the shield. Ancient legends tell of a war where high-spirited warriors wielded deathray-beaming spears and shields forged of Frost Steel, defended a nation destined to falter in the face of war. This shield is a witness to that war. "Powerful voices chant: 'The enemies are at our gates!'"

name: Safeguard of Amber
description: An unusual shield embedded with ambers mined from beyond the skies. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Preservation</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The wielder of this shield is seemingly protected by an invisible shield wall, immune to fiery arrows or mountainous claws. Ancient legends entail a war where a tribal hero wielding a bronze shield charged to their death against a Leviathan, together with warriors armed with fiery spears. This shield is a witness to that war. "Do not cross the line."

name: Obsidian of Dread
description: A fragment of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Nothing can prove its noumenon. Touch gently to hear an unclear murmur from the shard. "████ ██ █ █"

name: Obsidian of Desolation
description: A chunk of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: No reflections can be seen on the surface of the black prism. Not only does it suck in all the light, it seems to also absorb the wielder's emotions, leaving only a faint feeling of emptiness.\n\n"..."

name: Obsidian of Obsession
description: A sizable piece of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The weak-minded and soft-willed will spend their eternity in chaos from just a simple glance into the prism.\n\n" "

name: Harmonic Tune
description: A compact music box made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Harmony</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: It plays a relaxing and joyful tune. Even through the simplistic tune, anyone with the slightest understanding of music can tell the mastery of the composer of the piece. "Grab the hands of your Family and let us dance!"

name: Ancestral Hymn
description: A music box made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Harmony</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: It plays a hymn sung by a small band. It is impossible to find out to whom the lyric of the hymn sends its praise. "Penury, trial of the Great One! Wealth, grace of the Great One!"

name: Stellaris Symphony
description: A music box with complex structures made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Harmony</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: It plays a powerful cosmic symphony.\n\n"Some astronomers believe that the revolutions of the heavenly spheres work the same as complex mechanical structures. The crystal clear and pleasant notes emitted during the movements of the stars are known as the 'Harmony of the Heavenly Spheres.'"

name: Seed of Abundance
description: A seed of blessing sown by the Aeon of Abundance. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Those who come in contact with it are slowly healed of their wounds and illnesses. People who pray for the blessing of life while in despair will always have their prayers answered. "You shall be granted what you ask for."

name: Sprout of Life
description: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Radiating warmth, life and growth flourish around the place where it sinks its roots. Barren wastelands turn into luscious grass fields, withered plants rejuvenate and blossom, and springs burst through the ground to moisten the land. As you get closer to it, your muscles and bones twitch and propagate with an unbearable itch. "Life is unfailing where the soul abounds."

name: Flower of Eternity
description: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form. Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality. "There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."

name: Borisin Teeth
description: Broken teeth fragments left behind during the borisin conquests. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Borisin consider their teeth as a warrior's blade and weapon. The borisin worship warriors possessing supreme power. In their tribes, where the strong rule the weak, those with dental caries will only be discarded by the group. "O, Brood Lord, grant us sharp teeth and claws."

name: Lupitoxin Sawteeth
description: Blood-sucking sharp fangs left behind during the borisin conquests. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Borisin consider their teeth as a warrior's blade and weapon. A maddening impulse flows through the borisin blood. Fueled by Lupitoxin, they rend their enemies with their sawteeth and suck their blood, and are undefeated. "O, Brood Lord, grant us steel skin and bones."

name: Moon Rage Fang
description: Terrifying tusks left behind during the borisin conquests. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Borisin can further enhance their bodies through their innate "Moon Rage." The battle-frenzied warriors exhibit incredible healing abilities, shedding the blood of their enemies in a sanguine mist together with the unbridled growth of their muscles and bones. "O, Brood Lord, grant us divine strength."

name: Meteoric Bullet
description: Iron pellets forged for hunting monsters. Each one bears scratches that seem to record the number of prey that perished because of it. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>The Hunt</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The Armed Archaeologists discovered these iron pellets among various types of monster fossils and bones. Radioactive dating confirmed that they were fired in an era when humanity did not yet exist, and the creatures they shot were the last remnants of a certain monster species.\n\n"Death by old age is no different from death by bullet. The way of the hunter won't lead to a sacred nor sinful end."

name: Destined Expiration
description: Embedded in the deceased's brow, piercing through the crevice of matter, this bullet forever resides where its bullet hole should be. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>The Hunt</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: It traversed the winding paths amidst legions of soldiers, pierced through the weakest point of the stoutest helmets, and finally came to rest at the center of the skull of the invincible tyrant, emitting a whisper-like sigh. Its arrival came like a fatal coincidence. Its arrival was akin to an endpoint that all were fated to meet.\n\n"Sometimes, the bullet hole precedes the trajectory."

name: Countertemporal Shot
description: A spiral bullet forever going against the arrow of time, like a hound eternally chasing the immortal that defies time. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>The Hunt</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Once the embers of a Lord Ravager, the button to erase a civilization, and the final lament of an ancient behemoth... How many deaths must these materials have gathered to forge such ammunition? And what kind of firearm can propel it into the past? It is the answer to all. It is not a question itself.\n\n"Run. Flee to any moment's interstice. It will always find you, nailing you down in the fabric of fate."

name: Rough Sketch
description: The character design draft for Clockie, where a few pen strokes already gave the dream a shape. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Various original sketches of Clockie are widely circulated on Penacony. Exactly who captured the fleeting spark of inspiration and rang the first sound of "tick-tock" on the canvas?\n\n"Tick-tock! You... can see me?"

name: Dynamic Outlining
description: A Clockie outline drawing, where the silhouette of the dream was already leaping out of the page. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The Clockie drawing looks more refined after the unnecessary strokes are removed. The animators hid their wisdom in every frame of Clockie's dance and can be clearly discerned.\n\n"Tick-tock, tick-tock! Keep up, my friend!"

name: Exquisite Colored Draft
description: A colored draft of Clockie that brings the dream to life with vibrant colors. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Clockie becomes filled with colors, taking on the shape that will become a household name. Clockie's story inspired millions of Dreamchasers, with every one of them able to be inspired by his fantastical adventures.\n\n"My name is Clockie, and I'm a superstar in Dreamville Penacony!"

name: Scattered Stardust
description: The dust that falls from the Amber Lord's body when THEY swing the divine hammer. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Preservation</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The guards at Pier Point have never left their posts on Qlipoth's orbit, simply waiting for a miracle that only occurs once in decades or even centuries — How stardust splutters up like countless raindrops the moment the giant hammer falls.\n\n"The stardust are simply insignificant dust to the Amber Lord, but to us, every speck of it contains the essence of Preservation."

name: Crystal Meteorites
description: The crystals that separate from the Amber Lord's body when THEY swing the celestial hammer. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Preservation</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: People only become aware of the fact that Qlipoth has swung THEIR hammer again from the two phenomena invariably detected afterward: An enormous burst of intense gravitational waves, and "starquakes." Like a gift from the Preservation, the crystal meteorites dash across the dark sky and announce the beginning of a new Era.\n\n"The Genius Society is audacious enough to declare the Amber Lord as the slowest Aeon in the Cosmos, but none of these people have ever successfully observed the entire process of Qlipoth swinging the celestial hammer."

name: Divine Amber
description: The amber that rains from the Amber Lord's body when THEY swing the celestial hammer. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Preservation</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Although Pier Point sent out Meteor Hunters and intercepted most of the meteors, the brightest one among all these shooting stars will always only be seen by the chosen one.\n\n"It is a part of the divine body of the Aeon, albeit an insignificant one. Only the chosen ones, with their minds as steadfast as cornerstones and having endured challenges and hardships, can chisel apart this amber and unleash the crystalized light within."

name: Fiery Spirit
description: Feeble heliobus that scattered after the Flaming Catastrophe War. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: An innocent, formless heliobus. The size of a heliobus's flame when it materializes indicates its strength. This little heliobus is innocent and naive and may be easily consumed by more powerful heliobi. "Formless, rootless, and roaming boundless..."

name: Starfire Essence
description: A mature heliobus that ran away after the Flaming Catastrophe War. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: A mean and nasty heliobus that appears like a full flame. The size of a heliobus's flame when it materializes indicates its strength. This torch-like heliobus has just tasted consciousness and is eager to devour its host's emotions and desires. "Absorb their emotions and sway their wills..."

name: Heaven Incinerator
description: A beast-form heliobus that homogenized after the Flaming Catastrophe War. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: An intelligent and powerful heliobus that has started to take the form of a beast. The size of a heliobus's flame when it materializes indicates its strength. A large heliobus, having homogenized its numerous lesser peers, will gradually have a stable shape. These immortal beings can become so dangerous that they are considered calamities. "Floods, fires, landslides, and thunderstorms..."

name: Firmament Note
description: Scattered note from the firmament. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Harmony</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: A musical note scattered from order. Falling silently from the edge of the clouds, it blends into the symphony of mortal sounds, like a tear dissolving into the sea.\n\n"No one hears it until it dissolves into a song..."

name: Celestial Section
description: Melodious section fallen from the heavens. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Harmony</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: A musical section scattered from order. Falling silently from the edge of the heavens, it blends into the cacophony, like grains of sand scattered in the desert.\n\n"No one notices it until it ignites a spark of inspiration..."

name: Heavenly Melody
description: Symphonic movements from the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Harmony</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: A piece of music scattered from order. It quietly echoes from beyond the heavens, drowned out by profound silence, like a lone star twinkling in a river of stars.\n\n"No one feels it until it is forgotten by all ♬..."

name: Alien Tree Seed
description: The seed obtained from the fruit of the heart tree in the sacred Vonwacq forest, carrying the genes of various life forms. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The enormous alien holy tree in the sacred Vonwacq forest meticulously records the changes of the ecosystem over countless life cycles, continuously nurturing the ideal "Devil" using the genes of various life forms as seeds.\n\n"Cut this hard fruit open, scoop out the seed from its flesh, and plant it in sacred soil. You'll harvest dozens of leaders in the following year. Just wait for them to decide a winner via a battle royale!"

name: Nourishing Honey
description: The nectar brewed from the juice of flowers growing on the heart tree in the sacred Vonwacq forest. A honey that can accelerate the growth of life. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: When the Devil emerges from the fertile soil, it is only a round fruit with a stalk as long as a human's forearm. For some reason, it has to defeat its siblings before it has the right to drink nectar and grow into shape.\n\n"You can drink the sap of any tree in this forest, except that one."

name: Myriad Fruit
description: The fruit grown on the tip of the heart tree's branch in the sacred Vonwacq forest. It contains the essence of myriad lifeforms. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Abundance</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: One day and night after drinking the nectar of the divine tree, the ridiculous spherical fruit bloats into a "Devil" wearing fiber armor and wielding a wooden spear and a shield made of leaves. All around its footsteps, living creatures in the forest offer their genes as tributes to the Devil for it to taste, learn, and metamorphose. After that, the Devil will move on to challenge the sea and the sky of Vonwacq.\n\n"Through this method, the ancient sages imprisoned the most terrifying thing within a most ridiculous game."

name: Bīja of Consciousness
description: Consciousness fuses with matter, giving rise to the embryo of memory. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Remembrance</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: This thing does not truly exist until you see, hear, or sense something. This existence born from sensations soon falls silent, buried in the soil of thought — it may sprout one day, or it may not.\n\n"Such is the substance that forms our bodies, existing because you remember."

name: Seedling of Manas
description: Memory's cells extract thoughts, propagating in the heart of the inscriber. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Remembrance</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The seeds take root and sprout. Branches and buds weave together, transmitting signals like a living network of synapses. Over the passage of years, some wither and fade, while others flourish, growing strong enough to bear life and form the vessel of a soul. \n\n"We did not abandon the flesh. We merely transformed it into something... more enduring."

name: Flower of Ālaya
description: This is another form for life to exist and a substance that the universe cannot forget. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Remembrance</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: It matures. It becomes a web that constrains history, a blossom from the past. Life is its flower bed or its pistil. If you become the pistil, then you remember the universe and the universe remembers you. You are memory. \n\n"Memory is the true form of all things, thus there is no creation or annihilation in the Anāśrava pure land."

name: The Fluffy Hand-drawn Storyboards
description: Fluffy Across the Blue in its storyboard stage. Slightly increases the Traces of Elation characters.
backgroundDescription: Blurry is an incredibly fast artist who can draw a month's worth of work in a single day. But they never do, claiming they need to "guarantee quality," though they're likely just allergic to work. "It's so weird... how are there so many identical manuscripts of 'The Fluffy' out there, and every single one is clearly an original? Is Blurry selling these to make a quick buck?" "No way! Blurry is just a perfectionist who draws every page ten times until it's exactly right."

name: The Fluffy Serialization Memorial Issue
description: Fluffy Across the Blue currently in magazine serialization. Moderately increases the Traces of Elation characters.
backgroundDescription: Rumor has it that a Phantasmoon Games winner once accelerated time, leaving every artist in Planarcadia unable to meet their deadlines, except for Blurry. This is clearly just a tabloid story, and knowing them, QR_Colt probably wrote it themselves.\n\n"I was born drawing as well as Graphia, but it took me an entire lifetime to learn how to draw as fast as a Bullet Wyrm." — QR_Colt, during an online interview

name: The Fluffy Collector's Edition
description: Fluffy Across the Blue, now in published standalone volumes. Greatly increases the Traces of Elation characters.
backgroundDescription: The book's wrap-around band is packed with glowing reviews from cosmic icons like Pearl, Jade, Aventurine, Topaz, Ratio, Jing Yuan, Feixiao, Huaiyan, Yao Guang, Hua, Kafka, Robin, Arita, Schneider, Duke Inferno, Hoolay, Ryusuke, Sparkle, Sparxie, and {NICKNAME}. Blurry eventually lost a fortune in lawsuits for "forging endorsements and false advertising." "Counselor Umbralle, these petty celebrities are all ganging up to sue me. Can I hire you as my defense?" "Hahaha, you're funny. But I'd quite like to stay alive, thank you."

name: Grit of Strife
description: Crimson crystal dust that Castrum Kremnos craftsmen use to coat their weapons. Slightly increases the Traces of <color=#f29e38ff>The Hunt</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Dried divine blood that has crumbled into drifting crimson dust. It is the most primal, pervasive form of power, carrying the blessing and protection of Nikador.\n\n"Go on, keep talking! Once I arrive, it's the only thing you'll be able to do."

name: Resin of Valor
description: Crimson crystal amber forged by the craftsmen of Castrum Kremnos while tempering weapons. Moderately increases the Traces of <color=#f29e38ff>The Hunt</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Shimmering crimson crystals forged by melting divine blood dust in the fires of strife. These amber-like shards pulse with the rage and punishment of Nikador.\n\n"Let your arrows fly! They are but a refreshing rain to soothe the scorching heat of war."

name: Lance of Retribution
description: A crimson spear forged from the lives and dignity of the craftsmen of Castrum Kremnos. Greatly increases the Traces of <color=#f29e38ff>The Hunt</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: A spear forged by infusing blood-amber with a warrior's oath and the glory of victory. As the manifestation of the Lance of Fury, it embodies the very laws and essence of Nikador.\n\n"Show me your valiance! I shall still pay my respects... with steel and with blood."

name: Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King
description: A four-sided die used for simple checks. Can slightly level up Traces for <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The benefit of a four-sided die is that, if you believe in it, it will make every problem easy. Complex dilemmas, unsolvable games, and all those situations you have no idea how to handle — the hard part of it all lies in "not knowing what the optimal solution is." We spend our whole lives with a desire to grasp the power to select, yet spend that same lifetime feeling the anxiety of potential regret. But a four-sided die doesn't need to think about any of that. There is no optimal solution in the life of a die. In other words, in a die's life, all four sides are the optimal solution. "So don't overthink it. No matter what you select, I will declare it: a great success."

name: Sixen, King-Rook Fork
description: A six-sided die used for complex destiny checks. Can moderately upgrade the Traces of <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Once cast, the result of a six-sided die cannot be defied. This is the prerequisite for its presence at the gambling table, anchoring one's life, death, and destiny. The thrower "chooses" to cast it, and it brings a "result." But this is not the end, as the cycle of cause and effect has only just begun. Everyone must be prepared for the consequences of their choices, and even a Lord Ravager is no exception. "Yeah... I need to request some last-minute annual leave... Just in case the destruction of the world fails, I'll still need to keep my day job, you know."

name: Omnicolor, Fool's Own
description: A bizarre, myriad-colored die that binds infinite futures. Can greatly level up Traces for <color=#f29e38ff>Destruction</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Of course, there are also those who "choose" to reroll to escape a destiny of failure. That Lord Ravager is also keen on granting this opportunity. Unsatisfactory calculations, imperfect endings... He never tires of permitting a do-over. But every time he chooses to take the die back into his hands, its number of faces increases geometrically. "Friend, life's success rate doesn't go up just because you have more choices."

name: Celestial Globe
description: A beginner-level model suitable for astronomy enthusiasts to study. Can slightly level up Traces for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The model, clutched in youthful hands, was once warmed to a scorching temperature by love and longing. Despite its simple craftsmanship and ordinary materials, it was enough to make a child believe that the boundless universe was nothing more than a small sphere in their palm. It depicted a corner of the vast universe for the youth, only to be left behind forever at their childhood bedside. "Later, I ventured into the cosmos, far from home... Through the windows of the Express, my homeland had indeed become a tiny little thing."

name: Galaxy Framework
description: A framework of a galaxy used for advanced studies in interstellar navigation. Used to moderately level up Traces for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: In the Interstellar Navigation Dynamics class, the vast sea of stars is measured down to the inch, and eternal stars are reduced to mere framework components with varying specs and parameters. From then on, the distant horizon is crowded with scores and assessments, and romance must be written out as answers in black and white. It seems the academic journey demands far more passion than one might expect. "This galactic framework is beautifully crafted. I mean, I should give you an A."

name: Cosmic Sandpit
description: A cosmic sandpit drawn by a Navigator after surveying the universe. Can greatly level up Traces for <color=#f29e38ff>Erudition</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The picture painted by the pioneers is all-encompassing, and the simulated sandpit is vast enough to embrace the entire sea of stars. Latecomers take this as the starting point of their journey. Packing the sandpit into their handbags, they follow in the footsteps of their predecessors. It was not until the stars fell and she looked back that she realized: through all the meetings and partings along the way, she had journeyed ahead of everyone else, stepping among stars unrecorded even by the sandpit. "The meaning of the universe must lie beyond the universe."

name: Tear of Phagousa
description: A glass-like water droplet. Used to level up Traces slightly for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: Look through its clear surface and you will see fish-like shadows drifting within. Yet, they can never swim past the edge of this tear. \n\n"Drink it, and you'll see your homeland and the shore you can never reach."

name: Wine of Phagousa
description: Waves overflowing from the cup. Used to level up Traces moderately for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: The tides refract an intense blue, as if properly chronicling this banquet, held once and nevermore.\n\n"When believers shatter their honey brew-filled chalices, ocean waves shall bloom upon the earth."

name: Heart of Phagousa
description: A crystal made of countless ocean waves. Used to level up Traces significantly for <color=#f29e38ff>Nihility</color> characters.
backgroundDescription: It pulses like a beating heart and its gills open like an exhale, for an ocean still lives within it.\n\n"She pressed the ocean into her chest, trading it for eternal silence."

name: Enigmatic Ectostella
description: A fathomless crystal. Ascension material for the Trailblazer.
backgroundDescription: Severed from the highest of beings, this crystal reflects ever-changing mirages. The past and future intertwine on each of its countless facets, attempting to swallow up all observers.\n\n"Civilization is but a thin sheet of ice on top of the deep dark ocean of chaos."

name: Broken Teeth of Iron Wolf
description: Fragmented saw teeth left behind by automatons. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.
backgroundDescription: It is said that the smelting techniques of the Architects allowed them to make chainsaws sturdy enough to split giant boulders. Such techniques have been long lost to history.\n\n"Boss Svarog says its blade is so thin that it can cut into the gap between molecules... What are molecules?"

name: Endotherm Chitin
description: Hot, translucent substance almost like fire in the solid state. Can be used for the Ascension of Fire characters.
backgroundDescription: Strange chitin peeled off from an interdimensional creature. Although not piping hot anymore, it still radiates warmth.\n\n"It's too cold outside. But with this gemstone on you, you'll be able to travel far and wide, even to search for cities with humans left..."

name: Horn of Snow
description: Broken horn of a Frigid Prowler. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.
backgroundDescription: The Silvermane Guards would host contests where the winner must take a body part from a monster and bring it back within a set time limit. This cold broken horn must have been a trophy of one such contest.\n\n"Sir Bova, this is no moose horn and is certainly not fit for decoration above the Geomarrow furnace."

name: Lightning Crown of the Past Shadow
description: Headwear of the Guardian Shadows. Can be used for the Ascension of Lightning characters.
backgroundDescription: Accessory left behind by the shadow of a past Guardian, telling tales of the city of Everwinter.\n\n"Svetlana the Iron Fist — her wrath as terrifying as thunder and her retribution as swift as lightning."

name: Storm Eye
description: Arrows belonged to a Stormbringer. Can be used for the Ascension of Wind characters.
backgroundDescription: Used to belong to a certain Fragmentum monster modeled after a certain kind of Voidrangers. An arrowhead can be barely seen buried in the center of the vortex.\n\n"Those who perish in the Fragmentum shall rise again where they met their demise."

name: Void Cast Iron
description: Horseshoe of a Voidranger: Trampler. Can be used for the Ascension of Quantum characters.
backgroundDescription: Rare horseshoe obtained when a Trampler of the Antimatter Legion is defeated. When no one is observing, it pops in and out of existence.\n\n"The name of the experiment? It's just called "Horseshoe of the Trampler"... "

name: Golden Crown of the Past Shadow
description: Headwear of the Decaying Shadow. Can be used for the Ascension of Imaginary characters.
backgroundDescription: Accessory left behind by the shadow of a past Guardian, telling tales of the city of Everwinter.\n\n"Alina the Loving — her kindness as lofty as the sky and her compassion as brilliant as gold."

name: Netherworld Token
description: The Aurumaton Spectral Envoy's weapon. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.
backgroundDescription: This is both a weapon used by the Ten-Lords Commission messengers to subdue mara and abominations, as well as a token they present when undertaking operations. No authorities of the mortal realm have jurisdiction over them.\n\n"Messengers of Netherworld, authorized envoys of death's realm. Bearing orders for apprehension, with no pardon for transgressors."

name: Searing Steel Blade
description: The broken blade of a Searing Prowler. Can be used for the Ascension of Fire-Type characters.
backgroundDescription: The Silvermane Guards would host contests where the winner must take a body part from a monster and bring it back within a set time limit. This broken blade must have been a trophy of one such contest.\n\n"I saw it with my own eyes. Captain Gepard smashed that thing's hot steel blade with one blow of his fist, then held it with his bare hands and plunged it into the belly of that cold fatty, warming its heart."

name: Gelid Chitin
description: Frosty chitin emitting a cold humming. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.
backgroundDescription: Strange chitin peeled off from an interdimensional creature. Although not freezing cold anymore, it remains trembling, absorbing heat from its surroundings.\n\n"How has no one thought of selling it to worlds where they don't have air conditioners? It works like an air conditioner and sounds as loud as one, too."

name: Shape Shifter's Lightning Staff
description: A wooden staff with a pointed tip. It belonged to a shape shifter from the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. Can be used for the Ascension of Lightning characters.
backgroundDescription: According to ancient Xianzhou records, those who have ascended can summon lightning and command the wind. The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus claimed to have inherited the way of the gods. By demonstrating godly power, the disciples gathered large numbers of worshipers in secret. Branches of lightning coil around this wooden staff — could it be that the disciples were indeed no mere mortals?\n\n"The mortal body is but an illusion. Truth is only revealed to those who choose to ascend."

name: Ascendant Debris
description: Remains of The Ascended. Can be used for Ascension of Wind characters.
backgroundDescription: The Ascended originally intended to bring the world a legacy of kindness, but as the bestowment of Abundance fades, understanding arrives alongside liberation: They were nothing more than a mortal with flesh and blood. Their ability to traverse the skies was nothing but an illusion, and all that remained of their existence was dust and dirt.\n\n"I curse ye, Reignbow Arbiter..."

name: Nail of the Ape
description: Remnant of an Abundance Sprite. Can be used for the Ascension of Quantum characters.
backgroundDescription: The distinction between "sprite" and "abomination" is merely a matter of name. A sprite is tamed and obedient, while an abomination is an uncontrolled misfortune. This nail embedded in the body of the Malefic Ape serves as an eternal guarantee of its status as a sprite.\n\n"As a disciple, it is your duty to obey. If the Master Primus drives this Possession Nail into your body, then you will have no choice but to obey, won't you?"

name: Suppressing Edict
description: Parts used in the Xianzhou ingenium technology. Can be used for the Ascension of Imaginary characters.
backgroundDescription: After Rubert unleashed the calamity of inorganic life, the aurumaton in Xianzhou also rebelled and began a ruthless slaughter. To ensure that the turmoil does not resurface, the craftsmen imposed imprisonment using talismans, stripping the aurumaton of their ability to think. "What on earth did you do to make this fellow go mad?" "I didn't do anything! I just... cleaned that golden talisman a bit."

name: IPC Work Permit
description: An IPC "Senior Staff" work permit. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.
backgroundDescription: In the IPC, only project team leaders will have a work permit in this style. For workaholics like these experienced staff, they'd sooner forget to wear clothes than this name card.\n\n"This is more than just a pass into Pier Point. It is a status symbol!"

name: Raging Heart
description: The memoria core of "Shell of Faded Rage." Can be used for the Ascension of Fire characters.
backgroundDescription: The flames of anger will eventually consume themselves, erasing the original cause of the rage, and leaving behind only lingering resentment and an unquenchable core of poisonous hatred.\n\n"The memoria of fury will persist due to the hatred, yet it will also become unrealistic due to that hatred."

name: Dream Fridge
description: The fridge carried by Sweet Gorilla. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.
backgroundDescription: A special SoulGlad fridge designed to preserve icy sweetness. It serves as a tool for transporting drinks for the Sweet Dreams Troupe, and can also be wielded as a weapon when they are transformed into the Dreamjolt Troupe. "Notice: The Sweet Dreams Troupe serves as an outsourcing company for transportation, and SoulGlad Enterprise does not bear any liability in the event of accidents."

name: Nail of the Beast Coffin
description: A section of a mech's bionic spinal column. Can be used for the Ascension of Lightning characters.
backgroundDescription: The most important central component of the mech that was built in imitation of the borisin. Though the body that nurtured it no longer has even a sliver of life left, this component still maintains the "Slaughter Algorithm" inherited from primordial days and buried deep within its genes.\n\n"While you see a monster that can never be killed, I see infinite parts to salvage. That's the difference in perspective."

name: A Glass of the Besotted Era
description: A golden goblet of fine wine held by the troupe's cupbearer. Can be used for the Ascension of Wind characters.
backgroundDescription: A group of believers treads across countless stars, seeking memories of numerous fine wines, brewing their offerings in dreams. Another group of believers turns themselves into yeast, fermenting ancient faiths sealed by the dust of time, distilling their ideals within dreams.\n\n"At this moment, a cup of nectar blends with a goblet of poison, intoxicating this era together and poisoning the future with the past."

name: Dream Flamer
description: A flamer that instantly cooks food. Can be used for the Ascension of Quantum characters.
backgroundDescription: A special fiery dream flamer that uses flames to serve a delicious dream on the plate. It serves as a tool for the Sweet Dreams Troupe's cooking, and can also be wielded as a weapon when they are transformed into the Dreamjolt Troupe. "By design, the flames from this flamer affect only ingredients... although that doesn't exclude the possibility of the head chef regarding you as an ingredient."

name: Chordal Mirage
description: The silver strings from the red instruments carried by the troupe's instrumentalists. Can be used for the Ascension of Imaginary characters.
backgroundDescription: A simple composition weaves shattered pasts, and the sound of music guides hope for the future. As the strings are plucked, countless worlds converge here — the laughters of this moment and the faded tears, the eternal wishes and the unfinished dreams.\n\n"Pick up the memories buried in the ruins, and turn them into melodies."

name: Invasive Clot
description: Black Tide Creatures' core crystal. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.
backgroundDescription: Truly, the followers of black tide appear in countless forms and can reliably be identified by their crystals. Yet, no one realizes that what seems to be the core is, in truth, merely the "outer shell."\n\n"I saw a sea of crystals, and then — the relieved smile of the physician."

name: Radiant Prominence
description: An alien crown left behind by the Noontide Gryphon. Can be used for Ascension of Fire characters.
backgroundDescription: In a radiant fairy tale, Georios once sought the light of the moon to aid in creation. Aquila refused their rival's request, yet silently watched on, casting a sun-like gaze upon the land.\n\n"The dance of the zenith sun and the night moon brings forth a perfect eclipse."

name: Sea Siren's Torn Fin
description: Lady of Crashing Waves's spiny tail fin. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.
backgroundDescription: The daughters of the sea once had plump, long tails that glowed in the night, guiding lost fishermen home like lighthouses. Now, those fins have turned to bone spikes, piercing through the very chests they once protected.\n\n"The mad waves of the Skiana Sea can reach a thousand meters high. The ocean is no gentle mother."

name: Thunder Strum
description: A favorite instrument of the Rocking Rebels. An ascension material for Lightning characters.
backgroundDescription: Concerts in Planarcadia offer a spectacle you won't see anywhere else. Under the light of the Phantasmoon, the audience's soaring emotions actually manifest and react with the performers' instruments. Taming this physical emotion is a key skill for any musician here. Sometimes, after being soaked in that fervor for too long, an instrument might even evolve into a deadly weapon. "Burn this place to the ground! Salt the earth! Burn this place to the ground! Leave nothing but ruins!" — A rock singer, during a solo concert "Arcadia's a dream! The best place I've seen! The moon's out in bloom, and the air is serene!" — The same singer, at a gala hosted by Pearl

name: Charred Bud of Twilight
description: A corrosive core found within the head of a Dark Sun Gryphon. Can be used for the Ascension of Wind characters.
backgroundDescription: The crown symbolizing celestial radiance collapses into a bud-shaped corrosive core. Beings of light succumb to shadow, while the Gryphon's searing hatred consumes itself like embers' fire.\n\n"Light nurtures growth; darkness extorts death."

name: Darkveil Moonlight
description: An alien crown left behind by the Moonlit Pegasus. Can be used for Ascension of Quantum characters.
backgroundDescription: In a legend veiled by night, Oronyx once purloined the sun's radiance to bestow it upon the moon, as the Pegasi bore the brimming moonlight to ensure the earth's luminance during the slumber of Aquila.\n\n"How can the moon's pallid glow rival the splendor of the sun?"

name: Harbinger of Strife
description: The golden wheeled blade carried by Furiae Praetor. Can be used for Ascension of Imaginary characters.
backgroundDescription: Strife Titankins ascend through their ranks only via military achievements. This blade symbolizes exceptional courage, honor, and martial prowess.\n\n"Plunge into death's River of Souls, and honor our god with your eternal fame."

name: Sneering Harlequin
description: A clown mask that congeals the moment of greedy laughter. Ascension material for Quantum characters.
backgroundDescription: "What kind of joke could make the sneering ugly face contort into such an expression of laughter?" When plain jokes could no longer satisfy, and easy amusement failed to draw the masses' attention, the greedy one remembered this mask. That roaring laughter once lacerated the corners of its mouth, its afterecho reverberating across the universe to this day. Yet he was famished, consumed by a desire to hunt down the ultimate "joke" to fill his belly. Later, he got his wish and donned the mask. But in the vacuum-like silence, the only sound he heard was the unceasing chewing coming from his own mouth. "The greedy must first devour their own tongues. Hilarious, truly hilarious, hehehe..."

name: Destroyer's Final Road
description: Advanced level-up material for Traces.
backgroundDescription: The Leviathan's heart has stopped beating, but its mind lives on despite being trapped in a case. As long as the lid is closed, its mind is simultaneously both alive and dead, driving the engine of destruction.\n\n"Doomsday Beast, a blight made in the Warforge using what's left of a Leviathan and the weeping bones of thousands of the dead. It longs for the destruction of the universe and itself."

name: Guardian's Lament
description: Advanced level-up material for Traces.
backgroundDescription: Together with this visor, the twisted wish of a Guardian also lies broken. She had wanted to find a way out for her people to escape the Everwinter, but ended up becoming a puppet of a consciousness beyond her. "Supreme Guardian, the title passed down to generations of Belobog's rulers, the one who looked after all the people — It never occurred to anyone that the Guardians themselves also long for care and protection."

name: Regret of Infinite Ochema
description: Advanced level-up material for Traces.
backgroundDescription: No matter how many bodies it steals, its wish remains unfulfilled. Like those who seek the medicines of immortality, it craves an imperishable vessel, one that will rid it of its fear of destruction. And yet, it knows this is a dream that will never come true.\n\n"I have seen countless worlds devoured by The Blemished One's conflagration, and I was one of THEIR flames. I danced at the twirl of THEIR fingers, keenly aware that should the fuel burn out, this fire will also extinguish..."

name: Past Evils of the Borehole Planet Disaster
description: Advanced level-up material for Traces.
backgroundDescription: As a descendant bred personally by the Imperator Insectorum, its only desire is to expand the numbers of its kind. It uses giant scythes to harvest planets for its nest, tirelessly nurturing countless offspring, and devastating innumerable lives until the moment of its death.\n\n"On the broken planet, giant locusts blotted out the sky, and swarms of insects poured out of the planet's crust. The stag beetle raised this new nest and presented it as a gift to its Imperator Insectorum... May this horror only exist in historical records, never to appear again."

name: Lost Echo of the Shared Wish
description: Advanced level-up material for Traces.
backgroundDescription: THEY alone played the supreme rhythm until it was downed in THEIR multiple choruses. Yet, THEIR listeners refused to fall silent. As the foolish dreamer seized the string of the shared wish, the false player repeated the music forgotten by the world. "Stars trace your fingers and command all living's law and authority... Sweet dreams nowadays have manifested, and the gazillions of old laws have all faded away."

name: Auspice Sliver
description: Advanced upgrade material for Traces.
backgroundDescription: Only in the fleeting moment right before death, when all things appear frozen in time, can the eyes of mortal humans behold the falling forms of these spiritual feathers. Flying Aureus, Spiritus — its speed is the greatest out of the seven forms of the Reignbow's manifestation.\n\n "I spent a dozen days and nights to hunt it, only to discover it has always been inside my body."

name: Daythunder Anamnesis
description: Advanced upgrade material for Traces.
backgroundDescription: When the child of humanity drank of the crystal core, they lost the gift to sense human hearts. From then onward, their only purpose was to watch over the earth, bound to endless cycles of stars and moons. They continued to cherish life, yet could no longer perceive neighbors as living beings. "Prostrate upon the earth, longing for the touch of blue skies. Yet, once soaring high, the humble fragrance of grass is beyond all price..."

name: Vanquished Flow's Reticence
description: Advanced level-up material for Traces.
backgroundDescription: None remembered the sudden moment when the universe fell silent. The voice of thoughts dissolved. All shapes were recognized as identical pixels, captured by the anti-memetic web, transformed into a singular extrapolation. Until it ceased to "speak." "Core▀▄verdict▀▄█loop▄█▀entity▄me▀▄"

name: High Hopes of the Falsely Enlightened
description: Advanced level-up material for Traces.
backgroundDescription: The fools who lost their smile tirelessly play games with civilization, for without challengers there is no elation, not for others, and certainly not for themselves. Yesterday withered, heroes died, and the evil villain traversed the stars, unleashing malice upon all. Yet there is still a yearning for someone to defeat the great villain and take the rewards prepared since the very beginning. "Successors of Akivili, splendidly done."

name: Tears of Rail
description: Congeals the corners once visited. Can be used as a substitute for advanced Trace Materials when they are insufficient.
backgroundDescription: Frozen tundras, restless harbors, radiant metropolises, and forgotten sanctuaries... These distant corners once visited now shimmer before the eyes like a mirage, only to be sealed away within a teardrop of interwoven paths.\n\n"The ends of the path vanish into the endless starry sky, one side tethered to the past, the other leading toward the future."

name: Tears of Souls
description: A prison cage that sealed life's essence and soul. Can substitute materials dropped by enemies when they are insufficient. The substitution ratio of Tears of Souls varies depending on the materials' rarity.
backgroundDescription: The ice-cold screws in the automaton's engine, the blood-stained fangs in the borisin's mouth, the withered finger joints on the Sanctus Medicus disciple's hand, the emotions jumping in the Memory Zone Meme's head... The various essences of life are all imprisoned within this tear.\n\n"This drop of tear is the best proof that all life has a soul."

name: Extinguished Core
description: The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Crude material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: It is a lesion that breeds evil, the impulse to sin. It is the source of the Fragmentum distortion. A heavy blow has caused this heart to stop beating and lose its luster. "Preliminary tests indicate it's some kind of hybrid: One half is primordial, and the other half is something very similar to Stellarons." — Department of Biology, Sarah Castro

name: Glimmering Core
description: The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Normal material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: It is a lesion that breeds evil, the impulse to sin. It is the source of the Fragmentum distortion. The heart is glimmering and the veins on it indicate it's still alive. "What kind of monster is this? Did you see it... Its face! It has the face of our previous leader!"

name: Squirming Core
description: The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Advanced material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: It is a lesion that breeds evil, the impulse to sin. It is the source of the Fragmentum distortion. The heart is pulsating slowly, with a residual force powerful enough to cause a new calamity. It's best to destroy it to prevent further troubles. "It's like a cancer..."

name: Thief's Instinct
description: A small amount of anti-matter. Crude material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: A small amount of anti-matter that emanates out of the Voidranger: Reaver like the materialization of its destructive instinct.\n\n"They are all looking forward to the moment of obliteration, when they will be reforged and fused with the entire world."

name: Usurper's Scheme
description: A moderate amount of anti-matter. Normal material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: A moderate amount of anti-matter that floats around the Voidranger: Distorter. The amount of matter and anti-matter particles has reached a dangerous balance...\n\n"They are all looking forward to the moment of obliteration, when they will be reforged and fused with the entire world."

name: Conqueror's Will
description: Condensed anti-matter. Advanced material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Highly condensed anti-matter within the body of the Voidranger: Trampler. The moment of obliteration is the trumpet call for civilizations' destruction.\n\n"They are all looking forward to the moment of obliteration, when they will be reforged and fused with the entire world."

name: Silvermane Badge
description: Pin badge worn by soldiers of the Silvermane Guards. Crude material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: It is full of scratches from the erosion of wind and snow.\n\n"In ancient times, there was only one way Silvermane Guards could retire: Death."

name: Silvermane Insignia
description: Military rank insignia worn by captains of the Silvermane Guard. Normal material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Maybe it's a proof of heroics that you can brag about to your family. Maybe it's a lucky charm that protects you from a bullet.\n\n"Times have changed."

name: Silvermane Medal
description: Medal of honor worn by soldiers of the Silvermane Guards with gallant and meritorious service. Advanced material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: A proof of honor awarded to those that fought against Fragmentum creatures, Underworlders, and sudden disasters. It is not usually pinned onto the recipient's chest, but rather placed onto his coffin. "Remember, young Gepard. It is not a toy: It is the destiny and blood of the Landau family."

name: Ancient Part
description: Mechanical part left behind from the Old World. Crude material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Despite its size, it was cast and polished in a way that people today would struggle to replicate.\n\n"A small screw in the Old World is stronger than our armor."

name: Ancient Spindle
description: Mechanical spindle left behind from the Old World. Normal material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Once taken apart, the precision components can never be put back together. Even the maintenance veterans in Belobog's Technology Division would think twice before touching it.\n\n"You idiot, the Bluecoats will only give you a few canned goods for this. Take it to Boss Svarog and you won't need to worry about food and clothing for a while."

name: Ancient Engine
description: Mechanical engine left behind from the Old World. Advanced material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: It uses Geomarrow as the energy source. When powered, it spews wandering auroras, not sparkles.\n\n"Only the Technology Division directly under the Supreme Guardian has access to information regarding the Old World. I lost my privileges after I was fired."

name: Immortal Scionette
description: New and young shoot budding from an ancient divine construct. Crude material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "infinite lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. Countless years ago, a sovereign's hubris for immortality caused the Xianzhou fleet to sail into the sea of outer space to seek divine recipes.\n\n"We desire to live for endless ages and maintain the empire for all eternity. Unfortunately, human lives have limits and human capacity has its ends. Thus, we send nine Navis Astrigera to sail beyond the sky, seeking divine recipes for immortality."

name: Immortal Aeroblossom
description: New flowers blooming out of an ancient divine construct. Normal material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "Endless Lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. After endless trials, the fleet seeking the medicine of immortality was able to behold the visage of the celestial being. The divine one cast down its blessings in material form, and the Ambrosial Arbor sprouted its leaves.\n\n"New buds descend into the moon, divine flowers bloom by the clouds. In the blink of a blossom's life, old wood returns to youthful grove."

name: Immortal Lumintwig
description: Deciduous twigs from an ancient divine construct. Advanced material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "Endless Lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. After the Three Sufferings, Xianzhou laid in devastation. The Homo celestinae fell as demons, and catastrophes occurred ceaselessly.\n\n"As decreed by the Ten-Lords Commission, all who are near the mara-struck state will be seized by the infernal judges and cast into the Shackling Prison."

name: Artifex's Module
description: Components used in Xianzhou's ingenium creations. Crude material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: The foundation of Xianzhou's ingenium technology. The smallest constituent of all machine parts. Breaking it apart would be akin to destroying the cellular structure of a living being. "The Intelligentsia Guild put up a bounty of two million credits for technical plans that can flawlessly disassemble Xianzhou mechanical puppets." "If you know Screwllum, then these two millions are basically yours to take..."

name: Artifex's Cogwheel
description: Parts of the Xianzhou machines. Normal material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: The connective components used in Xianzhou's ingenium technology. The intricate and thin teeth of the cogwheels are as minute as mustard seeds, and yet are interconnected to form a complex body, making the machine able to pass as true life.\n\n"Its form lies in harmony, a parallel to nature. Its movements cyclical, echoing the cosmos."

name: Artifex's Gyreheart
description: Components used in Xianzhou's ingenium creations. Advanced material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: The core of Xianzhou's ingenium technology. The armillary sphere roils and vibrates like the essence of a heart, making the machine think like a living being.\n\n"Do not be startled. Taking away its heart would make him... her?... No, make it lose its sentience and return to its mechanical sources."

name: Dream Collection Component
description: A storage device for Dreamscape creations. Crude material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: A storage device for broken dreams, providing a fundamental energy source for Dreamscape creations.\n\n"Install this device, and you will get a member of the Sweet Dreams Troupe."

name: Dream Flow Valve
description: A control component for Dreamscape creations. Normal material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: A dream-building device that regulates desires and controls the Dreamscape creations' emotions.\n\n"If this device fails, you will get a member of the Dreamjolt Troupe."

name: Dream Making Engine
description: An energy core for Dreamscape creations. Advanced material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: A dream-building device that constructs fantasies and grants souls to Dreamscape creations.\n\n"If this device malfunctions... try to wake up before you descend into a nightmare, my friend."

name: Tatters of Thought
description: A memoria fragment of fleeting thought. Crude material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Within the Memory Zone, thousands of thoughts flutter like dust. Broken thoughts accumulate, serving as nourishment and components for memes.\n\n"A fleeting thought may dissipate into thin air or amass into obsessions."

name: Fragments of Impression
description: A memoria fragment of profound impression. Normal material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Within the Memory Zone, the form of memories float as fleeting glimmers of light, and only profound and memorable fragments can condense it crystals.\n\n"Memory is not a mere replication of past sensations, but a reconstruction of past impressions."

name: Shards of Desires
description: A memoria fragment of obsessive desires. Advanced material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Within the Memory Zone, memoria of desires develops ceaselessly. It absorbs thoughts and impressions, nurtures magic mirrors of desires, and reflects the eerie shadows of memetic entities.\n\n"Memory points to the past, while desire points to the future. To seek desires from memory will cause dreams to become inverted, and inner demons will naturally be born."

name: Fear-Stomped Flesh
description: Dust that forms the Strife Titankins. Crude material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: The tide of death sweeps across the world, and giants of hatred and resentment step forth from the River of Souls. All fear and cower before that stone-carved legion.\n\n"Slaughter is the stone from which fear is hewn."

name: Courage-Torn Chest
description: A fragment of the Strife Titankins after their demise. Normal material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: The slothful generals began to drill, and the reclusive sages began to plot. Then humanity discovered they could shatter the creations of gods, and slaughter became war.\n\n"Fear is the chisel of courage."

name: Glory-Aspersed Torso
description: The heart of a Strife Titankin, full of divine power. Advanced material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: In the beginning, humanity fought wars to stay alive, but now some fight as fearlessly as the Titankins of Strife to achieve death. The Kremnoans say that perhaps warriors of flesh and stone share the same heart —\n\n"And this heart is called glory, with courage flowing within."

name: Ethereal Omen
description: A fragment dropped by black tide creatures. Crude material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Misfortune often creeps in quietly, and by the time you perceive it, it has already swelled into a calamity that engulfs the world.\n\n"The death knell sounds at destiny's cessation."

name: Echoing Wail
description: A fractured carapace from black tide creatures. Normal material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Grotesque heads roar, ragged blades keen enough to sunder all, while the genesis of the scourge still lurks, veiled in the shadows and shrouded by the mists of death.\n\n"Why do you lament alone at the gravestone?"

name: Eternal Lament
description: A crystal born from the demise of black tide creatures. Advanced material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Born of the void and destined to return to the void. A contorted existence wrought by decay, fated to wander the desolate earth purposelessly.\n\n"Its life is one of ruin and sorrow."

name: Whimsy Wax
description: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A crude material used for enhancement.
