backgroundDescription: In the primal wilds, a mother asked her child, "Did you break your father's bow?" The child answered, "No, it must have been someone else." "No one else has ever stepped foot in this cave," the mother said. "If it wasn't you, then it must have been me." The child continued, "A gremlin did it. I saw it with my own eyes, but only kids can see them, so that's why you didn't." The mother laughed. "Fine then, why would a gremlin break your father's bow?" The child said calmly, "Father probably stepped on its nest. You adults can't see gremlins, so you're always breaking their homes." Whether this talk actually happened is irrelevant. The truth it holds is undeniable — the first stories were born from the imagination of a child. For billions of years since, those same fantasies have continued to change the world. "With stories, we are able to escape from reality."

name: Dreamweave Steel
description: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A normal material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Remember the old story? An officer pointed at a painting that exposed his atrocities and asked, "Did you paint this?" The artist smiled and replied, "No, you did." Art that tries to represent reality cannot simply copy it. The shallow surface of reality can never capture its profound, intangible essence. Consider a fallen soldier. If you only paint their likeness, they are just one more face among the nameless dead. But if you look past the surface to find the invisible honor, courage, rage, and regret, that is when you truly reach their reality. Only then will people know that this soldier was not just another statistic. This was someone who once brought the pulse of life to the mountains, the waters, and the homes they left behind. "With stories, we are able to fight back against evil."

name: Lucid Awl
description: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. An advanced material used for enhancement.
backgroundDescription: Every story worth taking seriously shares the same theme: "How to live the one life we're given." Life is so short that even the greatest sages are suddenly tossed into this world, forced to experience a lifetime without any preparation. That is why no one ever lives a perfect life. There are always regrets, always moments wasted. But luckily, we have stories. In stories, creators and readers share a different life. In stories, the human experience is continuously extended. And in stories, we can reach immortality from within our finite cages. "With stories, we are able to live a thousand lifetimes."

name: Hertareum
description: The cryptocurrency circulating internally in the Herta Space Station. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
backgroundDescription: Hertareum was planned as a digital currency, but eventually settled as a physical currency.\nIt's worth mentioning that even though Hertareum coins don't contain any precious metal components, the high-definition silhouette Non-Fungible Token contained inside it is much more valuable than any of them.

name: Shield
description: The official currency circulating in Belobog. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
backgroundDescription: After a long era of blockades, the Overworld and Underworld denizens of Belobog have developed vastly different standards for currency.\nThe current exchange rate of shield to credits is now 1:<unbreak>50</unbreak>... Speaking of, why are credits still an official currency of Belobog? It seems people have already forgotten the answer to this question.

name: Strale
description: The internal currency of the Xianzhou Alliance with strales as its basic monetary unit. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
backgroundDescription: The Xianzhou strales have long been digitized before Xianzhou's interactions with the IPC ever happened. However, there are some collectors who still kept the Celest-Gold coins minted when the Alliance first came into existence. Shaped like the tip of an arrow or a narrow leaf, it seems to allude to the past and future of that civilization.

name: Clock Credits
description: This is said to be a commemorative currency issued personally by the Watchmaker. Can only be used at the Clockie Statue.
backgroundDescription: A mysterious banknote, whose origin is unknown even to The Family. It features the classic image of Clockie on the front. This currency is prohibited for regular transactions in the Dreamscape world, and only a few people know its true purpose.

name: Celestial Ambrosia
description: It was said that even Titans covet this ambrosial libation. Cast it into the Tides of the Basin within the Vortex of Genesis.
backgroundDescription: The absolute finest of Amphoreus' thousand ambrosias. A golden, sweet nectar. It is said to come from the divine corpus of the Chalice of Plenty spilled onto the earth, making it the perfect offering to the Titans. Just a few drops are enough to inebriate a mortal with its rich fragrance. Consuming it on its own leads to unconsciousness, as if one is drowning in a vast ocean.

name: Disorder Ambrosia
description: A liquid that exists outside temporal order. Cast it into the Tides of the Basin within the Vortex of Genesis.
backgroundDescription: A precious drink that was once considered "Celestial Ambrosia" in worldly cognition. As the cycles of Amphoreus were revealed, so did the truth of this drink. The scent wafting out of the bottle's mouth seems even more intense and sweeter than before, but imbibing is still not recommended.

name: Arcadian Token
description: A commemorative coin used within Planarcadia, commonly known as "Wishbae." Can be exchanged for rewards at Furbobocom News.
backgroundDescription: The local currency of Planarcadia, minted and issued by the Wishpower Bank after being infused with Wishpower. The front depicts various imagenae living together in harmony. In the face of a digital economy, the Arcadian Token maintains its prestigious status among tourists and collectors for its unique blend of cultural sentiment and economic value.

name: Aideen Tokens
backgroundDescription: A token for amusement facilities at Aideen Park. Despite their large size, they are exceptionally lightweight.\n\nQ: What is something that the more you possess, the less wealth you have? A: Gambler's chips.

name: Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Forgotten Hall
description: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Forgotten Hall this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
backgroundDescription: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

name: Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Pure Fiction
description: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Pure Fiction this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
backgroundDescription: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

name: Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Apocalyptic Shadow
description: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Apocalyptic Shadow this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
backgroundDescription: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

name: Anomaly Arbitration Limited-Time Clearance Medal
description: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in the King Stage of Anomaly Arbitration of this period.
backgroundDescription: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

name: Access Card
description: Can be used to open the Relic Chest in the mysterious collection at Herta Space Station.
backgroundDescription: An unassuming card that can unlock Herta Space Station's most secure vault. If used wisely, it could lead to long-lost treasures.

name: Access Card
description: Can be used to open Relic Chests in the mysterious collection at Herta Space Station.
backgroundDescription: An unassuming card that can unlock Herta Space Station's most secure vault. If used wisely, it could lead to long-lost treasures.

name: Praise of High Morals
backgroundDescription: In this grand universe, moral standards are materialized into physical form. Thumbs-up approvals aren't a rare sight to behold.\nWhat matters is that you are recognized!

name: Ancient Coin
backgroundDescription: An old coin from a time when metal was still a plentiful resource in Belobog.

name: Core Module
backgroundDescription: Defective parts collected from a malfunctioning robot.\n\n"You get what you pay for. Obviously, this is worthless."

name: Thermal-Powered Mechanical Mining Pick
backgroundDescription: According to Sampo, it's a piece of mining equipment that he lost.\n\n"A pickaxe with a polished point might make for a decent weapon?"

name: Anti-Dust Mask
backgroundDescription: According to Sampo, it's a piece of mining equipment that he lost.\n\n"An ordinary respirator."

name: Customized Pink Safety Helmet
backgroundDescription: According to Sampo, it's a piece of mining equipment that he lost.\n\n"Put it on and you'll be the finest in the mines."

name: Strange Drill Ornament
backgroundDescription: A strange ornament you found in the Corridor of Fading Echoes resembling a delicate drill.\n\n"'Balakin' is inscribed onto the back. Your intuition tells you this device isn't something simple..."

name: Balakin Family Box
backgroundDescription: An iron box passed down by the Balakin family, containing secrets left behind by their ancestors hundreds of years ago.\n\n"My ancestors left behind the iron box, but forgot to leave its key. Funny, very funny."

name: Device Encryption Key
backgroundDescription: An encryption key used to activate the energy core in the restricted zone.\n\n"Despite its apparent similarities to other cores, it is clear the energy core inside the Silvermane Guard Restricted Zone is highly-customized."

name: Terminal Encryption Key
backgroundDescription: A custom key that can unlock the gear bridge inside the Silvermane Guard Restricted Zone. Only officers are granted access permissions.

name: Temporary Visitor Pass
backgroundDescription: A temporary pass allowing entry into the Silvermane Guard Restricted Zone.\n\n"Temporary workers in possession of this temporary pass may enter the restricted zone within three hours. Lending this pass to others is a felony, and offenders will suffer serious consequences."

name: Mine Cart Pin
backgroundDescription: A part used to connect the body and chassis of a mine cart.\n\n"It is this small part that supports the entire structural integrity of the mine cart."

name: Robot Settlement Level 1 Certification
backgroundDescription: Level-1 certification for opening the entrance of the Robot Settlement. Only those who have obtained all three certification levels can gain permission to open the door.\n\n"Hey, ow! Ow, ow, ow... Can't this robot be more gentle with a pretty girl's hand?"

name: Robot Settlement Level 2 Certification
backgroundDescription: Level-2 certification for opening the entrance of the Robot Settlement. Only those who have obtained all three certification levels can gain permission to open the door.\n\n"Hey, ow! Ow, ow, ow... Can't this robot be more gentle with a pretty girl's hand?"

name: Robot Settlement Level 3 Certification
backgroundDescription: Level-3 certification for opening the entrance of the Robot Settlement. Only those who have obtained all three certification levels can gain permission to open the door.\n\n"Hey, ow! Ow, ow, ow... Can't this robot be more gentle with a pretty girl's hand?"

name: Space Station Special Permit
backgroundDescription: A Space Station Special Permit issued by Asta and Arlan. Allows you to freely enter and exit most cabins of the space station.\n\n"Why not all cabins you ask? Let's just say, researchers of Herta Space Station are all crouching tigers, I don't want to limit their imaginations when it comes to unlocking things."

name: Mine Cart Wheelset
backgroundDescription: A part used for connecting mine cart wheels.\n\n"A sturdy axle connects two mine cart wheels."

name: A Bottle of Glass Marbles
backgroundDescription: Proof of Julian's capacities.\n\n"There are no masters and newbies with marbles. Only those who grab the opportunities can win."

name: Julian's Time Capsule
backgroundDescription: Treasure across time.\n\n"I didn't dig out ninety percent of the time capsules."

name: Commercial District Key
backgroundDescription: A key that can be used in the Rivet Town Commercial District.\n\n"The Fragmentum has come and everyone has fled. What Chamber of Commerce?"

name: Junjun, the Cuddly Bear
backgroundDescription: A big bear doll that has been stashed away.\n\n"Natasha's hand-made bear doll. Admittedly, it is rather cute."

name: Treasure Map
backgroundDescription: A map that supposedly leads to treasure.\n\n"A Treasure Map that looks rather sketchy. Is it... accurate?"

name: Real Treasure Map
backgroundDescription: A map that supposedly leads to treasure.\n\n"A Treasure Map made a long time ago. Judging by how old it is, seems quite convincing."

name: Fragmentum Monster Armor
backgroundDescription: Chitin that looks like armor, taken from a Fragmentum Monster.\n\n"Who wants something like this..."

name: Used Item Auction Pamphlet
backgroundDescription: A pamphlet about the used item auction.\n\n"A way for vagrants to trade... an auction sounds like a good idea."

name: Logistic Navigation Map
backgroundDescription: A navigation map with "recipient address" marked on it.\n\n"Heron Express would like to warn you about the latest scam, 'We left your delivery at your door.'"

name: Ultra Nickel Part
backgroundDescription: Intricate parts dotted around the Disposal Site. Hardly anyone would notice these dated-looking dull little things. Iron and nickel are gifts from the shooting star, but ultra nickel is something entirely different... Produced with mysterious methods, this superalloy, though outdated in the eyes of Herta, is patented and has no competition in the entire universe.\n\n"No competition? You get one of these for 10 credits on the black market. They say you can use it to repair all the beacons in the universe, very versatile."

name: Red Signal Log
backgroundDescription: A signal log in which is recorded the affirmative answer from Lesley and the truth about the starquake. It is sweet yet cruel.\n\n"Knowing how Rocky is, even I can't predict what he might do when he learns the truth."

name: Blue Signal Log
backgroundDescription: A fake log with Lesley's answer. Whoever made this hopes to maintain the fragile balance of Rocky's life using abrupt rejection.\n\n"She will say no to him and his life will go on. It's always easier to forget than to heal."

name: Surveillance Footage
backgroundDescription: A clip of the footage captured by the Herta Panopticon System. With all researchers under constant watch, there's no keeping secrets.\n\n"Surveillance is the bane of secrets but also the best historian-to-be. You can trace back to the beginning of everything, be it good or bad."

name: Videotape: Dim Blue Dot
backgroundDescription: A videotape that recorded the intricate secrets of the space station. Its maker went the extra mile in making it secure by installing a most extraordinary security mechanism.\n\n"As if you have fallen into a space that has neither beginning nor end, you look through a standard-issue navigation visor and stare into the deepest retreat of the vast universe. In the distance, you see a dim blue dot, like a drop of water before the canvas of darkness."

name: Videotape: Justice
backgroundDescription: A videotape that recorded the intricate secrets of the space station. Its maker went the extra mile in making it secure by installing a most extraordinary security mechanism.\n\n"That's the most direct evidence of the power of the Aeons. The justice people are seeking seems almost amusing in the face of a doomed planet... The hollow and eerily fast utterance is proof that the last bit of the videotape has been corrupted by something."

name: Videotape: Doomsday
backgroundDescription: A videotape that recorded the intricate secrets of the space station. Its maker went the extra mile in making it secure by installing a most extraordinary security mechanism.\n\n"There are no reinforcements. If you can, please come back following the route we agreed on in advance. Do you copy? The intermittent sound from the cosmic radio is calling a name repeatedly. There is no reply."

name: Misdelivered Letter 1
backgroundDescription: An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: Dear kindhearted soul, can you buy me a stamp and post this for me? A thousand thanks!\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.

name: Misdelivered Letter 2
backgroundDescription: An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: To Carlo Eyre, Room B<unbreak>03</unbreak>, Building <unbreak>35</unbreak>, 6th Street, Administrative District.\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.

name: Misdelivered Letter 3
backgroundDescription: An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: To my one and only; my precious; my eternally youthful; my clever and witty; the one worthy of all my love to protect; the one who may not even exist: The true love of my future.\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.

name: Misdelivered Letter 4
backgroundDescription: An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: The trash I wrote should never see the light of day. That's fine, it can rot forever in the bottom of the dark mailbox.\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.

name: Milk Powder Package
backgroundDescription: One of the anonymous packages delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Milk powder and a thermal baby bottle. Very thoughtful indeed..."

name: Anonymous Package
backgroundDescription: Anonymous package not yet delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Next to the anonymous package lies its sender."

name: Thousand Stars Access Authentication
backgroundDescription: A mysterious card used to access an unknown facility. Its corner has been chipped away and the letters on it have become unrecognizable. But when you hold it under the light at a certain angle, you can see the faint letters that read "Thousand Stars."\n\n"Obviously this card was extremely valuable, but it was discarded like trash when someone lost interest... Sounds like something Herta would do."

name: ██ Access Authentication
backgroundDescription: A mysterious card used to access an unknown facility. Its corner has been chipped away and the letters on it have become unrecognizable. But when you hold it under the light at a certain angle, you can see the faint letters that read "██." "When you run your fingers past the incomprehensible letters, you can't help but think: Maybe this card is one of those collector's edition things. Could it be that having all the cards can grant you the power to summon... that Aeon?"

name: Corporate Access Authentication
backgroundDescription: A mysterious card used to access an unknown facility. Its corner has been chipped away, and the letters on it have become unrecognizable. But when you hold it under the light at a certain angle, you can see the faint letters that read "Corporate."\n\n"Trust me, this is no doubt an access card used to open multiple layers of secured hatches, and it must have been developed by big corporations. The room it unlocks must also have been built by some pan-cosmic magnate."

name: Box of Rubbing Alcohol
backgroundDescription: A box of medical supplies urgently needed by Natasha.\n\n"Rubbing alcohol — hope it hasn't evaporated too much..."

name: Box of Special Painkillers
backgroundDescription: A box of medical supplies urgently needed by Natasha.\n\n"Natasha's home-made painkillers. People faint just from the smell."

name: Children's Book Package
backgroundDescription: One of the anonymous packages delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Children fall asleep to stories. A must-try for young parents..."

name: Toddler Clothing Package
backgroundDescription: One of the anonymous packages delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Soft and breathable, our quality clothing is designed to protect your baby from sweat. Perfect for silky-smooth skin."

name: Kluzer's Letter
backgroundDescription: Old letters that Kluzer carries around.\n\n"He didn't have the time to post them... maybe he didn't need to anymore..."

name: Old Photo of Balakin
backgroundDescription: An old yellowing photo. Evidence of a certain individual's part in a certain historic event. The figure in the picture did not seem to plan to let people feel the historical weight this photo should carry. "What will become of Belobog in a hundred years? Well, you'll have to see it through your eyes."

name: Commodity Contract
backgroundDescription: Commodity contract for the auction. Use it to get paid based on the value of the goods.\n\n"They always put 'Handle with Care' on the contract but everyone ignores it."

name: Geomarrow Probe
backgroundDescription: Rare relic from ancient times. Can be used with intricate Old World instruments.\n\n"A way for vagrants to trade... an auction sounds like a good idea."

name: Letter From the Comet Hunter
backgroundDescription: Letter from outer space by Hosea Lazaro the comet hunter — full of rubbish.\n\n"Back when I was still in the space station, I would look into the night sky in search of those faraway celestial bodies. Those clouds of stars, soft and alluring, captured my anxious heart. If you are like me, it's only a matter of time before people crown you with the title 'comet hunter'."

backgroundDescription: Letter from outer space by Hosea Lazaro the comet hunter — full of rubbish.\n\n"Back when I was still in the space station, I would look into the night sky in search of those faraway celestial bodies. Those clouds of stars, soft and alluring, captured my anxious heart. If you are like me, it's only a matter of time before people crown you with the title 'comet hunter'."

Those clouds of stars, soft and alluring, captured my anxious heart. If you are like me, it's only a matter of time before people crown you with the title 'comet hunter'."

name: Xenohydro in a Case
backgroundDescription: The Xenohydro was confined within a Mystic Case in the shape of a trapezohedron, with one of the planes made from the Absolutely Objective Lens. It is observed that the Xenohydro has icy blue skin that has silver spots dotted around. If you look through other planes to observe the Xenohydro, you'll find that it looks rather different. In fact, the image of the Xenohydro will vary from person to person.\n\n"I have a feeling that compared with the Xenohydro, this case is the actual curio. It can be worth quite a lot on the curio market."

name: Kapo-Kali Recipe
backgroundDescription: The uncrowned king of the beverage world, a coarse slice of manly friendship, and together with a lethal dosage of humor.\n\n"A big barrel of pure caramel, a few jumping peas here and there, a handful of fresh canterbury bells, and some interdimensional leaves. Don't forget a drop of Ambergris of Abundance and a few rolls of orchid zest. How much of a kick you want is your choice."

name: Rusted Key
backgroundDescription: A key with its teeth all worn smooth and not looking like it can open doors anytime soon.\n\n"Rivet Town Chamber of Commerce? Ask Julian if he knows about it."

name: Special Autoradiograph
backgroundDescription: A treasure map decoded with a Special Autoradiograph, revealing hidden coordinates within the space station.\n\n"I heard that scoundrel left behind some good stuff in the space station. This must be where the treasure is."

name: Delicate Snow Globe
backgroundDescription: Bronya's toy as a child. The snowy owl circles above the snowfields, looking for the best opportunity to hunt the hare.\n\n"Even if our connection with the past is completely broken, there are still things that can complete us."

name: Ball Peony
backgroundDescription: A very expensive flower. It blooms only once a year for a month.\n\n"But honestly, the price is completely worth that one month of bloom!"

name: First Snow
backgroundDescription: An eight-petalled flower with white spots at each tip, just like snowflakes.\n\n"A long time ago, the initial snow of the year symbolized harvest and joy."

name: Marquise
backgroundDescription: An aristocratic flower beloved by high society.\n\n"Rumor has it that a noblewoman spent her entire family's fortune on one of these flowers. This was why it was given the name Marquise."

name: Sunshine
backgroundDescription: A lovely small red-and-yellow flower that looks like the sun.\n\n"Just looking at it makes you feel warm inside."

name: Mechanical Parts
backgroundDescription: Common mechanical parts used everywhere.\n\n"The prospectors say this is the specialty of corners and gaps. It kinda makes sense..."

name: Robot Shell
backgroundDescription: A metal casing removed from discarded robots. Maybe it can still be used.\n\n"It's common for animals to molt, but have you seen robots molt?"

name: Flower Made From Scrap Iron
backgroundDescription: A cold metallic construct, but a burning passion perhaps hides beneath the petals.\n\n"It is cold to the touch, but warm if you put it against your body. Where on your body? Try your heart."

name: Backup Batteries
backgroundDescription: Portable backup power source for the elevator. Can be used in an emergency after being assembled.\n\n"Safety and portability are both great, but the capacity... who designed this!?"

name: Artisanship Commission Jade Seal
backgroundDescription: A token required to cross an important location.

name: Mei's Notes: Flowers
backgroundDescription: This seems to be a note that Mei had dropped. Messy writing fills the page with records on how to look after some common flower species.

name: Mei's Notes: Learning About Housework
backgroundDescription: This seems to be a note that Mei had dropped. Messy writing fills the page with records of what she had learned from other housekeepers.

name: Mei's Testimony
backgroundDescription: Testimony that Tantan had recorded at the scene of the incident. It is no simple task to get useful information out of the victim's jumbled statements.

name: Testimony From the Clumsy Lady
backgroundDescription: Testimony that Tantan had recorded at the scene of the incident. It is no simple task to get useful information out of the witness' jumbled statements.

name: Testimony From the Suddenly Excited Man
backgroundDescription: Testimony that Tantan had recorded at the scene of the incident. It is no simple task to get useful information out of the witness' jumbled statements.

name: Cycrane Surveillance Images
backgroundDescription: A picture of the lane taken by the cycrane. Starskiffs fly to and fro within the lane. The offending starskiff tried to hide within the traffic, only to expose itself.

name: Master Capote's Fan Reply Card
backgroundDescription: Handwritten cards with words of encouragement from Capote to his fans.\n\n"Master Capote's care and love for everyone is contained in these words!"

name: Master Capote's Limited-Edition Snapshot
backgroundDescription: A photo snapped from a unique angle and contains Capote's autograph.\n\n"Master Capote authorized it! It's not an intrusion of privacy!"

name: Master Capote's Life Wiki
backgroundDescription: The wiki-style encyclopedia that Capote's fans created themselves. Its contents mostly involve Capote's sayings.\n\n"Master Capote's keyword in life has been updated. The most recent version is: Illumination!"

name: Arlan's ID Pass
backgroundDescription: A personal special pass belonging to Arlan, with Peppy's photo stuck to it.\n\n"Brother is certainly loyal, and he carries his good friend's photo whenever he goes."

name: Broken Ceiling Tile
backgroundDescription: An alloy ceiling tile that is heavily damaged after a strong impact.\n\n"Will us Security Department have to... pay the bill for repairs?"

name: Footprint
backgroundDescription: Arlan used too much force during combat and left a footprint on the floor tile.\n\n"We Security Department should use this as our insignia next year!"

name: Photo of Arlan's Back
backgroundDescription: A photo of Arlan's back as he heads to the suspicious crystal on his own to investigate. The determination in his steps is obvious.\n\n"Brother is definitely a bear amongst horses! His figure is so cool!"

name: Dirty Ribbon Tied to a Bell
backgroundDescription: A white ribbon stained beyond recognition by an unknown filth. A bell is pinned to the end of the delicate woven fabric, its chime guiding the blind girl through the darkness. "That familiar, crisp chime... Big Sis, are you back..."

name: Damaged Music Box
backgroundDescription: A small, handcrafted music box. Though kept under good care for many years, it has fallen into a state of disrepair. The melody produced by the wooden box was somewhat unsettling, nonetheless, it was cherished by the two girls, who relied on each other like sisters. "Welcome... home..."

name: Dark Fist Tournament Invitation Letter
backgroundDescription: A black envelope. A pitiful pin hangs on the spot where there should have been a fire lacquer seal. On the back is writing in large, crooked letters: "Invitation." \n\n"I see you're a chosen one..."

name: Package for Peak
backgroundDescription: A package not delivered by Wildfire in time. Peak is its intended recipient.

name: Package for Eunice
backgroundDescription: A package not delivered by Wildfire in time. The rapper Eunice is its intended recipient.

name: Package With Illegible Recipient
backgroundDescription: A package not delivered by Wildfire in time. Its intended recipient could be one of the patients in the clinic.

name: Wen Furui's Gift
backgroundDescription: Gaily wrapped gift. From the appearance, it can be seen that a lot of thought was spent on packaging this gift. \n\n"Giving disposable cutlery as a gift... You're implying that the recipient doesn't like to wash dishes."

name: Dazzling Golden Watch
backgroundDescription: A watch that was almost mistaken for a bomb. It was said that a person's prized accessories can reflect their taste to an extent.\n\n"So I offered up three mansions in exchange for his watch..."

name: A Bouquet of Ball Peonies
backgroundDescription: A bouquet of fresh Ball Peony blossoms. In floriography, it means "patience."

name: A Bunch of Rainbows
backgroundDescription: A bunch of tiny Rainbow blossoms. In floriography, it means "the beauty of the ordinary."

name: A Bouquet of First Snow
backgroundDescription: A bouquet of fresh First Snow blossoms. In floriography, it means "purity and kindness."

name: A Stalk of Marquise
backgroundDescription: A stalk of exquisite Marquise blossoms. It represents a status of prestige.

name: Gilbert's Message
backgroundDescription: A letter from the Restricted Zone Logistics Officer Gilbert to his daughter Lila in the Overworld.

name: Golden Badge
backgroundDescription: A badge representing justice. It might shed some light on this Disciple of Sanctus Medicus' social identity. If you flaunt it carelessly, you'll only invite unwanted ridicule to yourself.

name: Disciples of Sanctus Medicus Letter
backgroundDescription: A letter between the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. The correct words will only appear in the hands of the intended recipient.

name: Folded Photo
backgroundDescription: A family photo taken somewhere not on the Xianzhou Luofu. Evidently, this Disciple of Sanctus Medicus came from a different world. He came here either chasing the distant idea of immortality or to cure a disease. He has a bright smile in the photo, drastically different to how he looked when you met him on the street.\n\n"We'll take another family photo together on the seaside rocks when you're back..."

name: Strange Prescription
backgroundDescription: A medical prescription. The messy writing makes one question the sanity of the author.\n\n"5 mace of Daiyu angelica, 3 mace of Tian Dong, mixed into the... of Xianzhou natives who have reached 600 years of age."

name: Delivery Package
backgroundDescription: A standard package for delivery. It is tightly sealed and heading towards its recipient.

name: Weapon Shards
backgroundDescription: A polearm that was sliced in half. One can imagine the fate that befell its master.

name: Shattered Jade Seal
backgroundDescription: A token required to traverse across an important location. Looks like the process of acquiring this token was not very smooth.

name: Dud Grenade
backgroundDescription: A grenade with its pin pulled. It is silent, as though it might start growling at any moment.\n\n"A little gift for the lost..."

name: Language Module
backgroundDescription: A chip for regulating language mastery, especially for standard-issue Belobogian Automaton.

name: Luocha's Paper Flower
backgroundDescription: A piece of paper casually folded into a flower. The petals are delicate and life-like, and one wonders what kind of person would have bestowed such likenesses onto the paper.

name: A Note Between Book Pages
backgroundDescription: This seems to be a page torn from a Department of Insight researcher's notebook. It is full of obscure and difficult symbols and sentences. There are cute cat stickers on the back of the page — the owner was probably a cat lover.\n\n"For Department of Insight internal use only. Do not leak out this document."

name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — Table of Contents
backgroundDescription: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — Preface
backgroundDescription: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — "The Unexpected Parchment"
backgroundDescription: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — "The Missing Miner's Lamp"
backgroundDescription: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — "The Crates Are the Keys"
backgroundDescription: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — "Treasure Hunt on the Battlefield"
backgroundDescription: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — Postface
backgroundDescription: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

name: IPC Designer Invite
backgroundDescription: An invitation for joining the Interastral Peace Corporation as a designer. Enthusiastic, cordial, with an astonishing salary offer.\n\n"Congratulations, Designer Ryan. We warmly invite you to join the IPC Technology Department."

name: Artisanship Commission Standard Parts Set
backgroundDescription: Standard parts set from the Artisanship Commission used to assemble different aurumatons.\n\n"I've told you a hundred times before that we want to industrialize. In. Dus. Tri. Al. Ize!"

name: Chengjie's Paper Boat
backgroundDescription: This boat Chengjie folded out of paper is like a tiny starskiff. Meticulously made and cute.\n\n"Master, I've finally graduated!"

name: Perfect Geomarrow Crystal
backgroundDescription: A fist-sized geomarrow crystal, reflecting an indigo luster.\nThat supervisor Antonia probably knows how much it's worth.

name: <unbreak>80%</unbreak> New Thermal Mining Pickaxe
backgroundDescription: A thermal mining pickaxe for Underworld miners. Often on-sold.\n<unbreak>80%</unbreak> new.

name: <unbreak>60%</unbreak> New Thermal Mining Pickaxe
backgroundDescription: A thermal mining pickaxe for Underworld miners. Often on-sold.\n<unbreak>60%</unbreak> new.

name: Dazzling Rainbowite
backgroundDescription: Only the extremely lucky can get their hands on this crystal.\nIt doesn't look like it has any practical value, but it could be sold for a very good price.

name: Dirty Mechanical Part
backgroundDescription: A small part used for mechanical production. Smaller than a person's fist.\n"It is this small part that supports an avenger's moral cleanliness."

name: Old Tin Box
backgroundDescription: A rather artsy tin box sitting there silently like a book.\n"Please put this tin box on sale on the shelf on the second row to the right of Spare Time Book Shop's door..."

name: A Bottle of Draconic Tears
backgroundDescription: Mineral deposit formed by some kind of creature. Rumored to be pearls that solidified from drakons' tears, and is very popular among Outworlders who love such legends.\n"Drakons in the ancient sea, centuries long they may live. Tears shed dry into pearls, fat burns in lamps of old."

name: Transcribed Scripture
backgroundDescription: A Xianzhou-style scroll, on which Thousand-Handed Merciful Medicus' Salvation is written 500 times. Closer inspection reveals the last few hundred handwritings to be different from the first few hundred ones. Let's hope this doesn't get discovered.

name: Undelivered Letter
backgroundDescription: An unsent letter addressed home. The author seems to have undergone some experimental "treatment."

name: Mini-Neutron Bomb
backgroundDescription: A small nuclear weapon. Its countdown will begin automatically when it no longer detects the registrant's vital signs — In other words, you can't just throw it away.\n\n"Maybe we can chuck it in a lake somewhere..."

name: Access Code for the "Chest"
backgroundDescription: An access code provided by a weird person. Go to Starskiff Haven and give it to Ziqiao. Maybe you'll get a pleasant surprise.

name: Clothes for "That Teacher"
backgroundDescription: A silly teacher forgot to wear clothes when he left in the morning. Go give him these clothes.

name: Research Records "Trying to Persuade"
backgroundDescription: Everyone has a beating heart. Emotions are often more effective than logic when persuading someone.

name: Research Records "Pretend to Be an Officer"
backgroundDescription: The Realm-Keeping Commission require their officers to be upright, kind, just, industrious, and empathetic. Not many people in reality can tick all those boxes.

name: Research Records "Intimidating"
backgroundDescription: Ever seen a fist this big? It's all yours~

name: Research Records "Bribing"
backgroundDescription: Any problem you can solve with money isn't a problem. It's a shame money isn't omnipotent.

name: Research Records "Sincere Request"
backgroundDescription: Even those most skilled in lies and flattery often cannot resist the power of "sincerity."

name: Research Records "Title Page"
backgroundDescription: March 7th brandishes this imaginary title page and decisively declares, "The passphrase is maybe — probably — definitely written on it!"

name: Pharmacological Studies on the Draught of Draconic Surge
backgroundDescription: A research report on the Draught of Draconic Surge written by Dan Shu, the Alchemy Commission's genius chief alchemist. Hurry and pass this to the Seat of Divine Foresight.

name: A Medicine Concocted by Dan Shu
backgroundDescription: A medicine Dan Shu concocted for a young patient. Its sweet smell is probably deliberate, made to entice the child to take their medicine properly.

name: Brumedew Concentrate Pellet
backgroundDescription: Dan Shu said this medicine can invigorate the body and prolong one's life. She's the Alchemy Commission's chief alchemist and your close associate — You should be able to trust her and ingest this without issue.

name: Jade Tracer
backgroundDescription: The jade abacus accessory that Yanqing left behind while carrying out an operation. It records his activities, and was dropped at a timely moment to warn the Seat of Divine Foresight.

name: A Scribbled Prescription
backgroundDescription: Messy writing that only a doctor can read.\n\n"This prescription can save people, but those who take it will hiccup uncontrollably every single day!"

name: A Nameless Specialty
backgroundDescription: A package containing the gift for Banxia, wrapped in fabric and tied up with twine.\n\n"I know she's busy... I wanted to give this to her personally, but now I have to ask you to deliver it to her."

name: Ice-Fresh Raw Frostweave Salmon Slices
backgroundDescription: A row of ready-to-eat raw frostweave salmon slices. The meat is firm and smooth and looks very tasty.\n\n"It's all thanks to the Eternal Freeze. We can eat raw fish from 700 years ago!"

name: Mimic Snow Slugs
backgroundDescription: A mimic snow slug, one of the components of the local biome out on the Belobog Snow Plains. They can change their appearance to match the external environment and disguise themselves from their natural enemies. "These slugs taste really good once they've been barbecued over a fire..."

name: Geomarrow Activation Element
backgroundDescription: A universal component in Belobog used to activate Geomarrow conduits.\n\n"Bro, you need to ask the real smart people. No one knows how to fix a machine better than Marev."

name: Frostweave Salmon Bread
backgroundDescription: A cold platter made from air-fried preserved frostweave salmon and bread, with a bowl of redsunset jam for free. Nowadays, frostweave salmon are mostly bred inside Belobog's walls. Their taste is miles off from the frostweave salmons fished from the wilds outside the city. "I heard having raw fish slices together with bread can delay the onset of diarrhea effectively. Is that true?" "Heck if I know. Go ask Natasha."

name: Stone-Roasted Meat Skewer
backgroundDescription: The steel skewer has all sorts of Belobog delicacies on it, and is barbecued thoroughly using high heat. Its ingredients are mostly harmless. It is also the favorite food of Belobog's adventurers out in the wild, as well as being the most easily obtainable. "This tastes so good! What kinds of meat are in it, though?" "You wouldn't want to know."

name: Snow Plains Combo Stew
backgroundDescription: The iron bucket contains all sorts of Belobog delicacies as a stew, and is simmered thoroughly using low heat. Ingredients with outlandish appearances float in the soup, but it smells very delicious. "What's wrong if they were once specimens? Aren't they dead animals and plants anyways?"

name: Floppy disk with a picture of Pela and her mother
backgroundDescription: A digital data storage component that has been frozen for more than a decade. It looks very primitive. A young girl is being held by someone in the picture, but that someone's face is no longer distinguishable. "Did you hear about that outstanding outdoors explorer who died 16 years ago? The best explorer out of all Belobog..."

name: Meteor Fragment
backgroundDescription: A meteor fragment that bore witness to Belobog's <unbreak>700</unbreak> years of decline. It should be returned to the History and Culture Museum.

name: Microfilm
backgroundDescription: A lost roll of film. It should be returned to the History and Culture Museum.

name: Dismantled Art Pieces
backgroundDescription: Parts of the modern sculpture Gears and Wisdom that has been disassembled into countless tiny pieces. These parts have evidently been modified artistically and will not run as a machine.

name: Old Photo: Mechanism Energy Hub
backgroundDescription: An old photo revealing the location of the exhibit "Mechanism Energy Hub."

name: Treasure Map: Cannon
backgroundDescription: A treasure map revealing the location of the exhibit "Cannon."

name: Treasure Map: Information Terminal and Display Monitor Set
backgroundDescription: A treasure map revealing the location of the exhibit "Information Terminal and Display Monitor Set."

name: Qingni's Memories
backgroundDescription: Qingni remembered how affectionate her mother was, but she also remembered how stubborn and unreasonable her mother was when it came to "becoming a pilot."

name: Divine Arrow Embers
backgroundDescription: At the end of the Third Denizens of Abundance War, Reignbow Arbiter's Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow wiped out everything along the way. The Xianzhou people used the burning embers of the arrow to create many divine objects, and this is one of them. Yukong carries it with her, lest she forgets.\n\n"We were so happy then. I wish we could stay in those moments forever."

name: Jing Yuan's Memories
backgroundDescription: Jing Yuan still clearly remembers those two young pilots. They were optimistic, brave, and talented. But, he also remembers how it all ended.

name: Yukong's Exchange Diary
backgroundDescription: Yukong hopes to still be that carefree foxian girl, flying through the skies. But time will always pass by turbulently.

name: Caiyi's Exchange Diary
backgroundDescription: Caiyi hopes that her friend can take care of her daughter, and let her daughter be anything the child wants to be... Except a fighter pilot.

name: Compendium of Remedies
backgroundDescription: A Xianzhou medical compendium compiled by the Alchemy Commission. It includes prescriptions to many decoctions and have been listed in the Required Reading for New Recruits to the Alchemy Commission list.\n\n"Memorize these, you will be tested on them."

name: Eerie Twig
backgroundDescription: A branch that exudes an eerie aura, it is a rare ingredient in some prescriptions.\n\n"Does this... really have medicinal use?"

name: Lost and Found Notice
backgroundDescription: A lost and found notice for a missing ingenium.\n\n"I'm unsure of the exact time, but I lost a Baroumbrella ingenium that can write poetry near Synwood Pavilion in the Exalting Sanctum..."

name: Drifting Clouds
backgroundDescription: A collection of poems left by a Vidyadhara poet from the Xianzhou Luofu that contains 523 untitled poems, and the themes are almost all about extremely mundane things.\n\n"To those who love poetry: Whoever does not talk about this collection is shallow and ignorant."

name: Inspo Jade Abacus: Borderland
backgroundDescription: A Jade Abacus that stores machine learning data and codes. It is used to help Cong write poems.\n\n"They say 'Poetry cannot be about technology, as it is not romantic,' but technology can be romantic, right?"

name: Unity Lock
backgroundDescription: When Cong emerged from his hatching rebirth, he carried this Unity Lock with him.\n\n"If those who love each other are bound by the Unity Lock, they will be united forever."

name: Stainless Steel Plaque
backgroundDescription: In the middle of the reward plaque is written "Genius Diviner."\n\n"Your talent and knowledge are as solid as stainless steel."

name: Auspicious XV
backgroundDescription: A new generation flagship jade abacus, its off-white material feels exquisite to the touch.\n\n"Never buy an old jade abacus — they put out new models all the time."

name: Cloudbreadth Sleeves Limited Vertical Collar Jacket
backgroundDescription: The Nimbus Chronicles series women's cropped jacket with a stand-up collar launched by Cloudbreadth Sleeves is tailored using mid-length-fiber nylon-wool mixed fabric and pure silk.\n\n"The Cloudbreadth Sleeves clothes are delicate, ethereal, and expensive!"

name: Override Module
backgroundDescription: The computer module that Zhongshan handed to you. Adding it to those damaged automatons seems to be able to "resurrect them from the dead." Somehow, this module also has a solar panel attached to it.

name: Torn Manuscript Fragment
backgroundDescription: The torn manuscript contains faintly discernible notes on conjectures related to "Sensor No. <unbreak>223</unbreak>" and the "big universe time tunnel" theory.

name: A Mysterious Key
backgroundDescription: A slightly rusty key with no clear indication of which lock it corresponds to. Try it on all the locks you can until you find the right one!

name: Torn Manuscript Fragment
backgroundDescription: The torn manuscript contains faintly discernible notes on conjectures related to "Sensor No. <unbreak>223</unbreak>" and the "big universe time tunnel" theory.

name: A tuskpir wrap bought for Bailu
backgroundDescription: A cake roll that is too cute to eat. It gets its name from the beautiful patterns on the roll that resembles a tuskpir's fur. "This cake roll is so cute and looks like a tuskpir!" "It's actually made of tuskpirs." "???"

name: A songlotus cake bought for Bailu
backgroundDescription: A classic snack made from songlotus on the Luofu. Once you take a bite, it makes a crisp laughing sound. Occasionally, Luofu's gormandizers use it to tease outworlders. "You scared the life out of me!"

name: Berrypheasant skewers bought for Bailu
backgroundDescription: Berrypheasants live in symbiosis with plants, with many fruit hanging from their tail. Berrypheasant Skewers are actually fruit skewers. No Berrypheasants were harmed during the production process. "So... is this a meat dish or a vegetarian dish?"

name: Steamed puffergoat milk bought for Bailu
backgroundDescription: Puffergoat milk, also known as Gentle Halcyon milk, is a specialty of the Xianzhou Alliance. The milk is difficult to preserve and rarely seen outside Xianzhou. It is sweet after warming without needing extra sugar, but it becomes bitter after cooling, so it must be drunk while hot. "According to the Lifitide magazine, General Jing Yuan has to drink a large bowl of freshly-squeezed Puffergoat milk every morning. The Seat of Divine Foresight has denied this report."

name: Mung bean soda bought for Bailu
backgroundDescription: Made from fermented legume-based products. It smells sour and pungent, but tastes cool and refreshing. If you can drink a big bottle of mung bean soda and remain calm, you will definitely impress the gormandizers on the Luofu. "Like mung beans? Like soda? Then what are you complaining about!?"

name: Courier Package
backgroundDescription: A box containing the Golden Cloud Toad. The name and contact information of the sender were deliberately crossed out, but records from Heron Express show that the sender is A-Feng.

name: Payment Record for Exhibits
backgroundDescription: Dock Worker A-Feng's payment record. The record shows recently received credit remitted by the Interastral Peace Corporation, spaced out over several installments.

name: Dock Worker's Testimony
backgroundDescription: The testimony of dock worker A-Feng, who has admitted to disrupting the normal operations of the dock in exchange for payment from the IPC.

name: Rent for Aurum Alley Dock
backgroundDescription: The most tangible achievement of the Aurum Alley revival project. It demonstrates that the Alley still has plenty of life in it.

name: Dock Lease Contract
backgroundDescription: This contract can prove that the Merchant Guild has legitimate rights to operate the dock.

name: Aurum Alley Merchant Guild Turnover
backgroundDescription: The most tangible achievement of the Aurum Alley revival project. It demonstrates that the Alley still has plenty of life in it.

name: Artistry Hardware Sales Analysis
backgroundDescription: Since Artistry Hardware partnered with the dock, its scope of operations has expanded, and its revenue and customer satisfaction have both increased.

name: Aurum Alley Historical Trading Volume
backgroundDescription: It is evident that at its peak, the old Aurum Alley had a trading volume similar to what the Alley has today.

name: Aurum Alley Merchant Guild Bidding Deposit
backgroundDescription: The most tangible achievement of the Aurum Alley revival project. It demonstrates that the Alley still has plenty of life in it.

name: Spices Supreme Crossover Event
backgroundDescription: The Special Combo Set that Spices Supreme has produced serves to prove that the Alley is still a strong contender, and is highly competitive as a food street.

name: Aurum Alley Business Opinion Poll
backgroundDescription: Surveys conducted to gauge the shop owners' intentions. More and more shops have voiced their support for the guild and expressed their confidence in the revival project.

name: Guild Insignia Rubbing (I)
backgroundDescription: A rubbing put together at a particular angle, portraying the secret insignia left by Scholar Bernini, who was Todd's teacher. It seems to be hiding some important information.

backgroundDescription: A rubbing put together at a particular angle, portraying the secret insignia left by Scholar Bernini, who was Todd's teacher. It seems to be hiding some important information.

name: Life-Death Polypore

name: Whirlbolt Pneumatophore

name: Elixir of Dragon Oil
backgroundDescription: The miracle medicine Mr. Xiyan made up in the story. name: Growth Booster
backgroundDescription: A high-tech medicine used to nurture starskiff seeds in Mr. Xiyan's story. This thing may exist in reality — just not with the exaggerated effects. Using such wood to make sword hilts won't be the same as using wood straight off the Arbor, but it's more than enough to defeat one mere Lord Ravager." "Seriously?" "Who cares. Just say the lines!"

name: Treasure Map Indicating the Location of Ignis Aureliae
backgroundDescription: In Mr. Xiyan's story, this is a treasure map recording the location of the Ignis Aureliae. He therefore hid the Ignis Aureliae away from potential thieves before he was incarcerated." "There it is! The classic adventure story trope where a century-old treasure map just gets discovered out of nowhere!"

name: Todd's Snack
backgroundDescription: A snack that Todd wants to eat. It may be childish for a child, but is just right for an adult.

name: Hilt-Wood From the Arbor

This is still just a tree branch."

name: Ignis Aureliae
backgroundDescription: In Mr. Xiyan's story, this is the metal required to forge divine weapons. But in your eyes, this is probably something Mr. Xiyan dug out of a trashcan. "This looks like someone barbecued it. Is it really safe?" "It's special effects. I added special effects."

name: Evidence: Shamari's ID

name: Evidence: Giant Wooden Hammer
backgroundDescription: The giant wooden hammer Sparkle used to attack Shamari. It seems to be a custom-made model specifically for her. It is extremely heavy, and even Sampo can't lift it in one hand. What a herculean woman.

name: Evidence: Goldhammer Residence Security Regulations
backgroundDescription:
A copy of the Goldhammer Residence Security Regulations. Sparkle probably made it up on the spot just for this detective game. It says:
"To prevent criminals from hurting our great and lovely Miss Sparkle, the Goldhammer Residence shall abide by the following regulations from today onwards:
1. All retainers and visitors must enter and exit the Goldhammer Residence using the facial recognition system.
2. Those who cannot pass through the facial recognition system will be killed on the spot.
3. These regulations are in effect indefinitely."

name: Evidence: "Mutually Assured Destruction" Button
backgroundDescription: Apparently, one little press on this button will level all of Penacony. Who wouldn't want to try pressing it?

name: Evidence: Pom-Pom Toy
backgroundDescription: An exquisite Pom-Pom toy. Who knows why Sparkle would have something like this... Maybe it's truly because the Conductor's beauty is famous throughout the cosmos?

name: Evidence: Qian Ketong's Account Book
backgroundDescription: The account book of the rich merchant, Qian Ketong. For a merchant, it is probably something second-only in importance to money. Sparkle probably left it at the crime scene to prove that she really did assault someone.

name: Evidence: Lefton's Tie
backgroundDescription: A couture tie. The label says "For Master Lefton's Use Only."

name: Evidence: Wright's Stool
backgroundDescription: A small stool with two small footprints drawn on it using a crayon, indicating it once belonged to a Pepeshi worker. This is perhaps the most crude out of all the "evidence"... Miss Sparkle had fallen from her pedestal.

name: Evidence: Zhongshan's Ring
backgroundDescription: An expensive-looking ring. The words "Zhongshan's Heirloom" are carved on its side.

name: Evidence: Smoked Red Herring
backgroundDescription:
This "evidence" is obviously something comical Sparkle made. To avoid you thinking that you wasted time investigating this useless evidence, here's a recipe —
Smoke the red herring (or any other type of preserved fish) until it turns golden on both sides. Place it into a dish, remove all bones, then crush the meat. Add raw eggs into the frying pan and fry it until well done, then add vegetables you like and fry that too. Then, add in the crushed smoked red herring and day-old rice. Add some salt (be very careful with how much you put in! There's already preserved fish in it!), stir-fry evenly, then plate.
And voila! Here's a Smoked Red Herring Fried Rice.
You're welcome.

name: Longevity Pill of Cruelty
backgroundDescription: A medicine exclusive to the Xianzhou Yaoqing, said to have the effect of improving overall fitness and rendering those who take it immune to all diseases for a short period of time. On the Yaoqing, legend holds that a healer who went by the surname of Yu fell in love with a foxian trader girl. But the Vidyadhara could live for a thousand years, much longer than the foxians. Yu searched for ways to release his lover from the grip of death. He fell for the trickery of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus and asked his lover to take the longevity medicine of Abundance without telling her what it was. The foxian girl turned into an abomination that no longer loved him before being slain by the Cloud Knights. To prevent Yu, who was overwhelmed by grief, from becoming mara-struck, the Alchemy Commission ordered him to take the Longevity Pill of Cruelty that deprived him of love and desire until his demise. The legend has another version, in which Yu was not of the Vidyadhara but a mere mortal, and the foxian girl was a spy planted by the Disciples to infiltrate the Alchemy Commission. This version is not as popular, for it turns a romance story into a political power struggle. "Those who love and live deeply fall into mara, while those who sever desire and passions can live for a millennium. Ask yourself, then, why fear mara, and why take joy in a long life?"

name: Emotion Prototype: The Moment of Betrayal
backgroundDescription: You will always remember the trust and gentleness of that person, the persuasion and incitement from those people, and the surprised whisper from that person the moment you drew your dagger.\n\n"Et tu, my child?"

name: Emotion Prototype: The Cloud of Doubt
backgroundDescription: You sit up, a cloud of sadness forming in your mind. The words you have promised to others begin to falter. Are you really not a loser? Can you really achieve anything? Have you really chosen the right path?\nA fire ignites from the depths of your heart, and for one moment, tempting you to burn everything from the past to the ground.

name: Emotion Prototype: Everlasting Hatred
backgroundDescription: As you read this message, please consider the following advice: Send a message to your nemesis and tell them that you have forgiven them.\n\n"Our lives are too short to be wasted on feuds."

name: Emotion Prototype: Broken Dreams
backgroundDescription: Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony. They once belonged to broken hearts. "In the realm of black dreams I sleep, where distinctions of right or wrong are buried deep."

name: Emotion Prototype: Momentary Freedom
backgroundDescription: As the starship traverses the sky, leaving behind a trail of clouds, the IPC's pursuers disappear from sight. You exchange a high-five with your companions, feeling liberated from any constraints...\nThis is not the end. The looming threat of prison remains. It may be ten years or a hundred, but eventually, you will return to it. Until then, you can still savor a moment of freedom.

name: Unknown Jigsaw Fragment
backgroundDescription: This fragment appears to have been a part of a certain Dream Jigsaw.\nYou can feel from it a mixture of confusion, fear, grief, and an almost imperceptible determination to face death head-on.

name: Firefly's Budget
backgroundDescription: The meagre private funds of Firefly, a new artist of the Iris Family.\nUse it wisely. It's someone else's money, after all.

name: Cosmic Fried Rice (Overnight Edition)
backgroundDescription: The researchers' favorite work meal. It's not very fresh and not very clean. One wonders whether one will see the Aeons after eating it.

name: Abnormal images from surveillance records
backgroundDescription: Surveillance images provided by the security robot. It records the suspicious figure that recently approached the door security system.

name: External communication records
backgroundDescription: Data copied from the space station's terminal. It clearly and comprehensively records all external communication from the terminal.

name: Freshly-Baked Cake
backgroundDescription: Fresh and tasty cake. Probably dropped by some unfortunate researcher.

name: "Calm" Gear
backgroundDescription: A manifestation of the emotion "Calm" in the Dreamscape. It can be used to repair people's Emo Dial and recover their lost emotions or memories.

name: Half-Autographed Photo
backgroundDescription: Evidence that Lesley Dean once gained a new lease of life.\n\n"Not even death could extinguish his radiance."

name: Aventurine's Token
backgroundDescription: A token of the Interastral Peace Corporation. You remember the envoy played a little trick with it.

name: Utopon Unicycler
backgroundDescription: The luxury "Utopon" unicycler, inspired by wind instruments, boasts an elegant design and provides a safe riding experience without having to worry about traffic jams!\n\n"Transform every one of your trips into an unforgettable journey."

name: Envision a Rose Forthcoming
backgroundDescription: An old record tape discovered at the hotel in the Dreamscape, containing a single track titled "Envision a Rose Forthcoming."

name: Employees' Idle Chatter
backgroundDescription: Bocchi's co-workers seem to have a grudge against him because they are forced to work overtime. Feinman seems to have something to do with this.

name: TV News
backgroundDescription: A news article about a swindler being caught. I'm writing this down, although I don't know how Bocchi can be related to the case.

name: Project: Scarab
backgroundDescription: Bocchi's "Precious Proposal." You're uncertain whether it'll see any use.

name: Bizarre Tape
backgroundDescription: A weird voicetape. A terrifying nightmare.

name: Note: Searching for Mother in Dreamscape (I)
backgroundDescription: In the lobby of The Reverie, you encounter a father and daughter who seem to be searching for a long-lost relative in Penacony. Perhaps you will meet them again in Penacony's Dreamscape metropolis.

name: Note: Searching for Mother in Dreamscape (II)
backgroundDescription: The father and daughter, seeking their relative's whereabouts in Penacony, inquire about a woman named "Charlotte the Dream Artist." A helpful banker informs them that artists in Penacony often gather in a restricted area known as the "Edge." Perhaps that will be their next destination.

name: Note: Searching for Mother in Dreamscape (III)
backgroundDescription: Once more, you cross paths with the father and daughter at the Dream's Edge. They have yet to find Charlotte, however, they have discovered that Penacony's finest artists frequently assemble at The Reverie in the Dreamscape. Although the hotel in the Dreamscape is presently undergoing renovations, their determination remains unwavering as they plan to proceed there...

name: Note: Searching for Mother in Dreamscape (IV)
backgroundDescription: In the end, the father and daughter locate their long-lost wife and mother at the hotel in the Dreamscape. However, she refuses to reunite with her family. Following a heartrending conversation, the father and daughter leave the dream world in frustration, leaving you wondering if you will ever encounter them in reality...

name: Lucky One's Black Card
backgroundDescription:
The grand prize awarded by Dreamy Slots, but there are no instructions on how to use it.






...Well, for those who have read this far, it's unsightly to give you no hints. Let me tell you a secret: It's a room key.

name: Golden Limited - Aideen Token
backgroundDescription: This shiny gold token appears to hold great value and can potentially be exchanged for an incredible super jackpot, but nobody in the Golden Hour knows how to use it.\nNevertheless, remember the words: "Promising Future."

name: Medicine of Unknown Use
backgroundDescription: A mysterious medicine Screwllum handed to you. It may evoke the memories buried deep within Professor Chadwick's consciousness.

name: Eerie Building Block
backgroundDescription: This box contains eerie puzzle building blocks. It can be returned to the Dream Ticker Administrator.\nPuzzle blocks that make the Dream Tickers malfunction are sealed here, emitting an ominous aura.

name: Ace Gambler's Discarded Part
backgroundDescription: A part given to you by an Intellitron guest known as the "Ace Gambler." Its purpose remains a mystery.\n\n"Just carry it with you, even if as a talisman."

name: Ace Gambler's Precious Part
backgroundDescription: A part given to you by an Intellitron guest known as the "Ace Gambler." It is said to contain a miniature transmitter that manipulates the outcome of the capsule machine, but it is no longer functional.\n\n"Don't frown all day. Put a smile on that face!"

name: Soulheal Special Mix
backgroundDescription: A special beverage given to you by Giovanna the dream nurse. It helps to suppress negative emotions and assists people in engaging with their normal jobs and lives.

name: Components From a Certain Ruin
backgroundDescription: This is a part found in the ruins of the Pasdrak City Civic Center. Its original purpose is now impossible to discover. Swanga now carries this part with him at all times as a reminder to always recall the blood and tears of the revolutionaries.

name: Handwritten Letter
backgroundDescription: A delicately wrapped letter by Pom-Pom with a message expressing gratitude.\n\n"Thank you for the gift, passenger {NICKNAME}!"

name: Handwritten Letter
backgroundDescription: A delicately wrapped letter by Dan Heng with a message expressing gratitude.\n\n"Thank you for your gift. I like it."

name: Handwritten Letter
backgroundDescription: A delicately wrapped letter by Welt with a message expressing gratitude.\n\n"Thanks for the candy. I'll keep the rest for when we all come back to share."

name: Fate's Epistle
backgroundDescription: The parting gift from Black Swan. A tiny card numbered 'Zero,' seemingly absent from Black Swan's collection. In the card's art, she casts her gaze into the mist of destiny. "If one day you have unfortunately sunk into the Memory Zone's deep seas without a Memokeeper by yourself — it will guide you out on my behalf."

name: Invite Received by the Annihilation Gang
Gulliver's Arch
backgroundDescription: The entrance to the Dewlight Pavilion's Dreamscape Sandpit. Placing your hand through the small archway shrinks your body, and stepping out through the door in miniature state restores your original form. "The appearance of this thing reminds me of a tunnel that could shrink people with a single pass..." "If I were you, I would immediately shut your mouth. Don't say things that are not meant to be said."

name: Pinball Machine Model
backgroundDescription: Pinball Machine Model. A miniature version of the Soulglad Candyball launcher found throughout the Sweetdream Paradise. "What would happen if I put a candyball into Soulglad?" "You can give it a try, but when the Bloodhound Family interrogates you, remember not to involve me in it."

name: Aventurine's Cornerstone
backgroundDescription: The cornerstone that only belongs to you. The Ten Stonehearts must cut their Cornerstone with their own will, allowing it to radiate its unique brilliance. Though shattered, the divine corpus of Qlipoth still shines for you. "All or nothing, it shall be."

name: Aventurine's Baggage
backgroundDescription: A baggage that only belongs to you. Filled with precious gems, it also serves as a tool for your tricky and elaborate magic trick. "Believing that you can trade these base and tacky jewels for everything — That's what gamblers excel at, isn't it?"

backgroundDescription: A most exquisite scroll, holding a doctor's prescription within. Dr. Ratio advises you to only unveil it in a moment of life or death. "You look distressed. Is something troubling you? If so, you can figure it out yourself."

backgroundDescription: The spirit of freedom will spread far and wide among the stars, and its legacy will be more timeless than a pastoral song.

name: Lost Property
backgroundDescription: A notebook lost by someone — its corners are yellowed and the majority of the notes within have been rendered incomprehensible by some kind of red rust-like stains.

name: Big Ticker's Broken Heart (I)
backgroundDescription: A single part of a lost heart that has fallen into an existential crisis.\n\n"They said that the Dreamscape Ticker isn't the same as Clockie at all, just a scrapped early Clockie prototype..."

name: Big Ticker's Broken Heart (II)
backgroundDescription: A single part of a lost heart that has fallen into an existential crisis.\n\n"Please... just leave me be, Clockie. I just don't know how to face you... because I'm just a failed product."

name: Big Ticker's Broken Heart (III)
backgroundDescription: A single part of a lost heart that has fallen into an existential crisis.\n\n"I... I'll never be qualified to be the real you. Just give up, Clockie!"

name: Television (Limited Edition)
backgroundDescription: Made locally in Penacony, this television appears ordinary but is actually a commemorative TV set for Lil' Brother Hanu, allowing users to transform into Brother Hanu at any time and relive that wonderful adventure story.\n\n"Wishing you have fun, and may you never forget the deeds of Hanunue."

name: Symbol of Fortune
backgroundDescription: A seemingly ordinary Aideen Token that contains the luck that Aventurine wishes to pass to you.\n\n"Using this coin, I won the capsule machine's grand prize seven times in a row. Hopefully, it can bring you good luck as well. — Aventurine"

name: Astral Express Miniature (Limited Edition)
backgroundDescription: A miniature model based on the current Astral Express. A very expensive limited edition item paid for by Aventurine himself.\n\n"Here's a small token of congratulations to the Astral Express for obtaining the Radiant Feldspar — Aventurine"

name: Page of Past Dreams
backgroundDescription: A boy's graffiti. The strokes are immature, yet time has not worn down the imagery of old dreams even a bit.\nHis faithful companion has put in a lot of effort for this.

name: Hex Pass
backgroundDescription: A premium gaming subscription service newly released by the Hex Club. Designed by Think-Tank, players can challenge "Hexanexus: Remake" and obtain rewards from various tiers.\n\n"Listen up. This is what sunk cost looks like."

name: An Elder's Note
backgroundDescription: A mysterious note that seems to contain an encryption key and some ciphers.\n\n"The Ten-Lords Commission knows what these documents mean, of course. They just don't know where the contents will be used."

name: Denisovan Slumbernana Pendant
backgroundDescription: A pendant decorated with a Slumbernana Monkey trinket, serving as a promotional reward for "Denisovan" level members. Proud members flaunt it on their phones, fanny packs, necks, or even faces.\n"Oh, by the way, 'Human' level members can accumulate pendant shards from the daily quiz and class attendance."

name: Slumbernana Association Membership Card (Golden Slumbernana)
backgroundDescription: This card has a golden slumbernana printed on it, signifying official membership of the Slumbernana Association. Whoever holds this card will be seen as a friend of all Slumbernana Monkey fans.\n"Rumor has it that only 0.6% of membership cards have a jadegreen banana printed on it, but members who have recruited over 90 fresh monkeys for the Association will always get that rare card."

name: Memory-Peeking Film
backgroundDescription: An enigmatic film reel given to you by Mr. Reca. The eye attached to it casts an unsettling and penetrating gaze, emanating a powerful obsession toward witnessing something. Entering another's Emoscape using this item allows you to capture the memories you have witnessed as audiovisual records.\n"Memories are movies without a montage, while movies are memories that have been edited. The former is raw material, and the latter is art refined from it. Regrettably, most of my colleagues fixate on the former, and are unable to create the latter..."

name: Luofu Sports Illustrated — Special Edition for Luka's Final
backgroundDescription: The special edition of Luofu Sports Illustrated, reporting on Luka's participation in the "Ringmaster's Challenge."\n\n"Swinging the next hit is always what's most important!"

name: SoulGlad Bottle Cap
backgroundDescription: A bottle cap, purchased from the Dreamjolt Troupe for a high price. The fact remains that bottle caps are valuable even outside of nuclear wastelands.

name: Slumbernana Monkey Pre-Order Special Freebie
backgroundDescription: A special freebie for pre-ordering Slumbernana Monkey dolls, showcasing sub-par quality.
