backgroundDescription: A painting from the Rosy Celestial Maiden series, released by an opportunistic art dealer. You can't help but chuckle upon seeing March 7th's dashing form as she fights in this painting.\n\n"Street stall art can never go out of style."

name: Old Kremnos Festival Photo
backgroundDescription: An old photograph of the Kremnos Festival, taken by Damionis. Though slightly blurred, it still faintly captures the grand scale of the festival.

name: Small Amount of Redsoil Feed
backgroundDescription: Exceptionally pure redsoil feed, crafted with the ideal wet-to-dry ratio. It's the absolute favorite treat of dromases.

name: Mystical Blacksoil
backgroundDescription: An essential sacrificial item for a mysterious ritual. It's somewhat clotted.

name: Mystical Seeds
backgroundDescription: An essential sacrificial item for a mysterious ritual. It looks slightly dried up.

name: Mystical Philter
backgroundDescription: An essential sacrificial item for a mysterious ritual. It smells a little sour.

name: Scroll of Mysterious Rites
backgroundDescription: A tattered scroll detailing the steps of an ancient, mysterious ritual, with annotations from an unknown person.\n\n"Who knows what this might summon..."

name: Scroll of Mysterious Rites
backgroundDescription: A tattered scroll detailing the steps of an ancient, mysterious ritual, with annotations from an unknown person.\n\n"Who knows what this might summon..."

name: Mysterious Gift (L)
backgroundDescription: A mysterious gift hidden behind the door, looking very valuable. What could it be?

name: Mysterious Gift (S)
backgroundDescription: A mysterious gift hidden behind the door, looking somewhat plain in appearance. What could it be?

name: Slate
backgroundDescription: A slate that is hidden by Possephone within the cushion. Its contents appear to reveal why Hadez acted against her.

name: Teleslate
backgroundDescription: A teleslate belonging to Possephone. From the memory you observed, it seems there was a glimmer of hope that Possephone could have escaped from Hadez.

name: Scroll
backgroundDescription: A tattered and torn scroll. Based on the memory you observed, it is a replica of the one Rhadaman used to trap the married couple.

name: Janus Priest's Talisman
backgroundDescription: A stone seal that symbolizes one's identity as a priest of Janus. It can resound with and open the Gate of Infinity.

name: Seal Slammers Photo Slate
description: Use from your Inventory to view the group photo.
backgroundDescription: A photo slate Apophis took of you after winning the Seal Slammers championship. The contestants were specially invited to appear in the photo, and the champion takes center stage. "Dan Heng, let me wear the seal sunglasses for a while~" "...You already have a trophy."

name: Seal Slammers Photo Slate
description: Use from your Inventory to view the group photo.
backgroundDescription: A photo slate Apophis took of you after winning the Seal Slammers championship. The contestants were specially invited to appear in the photo, and the champion takes center stage. "Dan Heng, let me wear the seal sunglasses for a while~" "...You already have a trophy."

name: Nicomachus' Work Permit
backgroundDescription: A bloodied Grove of Epiphany work permit with the name "Nicomachus."

name: Andreas' Work Permit
backgroundDescription: A damaged Grove of Epiphany work permit with the name "Andreas."

name: Clio's Work Permit
backgroundDescription: A Grove of Epiphany work permit wrinkled with sweat with the name "Clio."

name: Clio's Experimental Crop
backgroundDescription: A grain that is quite ordinary in realms beyond the sky but uncommon in Amphoreus. The label on the specimen indicates it is the 330th generation of an experiment — perhaps the experiment has been ongoing for centuries. "During the breeding process, the crop's resistance to the black tide has significantly improved. The next step will attempt to enable the crops to absorb energy from the black tide and survive in lightless environments, challenging the conventional belief that no life can endure within the black tide."

name: Nicomachus' Notebook
backgroundDescription: A seemingly unremarkable scroll filled with various equations and symbols, so complex that even the Synesthesia Beacon struggles to provide a reliable translation. "Self-reference is the most challenging problem — it not only strips mathematics of its completeness but also renders our souls enigmatic within the logical system." "This equation should hold true. I have an excellent proof... but alas, the space here is too tiny for it."

name: Andreas' Ceremonial Medicine Enhancer
backgroundDescription: It is said that this somewhat hazardous-looking powder helps participants in Titan-worship ceremonies attune their consciousness to the thoughts of the Titans. "So, what exactly is it made of?" "An unrefined plant-based sugar." "Huh? So eating it just means eating sugar?" "Yes. The ceremonies are quite lengthy, and fasting participants often struggle to endure due to low blood sugar." "..."

name: Artakama's Sword
backgroundDescription: The sword once wielded by Artakama, a Chrysos Heir scholar of the Grove. In the dire battle against the black tide, this sword stood steadfast by its master until her final breath. Following Artakama's demise, her younger sister, Cynane, picked up the sword and continued the fight until the ceaseless swarms of monsters devoured everything living.

name: Dew of Divine Blood
backgroundDescription: A rare Amphorean fine wine. It is said to be brewed from crops nourished by the divine blood of each Titan.\nThis particular bottle originates from the Chrysalis of Gold, Mnestia of Romance.

name: Weft
backgroundDescription: A golden spindle that belongs to "Goldweaver" Aglaea. A legendary treasure.\n\n"Follow the golden thread, the love that contains all like the gods."

name: "Work Champion" Medal
backgroundDescription: A memorial medal issued by the Garden of Life to reward the sweat and tears shed by Chimera Squad that took the crown.\n\n"To the most diligent chimera. We hope to see growth and improvement in your future work!"

name: Coreflame of Time
backgroundDescription: The fallen soul of Oronyx the Time Titan. The Coreflame urgently awaits to return to its place, and its demigod will assume the authority of the vacant station after completing the trial.

name: Nether Butterfly's Pondering
backgroundDescription: A handcrafted silver ring — if you hold it to your ear, you can hear the sound of melting snow. In Aidonia, the departed seal ice and snow into a ring before their final journey, offering it to the living as a token to walk the rest of the path in their stead. "When the ice melts and the snow fades, the flowers will bloom, and you will find me."

name: Letter from the Phantom Thief Cipher
backgroundDescription: A phantom thief's letter left behind by Kitty Phantom Thief, Cipher, out of "courtesy" and "honor."\n\n"I fear it would attract tasteless little thieves, so I shall safeguard it for now."

name: Cipher's Coin
backgroundDescription: A coin left behind by Kitty Phantom Thief, Cipher, out of "courtesy" and "honor."\n\n"Naturally, I've left appropriate payment — a single coin."

name: Trianne's Hand-Drawn Picture
backgroundDescription: Trianne secretly prepared a small gift for Castorice — a childlike drawing of the companions on their Flame-Chase Journey. Castorice perceptively noticed that it, and the memory it represents, would be the key to saving {NICKNAME} from the nether realm. "But Little Cas no longer has anything to fear now, because everyone is here with you in this Flame-Chase Journey!"

name: Coreflame of Death
backgroundDescription: The fallen soul of Thanatos the Death Titan. The Coreflame urgently awaits to return to its place. The demigod of Death has already overcome the trial and assumed the authority of the Titan.

name: Outlander King of Knights Puppet
backgroundDescription: The memory entity you carried away from a dream, in some foreign land, an artisan who admired the King and carved a puppet with heartfelt reverence. Though it seems far removed from the real King, and the craftsmanship leaves much to be desired, what heroes pass down to later generations is often just like this — crude, yet enough to soothe the soul. "Besides, don't you think that, after staring at it for a while, it actually kind of feels full of soul?" "I think it's trying to suck my soul in!"

name: Tarnished Glory
backgroundDescription: An old, tattered photograph captures the past of Miss Note — the cries of injustice behind bars, the jubilant song upon breaking free, the thunderous applause beneath the stage, the scorn born of disgrace. All those voices have faded into history, leaving only a yellowed memory behind.\n\n"And even so, I still choose to sing."

name: Chronocognitive Anchor
backgroundDescription: A Curio and Space Anchor from the world of Erudition that protects your individual data structure from the influences of digital tsunamis.\nWhen necessary, it can also serve as a bridge for communications between the internal and external world.

name: "Take the Feast to Tomorrow"
backgroundDescription: It was a distant wish, and also her blessing.

name: "Golden Dew"
backgroundDescription: Rich, intense, sweet.\n\nNot exactly sweet, but the contrast is obvious.

name: "Scarlet Honey Brew"
backgroundDescription: The bottle contains the heroic souls of pomegranates who fought to their last breath. Drink it, and honor their journey.

name: "Colorful Gate"
backgroundDescription: You can taste all the Amphorean fruits in this! Zero intoxication level, totally safe and worry-free!

name: "Dark River of Souls"
backgroundDescription: Don't worry. It just looks like water from the River of Souls... probably.

name: "To Dromas"
backgroundDescription: Thoughts flowed like a fountain. By the time the pen stopped, only half a bottle of honey brew remained.

name: "Cloud Brew"
backgroundDescription: Harvesting grape clouds at the intersection of Evernight for extraction and bottling... mysterious purple-tinted... plain drinking water.

name: "Rough-Brew Ambrosia!"
backgroundDescription: The kitty doesn't want to think about why this bottle of ambrosia has an exclamation mark in its name, and honestly, she has no clue either.

name: "Scorching Like Fire in My Memories"
backgroundDescription: The taste hits you like a punch to the face. Might be just what you need for healing wounds.

name: "The Deep Sea"
backgroundDescription: Tides rise and fall, but the sound of waves remains eternal.

name: "Have Mercy, Okhema"
backgroundDescription: Despite the oddly saccharine naming sense, the complimentary drinks in the Marmoreal Palace guest rooms taste just ordinarily sweet.

name: Flame-Chase Medallion
backgroundDescription: An identification badge of the Flame-Chase Army, bearing the Imperator's highest command. The wearer has unrestricted access throughout the city.

name: Hysilens's Ceramic Cup
backgroundDescription: An unassuming ceramic cup, plain in craftsmanship. At that wanton feast, its cold rim passed her honey brew to your lips, branding you with the sin of exile, yet bestowing a dream of clarity in return.\n\n"The worth of a vessel lies in what it once held, and who once held it, just as blades earn legend by battle, and heroes are remembered through sacrifice."

name: Dew of Divine Blood
backgroundDescription: Phagousa was said to have buried twelve bottles of fine vintage beneath the seabed, hoping to savor them a thousand years later. But even as the black tide silenced the song of Chalice of Plenty, not a single drop had been uncorked.\n\nThis bottle, sweetest of the twelve vintages, was brought ashore by the last surviving sea siren. The divine power it holds can pierce through any fog.

name: Coreflame of Worldbearing
backgroundDescription: The Worldbearing Titan, Kephale's fallen soul. Yet seemingly some foreign force has tampered with them, making their divinity different from the one in the past Cycle. The Coreflame awaits its rightful return, through which the final Deliverer shall forge a new Era Nova.

name: Dream's Curtain Call
backgroundDescription: A photo taken at an unknown time, but the reality of its touch is undeniable. In the past, this scene truly came to pass, leaving behind a proof of its transpiration. Though few are aware, a young girl will smile when she recalls a beautiful dream she once had. The dreamer is also the dream-maker. The dream-maker is also the dreamer. Only by offering up one's past can the most beautiful dreams be woven. People will not lose themselves within them, unwilling to awaken. In their beautiful dreams, they will regain the courage to face the future. And then, walk toward tomorrow.

name: Dream's Curtain Call
backgroundDescription: You decide how memories are ultimately presented. When that beautiful dream ended, you immortalized Firefly in the way she longed for. The dreamer is also the dream-maker. The dream-maker is also the dreamer. Only by offering up one's past can the most beautiful dreams be woven. People will not lose themselves within them, unwilling to awaken. In their beautiful dreams, they will regain the courage to face the future. And then, walk toward tomorrow.

name: Imperial Ring of Strife
backgroundDescription: From the "Champion of Strife": Mydei's bestowal, symbolizing both his glory and restraint as a ruler and protector.

name: Trickery Coin
backgroundDescription: From the "Trickery's Traveler": Cipher's bestowal, symbolizing her playful yet sincere blessings and desires.

name: Winter Blossom of Death
backgroundDescription: From the "Servant of the Afterlife": Castorice's bestowal, symbolizing the tenacity and peace she watches over on the other side.

name: Passage Plushie
backgroundDescription: From the "Holy Child of Passage": Tribios's bestowal, symbolizing her unwavering faith and empathy throughout her journey in a thousand bodies.

name: Bracelet of Romance
backgroundDescription: From the "Weaver of Romance": Aglaea's bestowal, symbolizing her unchanging selflessness and temperance beneath her aloof perfection.

name: Skybound Spirit Kist
backgroundDescription: From the "Healer of the Sky": Hyacine's bestowal, symbolizing her gentle devotion and indiscriminate love for all of humanity.

name: Jade of Reason
backgroundDescription: From the "Scholar of Reason": Anaxa's bestowal, symbolizing the enlightenment and critique he calmly left for future generations.

name: Wish of Worldbearing
backgroundDescription: To save the world, one must shoulder the burden of heavy wishes. Only by leaving it behind, can you absolve the obsession.

name: Despair of Worldbearing
backgroundDescription: To save the world, one must be accompanied by searing despair. Only by shattering it, can you absolve the obsession.

name: Trailblazemon's Paw (Right)
backgroundDescription:
It was the New Year of the old calendar. That year, times were tough. The foxes couldn't afford to throw their feasts, the frogs didn't dare to sing, the monkeys stopped discussing flight, and the white rabbits hadn't passed through in ages.

But then it arrived.

A black rabbit.

Unlike those rabbits who couldn't care less about the moon, this one led its companions and gave the little animals here a hand.

...Ah, I should say, gave them a paw.

name: Trailblazemon's Round Foot (Left)
backgroundDescription:
The black rabbit brought along many friends: some look human, while others look quite strange.

They aren't quite as level-headed as the black rabbit. Heated arguments are just part of their daily routine.

But when a foe appears, they immediately cast aside their differences and fight with total trust, following even the most questionable orders.

As they say, good people must stick together. Friends won't always see eye to eye, but they'll always help each other live a better life.

name: Trailblazemon's Paw (Left)
backgroundDescription:
The foxes' prophecy came to pass. The flames of destruction ignited in the borderlands, sweeping all the way to the center of the world.

Many of the black rabbit's friends were sacrificed on the battlefield.

The frogs and monkeys were overcome with guilt, and no one was willing to sing at night anymore.

...But the black rabbit reached out its hand once again.

It said: "Stand up. You are worthy of singing your hearts out."

name: "Blue Guardian" Trophy
backgroundDescription: The Phantasmoon New Game trophy will be awarded to every hero who offered their Wishpower to protect the Blue Planet!\n\n"A joyful ending like this is exactly what readers who celebrate life deserve!"

name: Ashveil's Detective Notes
backgroundDescription: Ashveil's Detective Notes

name: Setting Sail Among the Stars Picture Book
backgroundDescription: When we were kids, we all had countless "dreams." They didn't need to promise a hefty paycheck, nor were they bound by the cramped realities of life. They could be completely unreasonable, or entirely nonsensical... They were bold and fiery. They were the future we dared to proclaim to the world, hands planted firmly on our hips. As time passed, we all more or less parted ways with those first "dreams." We realized we lacked the talent, discovered that the reality of those dreams wasn't all that great, or learned that the weight of everyday life keeps us from reaching the stars. We might complain, we might harbor regrets, and we might grieve. But no one ever regrets having had a "dream" during those tender, beautiful days of childhood — a dream that forever encouraged them to set sail. This is the true meaning of a dream. And this is exactly why we must always safeguard a child's right to dream. "Open this picture book. Take a look at the future these children are so eager to leap into. May you find your younger self within these pages."

They could be completely unreasonable, or entirely nonsensical... They were bold and fiery. They were the future we dared to proclaim to the world, hands planted firmly on our hips. As time passed, we all more or less parted ways with those first "dreams." We realized we lacked the talent, discovered that the reality of those dreams wasn't all that great, or learned that the weight of everyday life keeps us from reaching the stars. We might complain, we might harbor regrets, and we might grieve. But no one ever regrets having had a "dream" during those tender, beautiful days of childhood — a dream that forever encouraged them to set sail. This is the true meaning of a dream. And this is exactly why we must always safeguard a child's right to dream. "Open this picture book. Take a look at the future these children are so eager to leap into. May you find your younger self within these pages."

name: Recipe: Classic SoulGlad
backgroundDescription: When it comes to SoulGlad, classic means the best. Despite three attempts to modify the formula, the SoulGlad company was compelled to return to the original recipe due to complaints from dissatisfied customers each time.\n\n"Our double-blind tests show that over 70% of customers failed to discern the difference between the new formula and the original one."

name: Recipe: Bright Future
backgroundDescription: "One day, we will have a real house." With a cup of coffee in her hand, your wife says. "It will have a yard where we can grow flowers, a hall where we can dance, a transparent attic where we can gaze at the stars — and ideally, a small dog to cuddle and fall asleep with. That would truly be the truly blissful life." You smile in silence and propose a toast. The warm vapor swirls and ascends, gently caressing the ceiling before dissipating. "A bright future exists only in dreams."

name: Recipe: Daring Wager
backgroundDescription: The poker game continued, reaching the fourth round. The man could not stop himself from checking his hand — his confidence had long since wavered. "A true gambler won't hesitate to call, even if the chances of winning are impossibly small..." The young man on the opposite side of the table snickered, pushing all his chips forward. "All in." "Being content is a virtue for mortals, whereas hesitation is a fatal flaw for gamblers."

name: Recipe: Pika White Grape Soda
backgroundDescription: This soda made of fermented white grapes tastes both sour and bitter. It serves as an exceptionally revitalizing remedy for summer heat, and consuming it often results in sneezing and a runny nose. According to those who have tasted it, it feels like a cold hand pressed against your neck.\n\n"Pika... Ah-choo...!"

name: Recipe: Eternal Endurance

Developing a new poison formula proved to be much more challenging than anticipated. If he couldn't produce results by tomorrow... His mind was overwhelmed with worry, leading him to knock over the test tube rack on the table. The liquids from two unidentified containers mixed, releasing a pungent odor... "The 106,002nd attempt. Result: Successful."

name: Floatdisc Burger
backgroundDescription: This burger earns its name from the crunchy disc-shaped flaky chip nestled between the buns, and only a few individuals can consume it in a dignified way. In certain taverns, devouring a Floatdisc Burger without using your hands has become somewhat of a legendary challenge.\n\n"Why is it that some Halovians always find fault with its appearance?"

name: Clockie Pizza (Whole)
backgroundDescription: Resembling a clock, this pizza is precisely divided into twelve equal-sized slices, making it the perfect food for parties.\n\n"What is the meaning behind the unique shape of this food? Some believe it pays homage to a mysterious wealthy individual, while others see it as a reminder to cherish each passing moment."

name: Potato Fries Sundae
backgroundDescription: Strictly, the Potato Fries Sundae is not merely a food but a unique culinary experience that can only be realized within a dream world. In this realm, potato fries never go soft because of cooling down, and the ice cream never melts because of warming up. Cold and heat achieve perfect harmony here.\n\n"Finally, no more upset stomachs."

name: Oak Cake Rolls
backgroundDescription: Legend has it that poor inhabitants of border planets would add wood chips to their bread to satiate their hunger. Over time, this practice evolved into a peculiar tradition among aristocrats, symbolizing a "reverence" for the humble past. This product features a variety of botanical additives, closely resembling an oak branch in terms of both appearance and composition, and only the most ambitious and determined individuals can consume it. "Politicians from the Oak Family take pride in eating it without flinching, for they believe it to be a formidable feat."

backgroundDescription: Page after page of dense legalese that'll put anyone to sleep just looking at it. Whatever, the money's already in hand, so nothing too crazy should pop up down the line... right? ...Right?

name: Star Rail FEST Fan Glowstick
backgroundDescription: From the Nameless who bridge the stars to the cute critters of The Fluffy and the heroes who saved the universe... they've gathered here for you, waving their glowsticks with hope and cheer.\n\n"In this vast universe, there are always people rooting for you. Never forget that, no matter where you go."

name: Trope-y Toast Slice
backgroundDescription:
A slice of bread that's the perfect type, shape, size, and flavor to recreate that classic gag. Just pop it in your mouth and run through an intersection to trigger a dramatic encounter—it's practically a law of the universe.

"So that's your excuse for running into me!?"
"I said I was sorry, okay!?"

name: King Pom-Pom: Alloy Armor <unbreak>999</unbreak>
backgroundDescription: The original prototype for the King Pom-Pom figure. In Fluffy Across the Blue, it's a powerhouse that puts most of the Nameless to shame. It comes with a full suite of cleaning, laundry, and sanitizing systems, making it more than a match for 99% of the universe's housework.\n\n"Pom-Pom is actually starting to feel a little threatened!"

name: Furbobo Weekly Badge
backgroundDescription: A Furbobo Weekly badge featuring artwork personally drawn by a famous comic artist, commemorating the Furbobo Weekly pop-up shop's victory as champion of Seafeld City's commercial district.\n\n"Aww, these teary-eyed little furbos are the cutest, don't you think?"

name: Solid Water
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry. "...Isn't it ice?" "No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state." "...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

name: Basic Ingredients
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal. Not particularly good, but is edible. "Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"

name: Phlogiston
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Particles that form the flame. Genius Society #2 Harald Punch proved its existence, but #3 Nyul Iman disproved it. #7 Bohdan overthrew Iman's conclusion and proved it again before getting killed by #4 Polka Kakamond days after announcing Phlogiston's existence. "Does it exist or not? We're not interested, frankly speaking."

name: Metal
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: A substance abundant in planets' crust and the ocean. Very useful, very handy. "I've been to a planet where the locals consume metals to get superpowers. Please don't do that at home, as most metals are not digestible by humans."

name: Gaseous Liquid
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Is it fog, rain, or wind? You can't tell if it's still in the container without lifting the lid. "The answer my friend, is blowing in the gaseous liquid..." "The answer is blowing in the gaseous liquid."

name: Seed
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Reproductive units unique to plants. Most of them symbolize life, and some of them taste pretty good. "Sow one in the spring, harvest a thousand in the autumn."

name: Discarded Ingenium Parts
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: To a bystander, it's just trash. To a craftsman, it's leftover materials. To a recycler, it's credits. Only skilled artisans who truly understand the art of ingenia can see valuable treasures in what others deem wasteful.\n\n"It is said that in the Great Trial of the Furnace, to challenge Mr. Yingxing, they gave him a pile of defective products and waste. But after a day and night, he crafted a lifelike mechanical lion that moved as if it was alive."

name: Human-Height Auspicious Crops
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: The robust and bountiful rice ears are astonishingly as tall as a person. In certain agricultural and pastoral delves of Xianzhou, such towering auspicious crops can be found everywhere.\n\n"The scholars who planted them hoped that people would never have to experience the feeling of hunger again."

name: Tranquility
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: After a long day of work or school, you savagely dive onto your bed on a Friday night, ready to hide there for the next two days.\n\n"Turn off your cell phone, and if anyone asks on Monday why they couldn't reach you, just say your cell phone ran away from home, and you just managed to talk it into coming back."

name: Broken Dreams
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony. They once belonged to broken hearts. "In the realm of black dreams I sleep, where distinctions of right or wrong are buried deep."

name: Rusty Gear
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Gears themselves are not rare, but finding gears that meet the specifications is no easy task. With rapid advancements in technology, these outdated parts are being discarded in large quantities.\n\n"The best gear is always the one that fits perfectly."

name: Distinctive Tattered Feather
description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: A feather adorned with the Titan Aquila's symbol, often found on cliff faces near the heavens. Some believe these are ciliary feathers shed by Aquila, the hundred-eyed giant bird, while others think they are remnants of birds of prey that soared too high, caught in Aquila's gaze, and met their demise. In ancient times, Aquila's disciples collected these feathers in bulk, using them to craft the ceremonial priestly miter. Notably, the Titan symbol on the feathers fades if left exposed to the night air for too long. "If my love for you could be measured... it would surpass the number of Aquila's eyelashes!" "...Though, now that I think about it, does the hundred-eyed giant bird even have eyelashes?"

name: Mechanical Parts
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Essential components of all machines with strange shapes and specific functions. Without them, nothing can be made. "With the same parts, Screwllum can make entire planets and create cyborgs. But you can only make me a watch that runs seven seconds late every day." "Seven seconds is good enough! Just a hair later than the clocks they use in observatories."

name: Virtual Particle
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Tiny particles commonly found in the universe but cannot be observed in theory. Scientists are good at transforming theories into reality. "I've got a virtual particle and an anti virtual particle here. How do we turn them into a real particle and a real antiparticle? Now, look closely..."

name: Protein Rice
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Nature's gift to human society, friend of mankind, savior of lives. Smooth as egg white and full of protein. "Every grain costs sweat and blood."

name: Feather of Flame
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Warm dark feather with a weak ember at its tip. Sparks trail the feather as it's waved around. "The legend of the Phoenix spreads far throughout the entire universe..."

name: Core of Ice
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Shattered ice fallen from the stars. The frosty mist it emits when removed from a specialized canister looks like the breath of wintertime. "Zoom in on a snowflake 100 times and behold the wonder of nature."

name: Eye of Lightning
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: An electric ball made from captured lightning. If its balance is tipped by a conductor, it emits a lightning ball. "A genius in the past wanted to use Eye of Lightning to search for aliens. For this, Nous cast their gaze upon her. Not sure which is the bigger win: Found aliens for real or got noticed by Nous?"

name: Vortex of Wind
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: The eye of the storm remains stagnant. Even when put in vacuum, the grains involved in the vortex continue to revolve around the eye of the storm. "Look, they won't stop no matter what happens. They just keep whirling. You know what that reminds me of?" "Trailblazing!" "...That's right, Pom-Pom. Promise me that our trailblazing journey will never come to a stop."

name: Quantum Ripples
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Ripples in the Sea of Quanta. Although called "ripples," they are in fact the most basic form of energy fluctuation. "Time, there's so much time." "All the time there is."

name: Leaf of Imaginary
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: A leaf of unknown origin. It doesn't belong to any plant and is more of a representation of something more abstract. The ancient light nourishes the leaf through its veins, displaying its faded but remnant power. "One leaf, one world."

name: Meteoric Alloy
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Resilient meteoric ironsand. Its tenacity is far superior to solid boulders. "Let's grab as much as we can. Qlipoth will need them." "I have no idea whether the Aeon need them or not. All I know is that the IPC will pay big bucks for them."

name: Jade Abacus Unit
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: The most essential component of jade abaci, commonly used in the final step of installation.\n\n"Pick one, they are all outdated models. But once installed, they will undoubtedly bring a soul-like essence to your machines."

name: Extract of Medicinal Herbs
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Medicinal herbs are the foundation of Xianzhou's medical practice, and these extracts capture the active ingredients from various herbs, enhancing their medicinal efficacy in leaps and bounds.\n\n"The value of 'tradition' lies in its ability to evolve and progress, rather than remaining stagnant."

name: Tian Dong
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: While plants of the Tian Dong genus typically grow on land, Tian Dong plants of Scalegorge Waterscape stand out by extensively inhabiting the coastal areas of the Lunarescent Depths. Although artificial cultivation techniques for Tian Dong have become quite prevalent, there are still many who believe in the superstition that "wild plants have stronger medicinal properties," causing significant trouble for the Pearlkeepers.\n\n"Plunderers of Tian Dong, to the Shackling Prison they will go."

name: Confounding
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: I've never been outstanding since I was a kid. I barely met the requirements to get into college, and I barely earned enough credits to obtain my degree. Now, I'm sitting at my desk, contemplating how to explain my understanding of "confusion" to you, but am I really worthy of showering you with my superficial understanding? And do you really need to listen to all this broken gibberish of mine? I don't know the answer.\n\n"Anyway, I hope you enjoy yourself."

name: Hunger
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: In Penacony, "hunger" is an expensive spice that can make any food in the Dreamscape irresistible. In the world beyond dreams, "hunger" is the smile on the lips of death. "They say hunger is the best seasoning, but I just want to fill my stomach."

name: Old Molar
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: No one knows the origin of this molar. The person selling it claims this extremely anachronistic item was found on the battlefield of the Emperor's War, infused by a bygone era of craftsmanship and defiance now lost in modern times.\n\n"It serves as the growth rings of inorganic life."

name: Bough of Thought
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: A glowing bough with branches sprawling unrestrained in every direction, resembling the organic divergence of thought. It is born in a quiet corner of the Grove where scholars often drift into contemplative dazes. Though lacking any practical use, Cerces appears particularly fond of such curiosities. Legend has it that the Titan would select the bough with the most intricate branching and wear it atop their head as an ornament. \n\n"For a long time, I've been going to bed early, yet it does little to quiet my restless mind. It feels as though the thoughts from a past life have been reborn within me... At some point, I began to notice a cluster of intertwined branches outside my window."

name: Deep Marrow Rock Salt
description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Salt crystals unearthed from the depths of the rift valley, revered by the farmers who toil on the land. Many keep one of these crystals in their homes, treasuring it as the "bared spine marrow of Georios," a generous gift to the farmers. When reclaiming barren land, just a small sprinkling of this rock salt is enough to transform the barren soil into fertile ground, breathing life back into the earth. \n\n"Non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic fertilizer is the best!"

name: Strange Matter of Destruction
description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Strange matter that seems to possess the power of destruction. Resembling fire but not quite, it is neither cold nor hot and will damage anything that comes into contact with it for over 12 seconds. Could be the Antimatter Legion's version of trash. "Creatures that received blessing from Nanook all have twisted appearances."

name: Ambergris of Abundance
description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Jelly-like substance that contains the power of Abundance. Firm but not stiff, with notes of fragrance, it fills your heart with hope the moment it touches your fingertip. Do not ask what it's made of. "It gives you longevity and abundance, dispelling misfortune and illness."

name: Stone of The Hunt
description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Small stone with the power of The Hunt. As if guided by someone's will, it moves by itself towards a certain direction. Sounds like what a magnet would do? I assure you it is not. "The destination lies where my arrow is heading."

name: Preservation Construction Material
description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Construction materials that seem to possess the power of Preservation. When mixed with water it forms a paste, when exposed to air it turns rock-hard. Please do not use together with Solid Water. "I regret to say that Intelligentsia Guild's research on the material used to build the Subspace Crystalline Barrier by Amber Lord still needs time to reveal its nature." "I'm sure it's not cement — am I right, Taravan?"

name: Hard Chip of Nihility
description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: A chip made of iron that seems to possess the power of Nihility. It may have been a coin that people use to buy things. But apparently, as the engravings on it fade away, its value went with them. "I don't know what I'm writing between these quotation marks. What's the point of this item description? My life is meaningless, so is this piece of flavor text."

name: Tree Bark of Erudition
description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Dried tree bark that seems to possess the power of Erudition. Its creases tell the story of the years passed and the wisdom of nature. It says a lot more when beaten into pulp used for papermaking. "The wisdom of mankind is contained in this one word."

name: Slime of Harmony
description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: A torus that seems to possess the power of Harmony. It only has one surface. No matter where you depart, you're destined to not reach your destination. A tiny complaint would be that it is a bit sticky, as if it does not want to let you go. "All are connected and the wind of blessing breathes across the lands!"

name: Dragon Scale Coral
description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: At the bottom of Lunarescent Depths, there is a diverse array of nearly a hundred coral species, among which dragon scale coral holds the greatest value. Within the coral skeleton of dragon scale coral, there is a rich concentration of Heavenly East compound. This compound serves as the finest antibiotic in the cosmos and possesses numerous other medicinal properties. Despite almost ten thousand years of efforts, humans have yet to learn how to industrially produce this compound. In front of the entrance to the Fanghu's Alchemy Commission stands a statue of dragon scale coral. Underneath it, there is an inscription that reads: "When you mistakenly believe you can control nature, always remember: Nature is the ultimate biochemist."

name: The Sound and the Fury
description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: As you may have realized, the majority of sounds in this world are noise, and the majority of words are meaningless combinations. Don't let these distractions sway your judgment. "Life is like a fool's dream filled with the sound and the fury, but ultimately meaningless."

name: Thermal Gel
description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Heat dissipation is a challenge that all Intellitrons must overcome. Although Intellitrons created using different generations of technology differ significantly in terms of materials and internal structures, traditional physical heat dissipation often remains the most suitable choice for many models.\n\n"It's just like organic beings bathing in water."

name: Silk Spindle
description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: A spindle entwined with silk threads. When the first discarded garment handcrafted by Aglaea accidentally found its way to the market, people were left in awe. What ingenious trimming! What flawless hidden seams! What masterful cutting! For a time, the entire Okhema fashion scene was swept into a frenzy of imitating Aglaea's artistry. The type of spindle she uses also became a must-have among garmentmakers, but the golden thread wound around it — exclusive to the demigod of Mnestia — cannot be replicated no matter what.\n\n"O beautiful Mnestia, grant me but one-tenth of Lady Aglaea's talent! I am willing to do anything in exchange!"

name: Interdimensional Leaf
description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: The gravity of the planet Arivanta is not fixed. Rather, it changes all the time according to a Bode plot due to the influence of Arivanta's three moons. Ordinary life forms cannot survive such volatility, so the planet developed its unique eco-system, in which the herbal plant Interdimensional Tree is the most famous. For plants in a world where gravity is constantly subject to change, their leaves often have a hard time landing on the planet's ancient and solid ground. It is for this reason that the Interdimensional Trees tend to shake off their leaves rather late in the year. To help their leaves land, these trees, in the course of evolution, gave their leaves the ability to conduct fast short-distance warp-jumps towards the ground at frequencies that cannot be observed by naked eyes. Even so, not every leaf gets to land on the ground. Those lucky enough to make it watch others rise into the sky and burn as they are devoured by the atmosphere. "Wow."

name: Phase Flame
description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Sserkal, #29 of the Genius Society, only lived 29 days by human measures of time. Despite that, she put her short life as a spider to good use, inventing new technologies that would have taken the spider-kind thousands of years to develop. Of all her inventions, the most famous must be the technique known as Phase Change. What people don't know is that this technique was first applied to experiments with ions. She successfully created Phase Flame, which almost immediately changed to another phase. By the time the Flame returned to the Sserkal Phase, our genius had already passed away. She tried to harness the Flame but had too little time to do so. Thus, the Phase Flame continued to change between phases across different worlds, leaving behind the seeds of flame. "Sserkal's life was remarkable. She was smart, kindhearted, and above all, humble. She remained curious and inquisitive, asking her final question in the club on the last day of her life, the answer to which has not been found to this day."

name: Tear Crystal of Glorious Death
description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: A Mourning Actor took a gondola and rowed towards a silent world of barrenness, humming an elegy for civilizations long gone. Not a single soul could be found at the site of the doomsday battlefield, but like nacre, the world that had turned into ashes gave birth to pearls of sorrow. The ghosts of the past condensed into clouds and rained down crystals like teardrops. The Actor held a fine grain of such crystal in hand and immediately heard in a dream the glorious chorus of civilizations at their height — heroes with godly might, starships like towering mountains, the whimper of stars, and the rage of the enemy. The Actor became restless in sleep, dragged into silent dreams.\n\n"Every single joy I had in my dreams breaks my heart."

name: Mythus Knots
description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: To make the divine revelations of the Mythus even more mysterious, the History Fictionologists whipped up something known as Mythus Knots that contain a blend of rumors, secrets, legends, and myths. Historians would then blend such misinformation into what was supposed to be certain and rigid historical facts, with the aim to bring about a future of uncertainty for the universe. According to the History Fictionologists, the course of history is limited by the "narrative drive" in the minds of its observers. If something can be done to mix myths into facts, the universe will be covered in the "mist of uncertainty," allowing it to escape the calamity that is doomed to happen.\n\n"Scammers try to predict the future themselves, but prophets resort to higher powers."

name: Weary
description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: I'm tired of writing. I'm done with it.\n\n"This is what is called 'weariness.'"

name: Mechanical Cube
description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: According to legend, this is the heart of a prominent Intellitron leader, containing the Ultimate Source Code, the essence of all inorganic life. Scholars at the Intelligentsia Guild believe that this code holds the key to unraveling the mysteries of inorganic life.\n\n"It may also be the pathway for demons to return to the mortal world."

name: Fresh Seed of Dawn
description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
backgroundDescription: Legend has it that Amphoreus once hosted a beauty pageant where several renowned beauties each plucked a fruit from the golden apple tree. Mnestia declared that the contestant who returned the following year with their golden apple still intact would be deemed the most beautiful. When the year passed, none of the contestants succeeded in the trial — even the finest golden apples had rotted, just as even the most radiant faces inevitably fade with time. But in the third year, an ordinary-looking peasant girl returned, not with an apple, but with a new seedling. She explained that she had been deeply saddened by the golden apple's decay and had carefully gathered the seeds from the rotting fruit, planting them to nurture a new tree. Moved by her actions, Georios appeared and urged Mnestia to crown the peasant girl as the most beautiful contestant. Mnestia, however, was reluctant, unable to see any beauty in the girl. At that moment, Georios called upon Oronyx to cover Mnestia's eyes with the veil of night. The instant Mnestia lost their sight, they perceived the brilliance of the peasant girl's heart and joyfully awarded her the title. "Agy, doesn't this legend sound like your story?" "Heh... a beautiful tale, indeed."
