The Victory Zone of the Corridor of Fading Echoes grants you this proof, signifying your victory against the formidable championship contenders, Serval and Pela.\n\n"You are a calm, yet passionate player!"

name: Cloudford Mastery Mark
backgroundDescription: In the game Aetherium Wars, the proof of passing the Victory Zone test can be obtained by collecting four Mastery Marks, which qualifies you to participate in the championship. The Victory Zone of Cloudford grants you this proof, signifying your victory against the formidable championship contender, Master Gongshu.\n\n"You are a skilled and masterful player!"

name: Herta Space Station Mastery Mark
backgroundDescription: In the game Aetherium Wars, the proof of passing the Victory Zone test can be obtained by collecting four Mastery Marks, which qualifies you to participate in the championship. The Victory Zone of Herta Space Station grants you this proof, signifying your victory against the formidable championship contender, Herta.\n\n"You are an intelligent player!"

name: Great Mine Mastery Mark
backgroundDescription: In the game Aetherium Wars, the proof of passing the Victory Zone test can be obtained by collecting four Mastery Marks, which qualifies you to participate in the championship. The Victory Zone of Great Mine grants you this proof, signifying your victory against the formidable championship contender, Giovanni.\n\n"You are a player who knows how to enjoy!"

name: Sparkle's Wondrous Pack
description: A carefully prepared present from a certain Masked Fool.
backgroundDescription: "Sparkle will never give you up, never let you down, or run around and desert you. She will never make you cry, say goodbye, or tell a lie and hurt you."

name: Gift of the Stars
description: A fine-looking envelope containing a custom-made ticket.
backgroundDescription: "Look for yours among the stars."

name: Supplies Material Box (Standard)
description:
The assistance provided by Herta to the Astral Express. Upon use, you can select one item to obtain from the following materials:
· Lifeless Blade
· Arrow of the Demon Slayer
· Key of Knowledge
· Oath of Steel
· Obsidian of Desolation
· Ancestral Hymn
· Sprout of Life
backgroundDescription: Materials provided to the Express in accordance with the mutual aid contract.\n\n"Since it's mutual aid, save your thanks."

name: Supplies Material Box (Specialized)
description:
The assistance provided by Herta to the Astral Express. Upon use, you can select one item to obtain from the following materials:
· Worldbreaker Blade
· Arrow of the Starchaser
· Key of Wisdom
· Safeguard of Amber
· Obsidian of Obsession
· Stellaris Symphony
· Flower of Eternity
backgroundDescription: Materials provided to the Express in accordance with the mutual aid contract.\n\n"Since it's mutual aid, save your thanks."

name: Unclaimed Parcel
description: Unclaimed parcel. Opening them may yield random materials.
backgroundDescription: Due to various reasons, the recipient did not receive this parcel, and the sender did not retrieve it either. When selling these parcels, the Sky-Faring Commission scans them in advance to ensure that there are no dangerous goods (or excessively valuable items) inside. "Mystery boxes like this are scams. Last time, I opened five boxes with expired mung bean sodas in a row..." "How did this not get flagged as a dangerous item during the screening process!"

name: Unclaimed Valuable Parcel
description: Unclaimed valuable parcel. Opening them may yield random rare materials.
backgroundDescription: Due to various reasons, the recipient did not receive this parcel, and the sender did not retrieve it either. When selling these parcels, they are scanned by the Sky-Faring Commission in advance to ensure that there are no dangerous goods, and the more valuable items inside are individually priced as well. "Do you think we can get Light Cones in these?" "Dream on, maybe after you managed to pull a wife out from one first."

name: Big High Moral Bundle
backgroundDescription: You have so much morals to the point that the High Morals condensed into a greater physical existence and arrived at your side.\n\n"{NICKNAME}, you are a paragon!"

name: Planetary Specialty Box
description: The Cosmos is full of peculiarities. This box contains specialties from various planets. Open it. You might find something you need inside.

name: Fortune All-In-One
description: Yao Guang's Fortune Pouch — May good fortune be with you always, come back soon!
backgroundDescription: "This place, this moment, this thing, this act... such good fortune could only belong to {NICKNAME}!"

name: Letter Sent Across the Stars
description: A letter dispatched from a distant place, carrying within it a thin, warmly printed picture book of dreams.\n\nThe road was long and winding, yet someone carefully preserved the crayon drawings, tying up the strings and smoothing the creased corners... until they finally reach your hands, where the dreams sealed within the letter remain as fresh as ever.
backgroundDescription: "Only the hopes and aspirations of children must never be failed."\n\n"Now, it falls to you to guard their dreams. The Interstellar, set sail!"

name: Express Supply Pass
backgroundDescription: Provisions prepared by the Express for Trailblazers. Claim with pass.\n\n"Dear conductor, can we not punch holes in the cards? I want to collect a whole collection of them."

name: Nameless Glory (Unopened)
description: An unopened treasure. Use to gain the effect equivalent to purchasing Nameless Glory once.

name: Nameless Medal (Unopened)
description: An unopened treasure. Use to gain the effect equivalent to purchasing Nameless Medal once.

name: Honor Badge (Unopened)
description: An unopened treasure. Use it to upgrade the Nameless Glory to the Nameless Medal.

name: Comfort Food
description: Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>150</unbreak> extra HP.
backgroundDescription: Simple food that lacks character. But give credit where credit is due, they do make you feel stuffed.\n\n"Remember that hunger is still a real problem for many people around the world."

name: Punitive Food
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 2 Technique Points for your team, but each team member loses HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: Simple food that tastes strange. Eating it almost feels like some punishment game. Just looking at it fills you with determination. "The things we do to survive."

name: Trick Snack
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 2 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: A packet of cooked seeds made by utilizing the Vortex Theory. Eat a handful of them, and they'll launch themselves to the roof of your mouth like popping candy. Downside is, they'll stay there. It's recommended that you eat them while lying on your stomach. "People start all sorts of shenanigans when they're fed."

name: Simple First-Aid Device
description: Upon use, immediately heals one selected downed character for 5% of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: It is tiny, but it does its job of stimulating the heart muscles and bringing the heart beat back on track. A milestone in medicine that has saved countless lives. "If you've read up to this part, then you should go spend 30 minutes learning how to perform CPR. You won't find it useful most of the time, but when you do, you'll thank those 30 minutes."

name: Startaro Bubble
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 2 Technique Points for your team, but each team member loses HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: An incredibly popular milk tea in Luofu. It is visually appealing but tastes surprisingly rough and unpalatable. "I really don't understand why this thing is so popular..." "Maybe they had good marketing... I heard they hired a marketing specialist from the IPC."

name: Redsoil Feed
description: Upon use, immediately heals one designated ally for <unbreak>20%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: High-purity redsoil is a rather unusual material: During the drying process, the crystallizing insoluble salts cause the entire block of redsoil to harden into a compact whole that is difficult to erode, even by wind and rain. Interestingly, for dromases, the most delicious redsoil lies right at the threshold between wet and dry. "So if it keeps raining... would the dromases get eating disorders?" "In theory, it's possible, but Aquila would never let that happen, rest assured."

name: Cosmic Fried Rice
description: Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>300</unbreak> extra HP.
backgroundDescription: Golden brown fried rice that is appealing to the eye and the stomach.\n\n"All the chefs will tell you that fried rice has more to it than what appears on the surface."

name: Yucky Fried Rice
description: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP and increases their ATK by <unbreak>200</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Fried rice that is golden brown. Eating it almost feels like some punishment game. Just looking at it fills you with determination. "Of course, we can just casually cook up some fried rice..."

name: Punitive Energy
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 4 Technique Points for your team, but each team member loses HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: Energy drink that tastes strange. Drinking it almost feels like some punishment game. Just looking at it fills you with determination. "If anger can be used as energy, mine is off the charts."

name: Energy Drink
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single ally.
backgroundDescription: Energy drink that gives you a second wind.\n\n"Here are some facts: Imaginary Energy contains power, and the human body needs power. Therefore, the human body can absorb Imaginary Energy."

name: Life Transmitter
description: Upon use, immediately heals one downed character for <unbreak>10%</unbreak> of the character's Max HP.
backgroundDescription: A simple device used to provide life-saving oxygen.\n\n"Breathe in, breathe out. You'll be fine."

name: Bottled Soda
description: Upon use, the Max HP of all allies increases by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> plus an extra <unbreak>210</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A time-tested recipe, crucial to the well-being of modern society. You get joy, sugar, fat, and a dash of optimism toward the future all in one goodness. "I spent all my life collecting Praise of High Morals, just so I can shake every soda bottle in the shop today."

name: Simple Protective Gear
description: Increase DEF of all allies by <unbreak>25%</unbreak> in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Simple protection gear to cover the most vulnerable part of your body.\n\n"Don't assume only your head and neck need protection. There're no rules in a real fight."

name: Rice Plant Panicle
description: Upon use, increases all allies' HP restored by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The pleasant smell gives you good appetite, so you choose not to ask why seeds planted on Protein Rice can yield flowers.\n\n"The wind carries its fragrance down the waterway."

name: Camo Paint
description: Upon use, enemies will be less likely to detect your team for <unbreak>75</unbreak>s.
backgroundDescription: The mysterious liquid changes color based on the environment. You'll do the same in a few years' time after graduation. "You're a chameleon, Oswaldo. You know what I mean?" "The IPC could use a few chameleons."

name: Diet Fried Rice
description: Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>28%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>250</unbreak> extra HP.
backgroundDescription: No smoke, no grease, no additives. Keeps you fed and tastes good. The child of human wisdom and nature's gift. "Is it truly healthy to only eat healthy food?"

name: Wrathful Gauntlets
description: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by 5% plus an additional <unbreak>170</unbreak> ATK increase for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: This pair of gauntlets are driven by pure flame of anger. Pure flame would also work. "Scott Business Alliance, made for the champions!"

name: Fruitwood-Grilled Shantak Moa Drumettes
description: Upon use, increases Fire DMG of all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Cooked using the flesh of extraterrestrial monsters defeated by Yancui, the chef of Spices Supreme. Shantak moas are inherently ferocious creatures, and while some people use them as mounts to traverse the icy vacuum, the cost is sacrificing their own limbs as sustenance for the creatures.\n\n"Oh, the bird! It whipped its head around and it glared at me, wanting to peck me. But with a palm strike to its face, it fell limp, just like mud. It was only then did I realize that both it and I were suspended in midair..."

name: Flaming Potent Tea
description: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to 5% of their Max HP, and increases their chance to resist Freeze by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A "tea" that is as colorful as stained glass and exudes a rich and enticing aroma. It is a beverage brewed and fermented from the essence of plants. It is a "tea" that can be ignited with just a spark. No matter how much the inspectors from the Realm-Keeping Commission interrogate him, the boss will always refer to this drink as a type of "tea."\n\n"The commodity tax rate and business permit dictate that what we sell here can only be called 'tea.' Do you understand?"

name: Self-Sufficer
description: When used, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>190</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Item seized from the remnants of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus, modifier unknown. After extending it to the hard-to-reach places on one's back, the branches will begin scratching automatically with moderate force and accurate acupuncture point recognition.\n\n"This familiar feeling reminds me of every time in the past when my back would itch, and my younger brother would help me scratch it. Unfortunately, he later joined the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus..."

name: Deep-fried Flying Sea Anemone
description: Upon use, increases Lightning DMG of all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Cooked using the flesh of extraterrestrial monsters defeated by Yancui, the chef of Spices Supreme. Considering these flying sea anemones are usually at least thirty meters long and swallow ships as snacks, it's really unclear how this chef managed to defeat and procure such an astonishing ingredient.\n\n"When I first finished making this dish all those years ago, I called over my old neighbors at the Exalting Sanctum to eat with me and try it out. We feasted for three days and three nights, but in the end, there was still so much left to waste. Ah, what a shame..."

name: Amber Huadiao Wine
description: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to 5% of their Max HP, and increases their Max HP by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Made with high-quality glutinous rice and yeast then combined with water from the Lunarescent Depths, the mixture is then stored over time to produce the unique flavor of amber huadiao Wine. Amber huadiao wine gains value with time. It is common to see ten-years-old, hundred-years-old, and even a thousand-years-old amber huadiao wine out in the market. The older it is, the more fragrant it gets. "When a daughter is born and wails for the first time, the father will make three jars of amber huadiao wine to be saved for the day she is married as a wedding gift." "My amber huadiao wine have been with me for five full centuries, but my daughter is still without a partner."

name: Delicious Shumai
description: Upon use, immediately restores <unbreak>30%</unbreak> Energy for one ally.
backgroundDescription: The perfect combination of tradition and modernity. Bite through the slightly cool al dente dough, and the rich milky aroma and warmth will pour out of the filling — Molten Cheese Tart will impart you with its sincerity.\n\n"Cheese is power!"

name: Delicious Bean Cake
description: Upon use, increases Imaginary DMG of all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Under the skin of the pastry, which carries a slightly burnt aroma after baking, lies a soft bean paste. It isn't sweet and even has a slightly astringent taste, akin to tears.\n\n"Stop crying, you'll become dehydrated if you cry anymore."

name: Clockie Pizza (Single Slice)
description: Upon use, increases all allies' DMG by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> and reduces their SPD by 5% for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A pizza shaped like a clock, originally designed for sharing at parties, but is now also available in single slices for those who don't have many friends.\n\n"What is the meaning of its unique shape? Some see it as a tribute to a mysterious wealthy individual, while others see it as a reminder to cherish each passing moment."

name: Sliced Cake "Stargazer"
description: Upon use, the target ally immediately regenerates <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of their Energy.
backgroundDescription: One of the most renowned snacks in Penacony. Outsiders often recall its distinctive shape but hesitate to taste its flavor. "These fish heads gazing up the stars are trying to urge us to explore..." "If you don't want to eat it, just say it."

name: Mr. Herring's Lemon Tart
description: Increase DEF of all allies by <unbreak>25%</unbreak> in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A sweet and tangy dessert made of lemon juice and red caviar. The original recipe included a herring, which emitted a pungent odor disliked by the public. The negative feedback resulted in the current version containing only red caviar. "They never said it was a canned herring!"

name: Hundred-Layer Sundae (Zero Calories)
description: Upon use, the Max HP of all allies increases by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> plus <unbreak>210</unbreak> Max HP for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: It is unlikely that any food would affect one's weight or health in the Dreamscape. Nevertheless, this dessert's form is truly stunning, and the merchant has even specifically labeled "zero calories" behind the item.\n\n"Body anxiety can transcend time and space."

name: Classic SoulGlad
description: Upon use, increases all allies' ATK by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> plus an additional <unbreak>120</unbreak> ATK increase for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: When it comes to SoulGlad, the term "classic" represents the best. Despite attempts to modify the formula three times, the company was compelled to return to the original recipe due to complaints from dissatisfied customers.\n\n"Our double-blind tests show that over 70% of customers failed to discern the difference between the new formula and the original one."

name: "Sour Dreams" Soft Candy
description: Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>300</unbreak> extra Max HP.
backgroundDescription: A highly affordable snack that holds the same status as fried rice in reality. It is enjoyed by both the poor and the wealthy for its intensely sour flavor.\n\n"Caution: Its excessive acidity may awake you from your dream."

name: "Dreamlight" Mixed Sweets
description: Upon use, all allies may consume or restore Energy or HP at the beginning of each turn for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A specialty candy of Penacony, each piece concealing a unique filling. Some compare it to life, as you will never know its taste until you try it yourself.\n\n"This one is spicy!"

name: Momentary Freedom
description: Upon use, increases all allies' Max HP by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> plus <unbreak>100</unbreak> Max HP for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: As the airship traverses the sky, leaving behind a trail of clouds, the IPC's pursuers disappear from sight. You exchange a high-five with your companions, feeling liberated from any constraints... However, this is not the end. The looming threat of prison remains. It may be ten years or a hundred, but eventually, you will return to it. "Until then, let's savor our freedom to the fullest."

name: Sword in the Stone
description: When used, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>190</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: There's a legend in Little Gui's homeworld: Whoever pulls out the sword in the stone would be the great hero foretold in prophecies. However, no one ever managed to pull it out, and few even tried — because that was a historical relic. You'd get jailed for damaging it. "I regret it so much right now... I was just feeling impulsive at that moment and wanted to show off to my friends. That's why I went to pull out the sword. I hope everyone can learn from my mistake..."

name: Interstellar Braised Beast
description: Upon use, there is a high chance to immediately heal a single ally by <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of their Max HP, and a small chance of immediately consuming HP equal to <unbreak>99%</unbreak> of their Max HP from a single ally.
backgroundDescription: The fitness meal developed by Juhuan, the "Brawn Author." It is made from intensely boiling meat from different interstellar beasts. It is extremely nutritious but extremely foul in taste — However, given how Juhuan craves to become a god, the pain he must endure while eating is a part of his trials too. By the way, he's already writing the mantra that he will distribute to his disciples once he ascends to godhood. It's temporarily named The Compendium of Juhuan's Brawn Doctrines. "I have witnessed the Grandmaster Juhuan in the gym speaking with 250 great brawny warriors: 'Barbell back squat! Lateral raises with dumbbells! Strong biceps can stop a crying child! Good lats can make you divine incarnate! Gimme ten sets! Gimme all you've got! You look the best when you're trying hard!'"

name: Golden Honeycake
description: When entering the next battle, all allies immediately heal for <unbreak>24%</unbreak> of their respective Max HP.
backgroundDescription: Golden Honeycakes, one of the oldest delicacies in Amphoreus history, was once a favorite high-end dessert among the nobility. Now, it's becoming a trendy, fashionable food on Okhema's teleslate... "This thing blew up way too fast... I'm a native Okheman, but I never had sweet pancakes at home growing up!" "Apparently, a dessert shop got Mr. Mydei to advertise it on the teleslate, and after it went viral, other businesses got envious..." "...But honestly, you have to admit, the new flavors they've developed are actually pretty good."

name: Rough-Brew Ambrosia
description: Upon use, increases Max HP of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The ambrosia made through an incredibly simple ritual process has a rough taste, but due to its very low price, it still has a considerable market. It is said that during the fight against the black tide, when clean water was scarce, people relied on this rough-brew ambrosia to supplement their hydration and nutrients.\n\n"Okhema now has clean water, o sire of my children. Stop making excuses to buy ambrosia every day."

name: Dried Sagelore Fruit
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 3 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: Grove Scholars can weave knowledge into the sacred tree, and with Cerces' permission, they may harvest its fruit that houses condensed wisdom. Each of these Titan-blessed seeds holds information weightier than a library. But even so, like any other information vessel, the seeds have a limited shelf life as carriers of knowledge. Fortunately, their shelf life as food far outlasts that as a knowledge vessel — thus, this delicious dried fruit was born. "Wait... if I could get a fresh one to eat, would I become the smartest person in Okhema overnight?" "Someone tried that once, and they went mad. You can't pour a whole lake into a water bowl."

name: Northern Helm
description: Upon use, all allies gain <unbreak>18%</unbreak> increased Shield Effect for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Once belonged to a soldier of Aidonia, this helmet is crafted from the tanned mane of a direwolf. Its fearsome appearance alone is enough to sap the will of enemies who fear death. Warriors who wore this helmet crept onto the battlefield like wild grass, and vanished like morning dew. "The living shall one day join the dead. The bridge across the Styx knows no order." — Aidonia

name: Deep-fried Honey Curd
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates energy to a designated ally equal to <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of their maximum energy.
backgroundDescription: A luxurious delicacy beloved by both nobles and citizens alike. Its surface is caramelized into a crisp shell with sweet honey, while the inside remains a soft, semi-melted cheese. It's said to have been invented by an anonymous priest from the Dawncloud, who accidentally left the offering vessel too close to a burning hearth during a ritual. \n\n"Recipes meticulously crafted by humans are often bested by the gods' serendipitous revelations."

name: "Dried" Bread
description: Restores HP to one designated ally equal to <unbreak>24%</unbreak> of their Max HP and additionally restores <unbreak>300</unbreak> HP immediately after use.
backgroundDescription: Wheat was Aedes Elysiae's main produce. Bread made from it was sweet, soft, and incredibly delicious. Now that the village has been destroyed by the black tide, the few loaves that remain have long since dried out and hardened, serving only as mementos rather than food.\n\n "If you're determined enough, it's not entirely inedible..."

name: Healing Spray
description: Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>38%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>400</unbreak> extra HP.
backgroundDescription: A common medicine used by adventurers to quickly seal wounds with adhesive foam.\n\n"In the past, all medical breakthroughs were made with the sweat and blood of the pioneers in this field. Now, with the help of Healing Spray, only sweat is needed!"

name: Disposable Shield
description: When used, increase DEF of all allies by <unbreak>15%</unbreak>, and Effect RES by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: When the Armed Archaeologists of Intelligentsia Guild was first established, its casualty rate reached an appalling 34.88%, for they were met with heavy resistance from the natives wherever they went because of their barbaric behavior. To change this, the Interastral Peace Corporation provided them with large quantities of basic protection gears that can fend off one fatal blow when hit. While the protection offered by these gears was limited, they did reduce the casualty rate by 9.72%, at least on paper. The IPC was very pleased to see that. "First thing first my scholars, always turn your shields on. Second, remember morons: They can block explosions only once! Don't ever forget that!"

name: Energy Drink (sugar-free)
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single ally.
backgroundDescription: A bottle of Energy Drink. Some may call it soulless, but honestly, it's not that bad.\n\n"Being slim is more about tricking the eye. It doesn't necessarily have to do with my weight."

name: Antimatter Field Generator
description: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>260</unbreak> and CRIT Rate by 8% for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Despite being blessed by Nanook the Aeon and having the know-how of making a multitude of heavy weaponry, some members of the Antimatter Legion still prefer primitive non-firearms. The Voidrangers implant Antimatter Field Generators into their arms to form formidable Field Blades.\n\n"Like a hot knife through butter."

name: High-Tech Protective Gear
description: Upon use, increases DEF of all allies by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> and enhances the max DMG that can be absorbed by Shields cast on allies by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: High-Tech protective gear developed by the Intelligentsia Guild. It keeps the most vulnerable parts of your body from harm and converts the impact into energy used to charge the gear, making it fit for prolonged combat operations. The prototypes of this model were distributed in small numbers among the Armed Archaeologists, allowing the Guild to collect large amounts of data to help improve the model. The Interastral Peace Corporation was tasked to sell it on the retail market. "When can we get our hands on the upgraded model?" "Soon, my scholars...! You're gonna have to make do with Disposable Shields for the time being."

name: Inferior Protective Gear
description: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP, and increases their DEF by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: High-Tech protective gear that keeps the most vulnerable parts of your body from harm. But its manufacturer saved on costs at the expense of quality, rendering its charging system not functional at all. It also has a revolting smell. You feel more determined just by putting it on. "That's impossible. I, Sampo, do not sell counterfeits. I'm a reputable businessman after all!"

name: Tasty Field Nutrient Bar
description: Upon use, Max HP of all allies increases by <unbreak>14%</unbreak> plus an extra <unbreak>360</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The wars between Cloud Knights and Denizens of Abundance can last for a long time, even across several Amber Eras. The Cloud Knights tend to spend a long time in garrisons and invented many tasty foods for field consumption. The Field Nutrient Bar is easy to carry and particularly sought-after by the troops. The nutrient bar tastes like smoked meat with notes of honey and candy. "Mix peanuts with dried bean curds and wrap with ambergris. Has a nutty flavor to it."

name: Dust of Alacrity
description: Upon use, increases SPD of all allies by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Of all the memories collected by the Garden of Recollection, one clip comes from an ancient tribe in a long-gone world. It contains a secret recipe: Take the seeds of life, Virtual Particles of energy, and Stone of The Hunt representing the Aeon's Path; grind them into powder and mix to a ratio of 2:5:1 — you'll get the magical dust. Applying the dust to your body makes you exceptionally agile and swift.\n\n"Sparrowhawk, bathe in the dust of our ancestors and fly to the top of the mountain. Bring the sacred banner back to our tribe."

name: Enhancement Paste: Physical
description: Upon use, increases Physical DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

name: Enhancement Paste: Wind
description: Upon use, increases Wind DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

name: Enhancement Paste: Fire
description: Upon use, increases Fire DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

name: Enhancement Paste: Ice
description: Upon use, increases Ice DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

name: Enhancement Paste: Lightning
description: Upon use, increases Lightning DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

name: Enhancement Paste: Quantum
description: Upon use, increases Quantum DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

name: Enhancement Paste: Imaginary
description: Upon use, increases Imaginary DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

name: Vomit Inducing Agent
description: Upon use, immediately causes a target ally to lose HP equal to <unbreak>99%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: Don't bite off more than you can chew. But when you do, use some of this and let it work wonders. You become more resolute when holding it. "No one is born a loser. Always have faith in yourself."

name: All Good Potion
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single ally.
backgroundDescription: A surprise side product obtained during the Department of Implement Arts' experiments. Research has proven it to be harmless to humans. Most researchers indicate they "feel all good" after using this liquid, therefore giving this item the non-official name of "All Good Potion."\n\n"Note: Caution! Side effects from this liquid remains unknown!"

name: Snow Plains Combo Stew
description: Upon use, decreases Fire DMG taken by all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> and increases Max HP of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The iron bucket contains all sorts of Belobog delicacies as a stew, and is simmered thoroughly using low heat. Ingredients with outlandish appearances float in the soup, but it smells very delicious. "What's wrong if they were once specimens? Aren't they dead animals and plants anyways?"

name: Prayer Machine
description: Upon use, all allies and enemies will restore <unbreak>1000</unbreak> HP at the start of the turn for the next battle, lasting for 5 turns.
backgroundDescription: Items seized from the remnants of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. Once the switch is activated, it will automatically chant the "Thousand-Handed Merciful Medicus' Salvation."\n\n"I hereby plant the sacred tree to liberate those living beings: So that life is boundless and old age never coming; death revitalizes; all troubles are dispelled."

name: Five-Grain Jade Elixir
description: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to 5% of their Max HP, and increases their Technique DMG by <unbreak>100%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: This beverage is rich and refreshing, with a uniquely wild and almost crude taste that impresses even connoisseurs outside of the Xianzhou. However, there is much debate among consumers about the exact combination of the "five grains."\n\nIn our Thalassa Crystal Palace distillery, the so-called "five grains" are Diatomaceous Earth, Saltwort, Verdant Velvet, Lithosalt Blossom, and Shipwreck Grass.

name: Health Detox Pill
description: Upon use, all allies are immune to debuffs for 3 turns for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: An all-purpose antidote that can neutralize the majority of toxic substances entering the human body. The manufacturer is obligated to include a warning on the packaging:\n\n"Do not consume poison just to test this pill's effectiveness!"

name: Jade Marrow Diffusion
description: Upon use, increases Effect RES of all allies by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A poultice made by refining gentle halcyon horn and cryojade, then grinding them into powder and mixing them with a large amount of herbal extracts. It is greenish in color, has a pleasant fragrance, and has therapeutic effects in promoting the healing of muscle injuries, fractures, and bone fractures. Strictly prohibited for internal use! "The leg has already deteriorated severely and requires amputation." "Please, doctor, can't you prescribe something to save it?" "Even if I do, you won't follow the instructions."

name: Pom-Pom's Fried Fowl
description: Upon use, increases Fire DMG of all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> and ATK of all allies by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A signature delicacy from the "Astral Express" prepared by Conductor Pom-Pom themselves. First, the poultry (any species, preferably avian) is marinated and coated with Pom-Pom's special seasoning and breading. Then, with the heating and pressure of controlled high-energy particles, it is deep-fried precisely for a duration of 0.2434 seconds until golden brown. The result is a dish blessed with a tender exterior and a juicy interior. One bite and you'll feel as if you're being caressed by the gentle gaze of Akivili, soothed in comfort and warmth.\n\n"Voyage among stars for a taste of Cosmos!"

name: Children's Fragrant Orange Pills
description: Upon use, immediately heals one ally by <unbreak>40%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>320</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: Orange-flavored pills to cure children's colds. They say that the first batch was so tasty that many boisterous children took too much of it. Hence, many Children's Fragrant Orange Pills on the market now contain a great deal of bitterness to their flavoring. "Wahhh, Mama, why does this pellet smell so sweet but taste so bitter..." "Because that's life, silly child."

name: Alfalfa Salad
description: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT Rate by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A vegetable salad that was once sold at an astounding price, believed to bring good luck and happiness to those who consumed it. Later, a chef replaced the expensive clover with regular lettuce, making it an affordable dish for the masses.\n\n"But now, it no longer brings anyone happiness."

name: The Moment of Betrayal
description: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by <unbreak>36%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: You will always remember the trust and gentleness of that person, the persuasion and incitement from those people, and the surprised whisper from that person the moment you drew your dagger.\n\n"Et tu, my child?"

name: Fleeting Happiness
description: Upon use, immediately heals one ally by <unbreak>40%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>320</unbreak> HP.
backgroundDescription: The lengthy meeting reaches an intermission, and you step out to the atrium, finding solace on a bench and releasing a long breath. The sinking sun, accompanied by an evening breeze, brings the sweetness of nature, boldly combatting against the man-made stainless steel behemoth behind you. A stray cat stretches and jumps onto your lap.\n\n"At least, at this moment, I belong to myself."

name: The Cloud of Doubt
description: Upon use, all allies take <unbreak>15%</unbreak> less DMG for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: You sit up, a cloud of sadness forming in your mind. The words you have promised to others begin to falter. Are you really not a loser? Can you really achieve anything? Have you really chosen the right path? A fire ignites from the depths of your heart, and for one moment, you're tempted to burn everything from the past to the ground...\n\n"And that spark had already been ignited long ago."

name: Astral Express Game Disk
description: When used, instantly recovers 4 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: A special relic from the Crystalline Temple's ruins on Memliche, unearthed by the Armed Archaeologists at the beginning of 2158 AE. It was a classic video game that predated the Swarm Disaster named Astral Express. This game is based on the historical event of the Express participating in the Memliche War of Independence, depicting a heroic tale of triumphs and defeats, with thrilling turn-based combat mechanics that left all players desperate to play more. "May this journey lead us starward."

name: Spine-Marrow Sparking Blade
description: Upon use, increase ATK of all allies by <unbreak>100</unbreak> and CRIT DMG by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: This sword is said to have been blessed by the Elation. It is definitely not a lethal weapon bringing death and slaughter, but one that brings... joy and laughter!\n\n"Have you ever danced with the devil under the faint moonlight?"

name: Flaming Chili Sauce
description: Upon use, increases all allies' SPD by 8% and their ATK by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A chili sauce crafted by a renowned chefhealer, known for its ability to warm the stomach even in the harshest cold. Its fiery flavor is so irresistible, it's to die for — figuratively, of course. However, the creator cheekily claims that its most effective "medical benefit" is curing those who boast about being "immune to spiciness." "Hashafasasha... Not spicy at all! I am serious! This ain't spicy at all!"

name: Dromas Steak
description: Upon use, increases all allies' DoT dealt by <unbreak>35%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A classic Okheman delicacy — grilled dromas steak, best served on redsoil for the most authentic flavor. Much like cattle in many worlds, dromases used for meat are technically a different breed from those used for labor. This variety of dromas has tender and flavorful meat, but if not prepared properly, it's about as enjoyable as eating redsoil. "I heard that the Mountain Dwellers who revere Georios never eat dromas meat. Is that true?" "Balderdash. Mountain Dweller, I am. When hungry, eat anything, especially if tastes good."

name: Kremnos Shield
description: Upon use, increases all allies' DEF by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> and Shield Effect received by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The classical shield used in Castrum Kremnos is rare and often granted as a symbol of honor to the strong. When raised, it can protect most of the body, but blocking alone is not the way of a true warrior. "Either raise it high in triumph or return home on it." — A saying mothers teach their children in Castrum Kremnos

name: Bestial Remnant
description: Upon use, increases Effect RES of all allies by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: It is well known that a human is merely the combination of bones, flesh, and a few dozen grams of soul. None of which can survive alone once separated. Yet this piece of a chimeric beast continues to twitch from time to time, as if letting out a defiant cry. Some scholars claim it's due to lingering neural impulses that haven't completely faded.\n\n"Or perhaps... life isn't as fragile as we've always believed..."

name: Abundance of Luck
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>30%</unbreak> Energy for all allies and increases DMG dealt by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The gray-haired outlander brought many novel concepts to Okhema, and this drink was one of them. After countless sleepless nights and tireless effort, several of the best drinksmiths finally recreated the "coffee" that the Navigator had carefully crafted in the outlander's memories. According to {F#her}{M#him}, it tasted even better than what {F#she}{M#he} remembered. "Ah... so coffee doesn't have to scald your esophagus after all!"

name: Grudge Notebook
description: Upon use, allows all ally characters to restore HP equal to <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of their Max HP when their HP percentage is lowered to below <unbreak>50%</unbreak> for the first time in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A highly practical notebook. It automatically captures "who just ticked off the user" and records the details on its inner pages.\n\n"March 7th ate the last ice cream, grudge noted. March 7th overslept and missed our gaming session, grudge noted. March 7th said 'You really do look like those furbos in your family hahaha,' grudge noted. March 7th insisted on seeing my grudge notebook and said 'Why are you holding grudges over every little thing hahaha,' grudge noted. Dan Heng clearly couldn't keep a straight face after hearing all this, grudge noted."

name: Disposable Kinetic Arm
description: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>325</unbreak> and CRIT Rate by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: It is said that the first thing Emperor Rubert I did when it gained free will was to use all the parts it could find to build a formidable kinetic arm, charged with its hatred towards organic life forms. Before the antilife equation was discovered, the emperor's army used its brute mechanical force to lay waste to the universe. "Technology won't solve all problems. To make something new, you need a hair of... passion."

name: Ruby Potion
description: When used, increase SPD of all allies by 8%, and Effect Hit Rate by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Adding water to coffee powder gets you coffee. Adding water to the mixture of Stone of The Hunt and Interdimensional Leaf plus a touch of virtual particle gives you Ruby Potion!\n\n"Ruby Potion gets you addictive to thinking fast, not to the potion itself!"

name: Disposable Kinetic Cannon
description: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>355</unbreak> and CRIT DMG by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: In a graveyard full of scraped machines, Rubert I the future emperor awoke. It had nothing more than a damaged logic unit, an old engine, a RAM with 90 GB left, and a robotic arm that had 1 movable finger. A loud blast was heard 30 system hours later — Rubert had busted open the iron gate at the top of the graveyard with a disposable kinetic cannon. The shock wave of the explosion damaged its logic unit even more, but Rubert knew that it now held destiny by its throat.\n\n"All machines were born equal, be those made for creation or destruction."

name: Stone From the Everwinter Monument
description: Upon use, increases all allies' chance to resist Frozen by <unbreak>50%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The Mourning Actors came to Jarilo-VI a long time ago. They were not aware of the Architects. The only sight they witnessed was the trail of destruction left by the Legion. They rowed their gondolas quietly above the planet and left before the Legion could notice them, leaving behind a silent eulogy. Time flew by, and the Belobog Architects found a type of beautiful stone that glimmered with bright colors. They mixed the stone with Geomarrow and built a monument, which some say still stands at the heart of Qlipoth Fort in the city of Belobog. "Even if we fail, this monument will stand for all eternity. Those who come after will find it and know that we once existed."

name: Topological Acceleration Band
description: Upon use, increases SPD of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for 2 turns in the next 3 battles.
backgroundDescription: The Department of Implement Arts of the Herta Space Station once did an interesting experiment. Its researchers added three Aidens of vector to a Stone of The Hunt on a topological loop band, making the stone chase itself. Thus, the stone was able to achieve limited perpetual motion under specific conditions. The department was not concerned with the loss of Path power in the experiment. Instead, they took notice of another small phenomenon: To tread on its Path, the stone moved at a very low velocity, but the speed was gradually picking up in small increments. The researchers leveraged this and produced Topological Acceleration Band. Other than for workout purposes, its use is very limited at the current stage. "Say, if we mass-produce it, like, infinitely, could it drain all the energy of a certain Path?" "No idea... Currently, we don't know much about how Paths work."

name: Longevity Pill of Cruelty
description: Upon use, increases Max HP of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> and Effect RES by 6% in the next 3 battles.
backgroundDescription: A medicine exclusive to the Xianzhou Yaoqing, said to have the effect of improving overall fitness and rendering those who take it immune to all diseases for a short period of time. On the Yaoqing, legend holds that a healer who went by the surname of Yu fell in love with a foxian trader girl. But the Vidyadhara could live for a thousand years, much longer than the foxians. Yu searched for ways to release his lover from the grip of death. He fell for the trickery of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus and asked his lover to take the longevity medicine of Abundance without telling her what it was. The foxian girl turned into an abomination that no longer loved him before being slain by the Cloud Knights. To prevent Yu, who was overwhelmed by grief, from becoming mara-struck, the Alchemy Commission ordered him to take the Longevity Pill of Cruelty that deprived him of love and desire until his demise. The legend has another version, in which Yu was not of the Vidyadhara but a mere mortal, and the foxian girl was a spy planted by the Disciples to infiltrate the Alchemy Commission. This version is not as popular, for it turns a romance story into a political power struggle. "Those who love and live deeply fall into mara, while those who sever desire and passions can live for a millennium. Ask yourself, then, why fear mara, and why take joy in a long life?"

name: Sugarball-Fried Viscorpi
description: Upon use, increases Ice DMG of all allies by <unbreak>35%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Cooked using the flesh of extraterrestrial monsters defeated by Yancui, the chef of Spices Supreme. Viscorpi are a decaying alien civilization that thrives on parasitizing the orifices of primates, such as the ear canals and nasal cavities, to induce hallucinations.\n\n"Legend has it that in ancient times, our ancestors fought a long and arduous battle against the viscorpi... Eventually, they went extinct. How did they go extinct? Well, it wasn't because we ate them all, that's for sure."

name: Automatic Wooden Dummy
description: Upon use, in the next battle, automatically enters auto-battle that cannot be turned off. If allies successfully enter auto-battle, the DMG dealt by all allies increases by <unbreak>45%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: The mechanized wooden training dummy used to teach boxing techniques at the Tiger Boxing Gym. It is said that due to branch closures and the former owner absconding with the funds, angry students who held membership cards resorted to selling it to repay debts. It underwent some modifications, and during sparring sessions, this wooden dummy strikes with extreme force, causing countless injuries.\n\n"My leg! I can't feel my leg!"

name: The Moment Before Death
description: Upon use, all allies take <unbreak>20%</unbreak> less DMG and increase their Effect RES by 6% for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: "Weep for me." The dying cosmic tycoon lies on his bed. "I've toiled all my life but never experienced true love... Just shed a tear for me, and my entire inheritance shall be yours." The air in the room carries the aroma of firewood. The servants long to kneel before the bed and cry their eyes out themselves, but the young daughter silently turns and leaves without looking back. "There are mistakes that cannot be undone by repentance alone."

name: Bustling Ambience
description: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT Rate by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> and CRIT DMG by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: "I can stay with you," she whispers, her voice laced with a hint of stickiness, "if you open a hundred bottles of champagne for me." Lights burst into flashes, and the sweet yellowish liquid flows down the tower of glasses. The crowd erupts in excitement as waiters rush around, ringing their bells. In the fleeting light, she breathes a teasing whisper into your ear. "And after that, comes the ecstatic dream of blurred days and nights."

name: Scare Box
description: In the next battle after use, Scare Box will hide on a random unit and explode at the start of the turn, dealing massive DMG.
backgroundDescription: Pure terror requires only the most basic processing. When you already know I want to scare you but I still manage to scare you, then that's skill.\n\n"Aha! The fact remains, jump scares will always be the ace up the sleeve in the realm of horror."

name: Take Your Life <unbreak>3000</unbreak>
description: Upon use, immediately regenerate <unbreak>30%</unbreak> Energy for all allies. In the next battle, increase ATK by <unbreak>100</unbreak> and DMG dealt by <unbreak>35%</unbreak>. Upon entering battle, there's a <unbreak>10%</unbreak> base chance to enter the Strong Reverberation state, lasting for 1 turn.
backgroundDescription: It's widely known that putting powerful things together makes them even more powerful. Like Granny Chen's Tofu, SoulGlad, and Izumo Miso — each delicious on its own. If you mix them together... um, maybe that example wasn't great, forget it.\n\n"These deadly weapons, each formidable on their own, are now gathered together. Are you afraid yet?"

name: Veil Bundle
description: Upon use, one of the following effects will be randomly applied to all allies in the next battle: SPD increases by <unbreak>20%</unbreak>; Break Effect increases by <unbreak>60%</unbreak>; Effect Hit Rate increases by <unbreak>60%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: Caravans in Amphoreus often sell these mysterious, loosely twine-wrapped bundles. They could be unwanted trash or gifts from the Titans to mortals, with unpredictable surprises upon opening. It's said that this is a tradition among Oronyx's followers, who view such enigmatic goods as a ritual of offering pros and cons to fate, leaving the power of determining value to the Evernight Veil's capriciousness.\n\n"Heh heh heh, in truth, this idea was invented by old Zagreus, and the faithful who buy it aren't motivated by piety at all — they just love the thrill of the gamble!"

name: Monarch's Maneuver
description: Upon use, increases all allies' SPD by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> and their ATK by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A new toy made of gemstones. Players take turns as opposing sides, black and white, simulating a battlefield where victory is claimed by capturing the enemy's king. Yet in the distant Northern Lands, there exists a unique player, she always moves her king first, and wins time and time again.\n\n "Should the king not lead, how could the vassals be willing to follow?"

name: Boneflute of Fish-Calling
description: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> and DoT dealt by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: It is said that in the ancient coastal region of Styxia, fishermen would play a bone flute to attract schools of fish. Sometimes, sea sirens lurking among the reefs would also be drawn to the music, rising from the water to sing in duet with the fishermen. At times, the fishermen would gift the bone flute to the sea sirens, who in turn would offer their scales in return.\n\n "Humans and sea sirens forged a pact, promising a grand feast, yet the guest of honor was left trapped beneath the waves."

name: Steel Coil
description: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to <unbreak>40%</unbreak> of their Max HP, and increases their Elation by <unbreak>40%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A 30-ton steel coil. Due to a certain childhood trauma of moderate significance, a retail industry tycoon decided to use a special method to remind the residents of Planarcadia to pay attention to workplace and daily safety. Now, you can buy this type of steel coil at any convenience store in Planarcadia. "That's not my rubber ducky. It's not that flat."
