name: Trash
description: Upon use, immediately causes a single ally to lose HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: Worthless trash. Better carry some with you. "Some say that in the deep retreats of the cosmos, an invisible portal will open to those carrying a piece of junk."

name: Pleasant-Looking Trash
description: When used, instantly recovers 4 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: Worthless things are beautiful in their own way.

name: Sanctity of the Trashcan
description: Increase DEF of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: It's hard to explain why a trashcan has dignity and why that dignity is so heavy.

name: Jim Roger Bread Soda
description: When used, instantly heal a single ally by <unbreak>100%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: Crush dried bread into fine crumbs, add water, extract the liquid and let it undergo fermentation. Add Jim Roger patented ingredients as the last step. And there you go, authentic taste of Jim Roger!

name: Kapo-Kali
description: Upon use, increases all allies' DMG of a random Type by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The king of soft drinks. It looks like an azure gravity rainbow with sparkling bubbles surging in the bottle. Hear the crisp "click" when you pop the lid and feel drops of absolute zero freezing your nerve endings... In an instant, you will fall into a dream where the stars rise and fall in the midst of a distant fragrance.\n\n"This anti-gravity drink is all the rage, leading me to have seen Kali-Kapo, Gali-Gapo, Kopa-Kila, and even Kali-Gali-Kapo..."

name: Tuskpir Wrap
description: Upon use, immediately heals a target ally for <unbreak>20%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: A cake roll that is too cute to eat. It gets its name from the beautiful texture on the roll that resembles a tuskpir's fur. "This cake roll is so cute and looks like a tuskpir!" "It's actually made of tuskpirs." "???"

name: Berrypheasant Skewers
description: Upon use, immediately heals one ally by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of the ally's Max HP plus <unbreak>150</unbreak> extra HP.
backgroundDescription: Berrypheasants live in symbiosis with plants, with a lot of fruit hanging from their tails. Berrypheasant Skewers are actually fruit skewers, and no Berrypheasants were harmed during the production process. "So... is this a meat dish or a vegetarian dish?"

name: Rye Bread Soda Iceberg
description: Upon use, immediately heals one ally by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of the ally's Max HP plus <unbreak>150</unbreak> extra HP.
backgroundDescription: A cold snack made with Rye Bread Soda and Moo-Moo yogurt. It is sweet and delectable, full of wheat flavor. At the beginning of the Eternal Freeze, many migrants thought there wouldn't be a need for cold snacks in Belobog. But soon, they couldn't resist the frozen delight. "I often see couples eating icebergs with spoons in front of dessert shops..."

name: Stone-Roasted Meat Skewer
description: Upon use, increases Max HP of all allies by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The steel skewer has all sorts of Belobog delicacies on it, and is barbecued thoroughly using high heat. Its ingredients are mostly harmless. It is also the favorite food of Belobog's adventurers out in the wild, as well as being the most easily obtainable. "This tastes so good! What kinds of meat are in it, though?" "You wouldn't want to know."

name: Fighter Jet Lucky Plaque
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 2 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: Xianzhou residents believe that if a starskiff can safely endure until retirement, it harbors auspicious energy within it. They create talismans using materials from such ships, seeking good fortune. These wooden plaques often have the inscription "Safe" on the front and "Departure" on the back.\n\n"Lately, there have been more and more counterfeit goods. Some of these lucky plaques are completely shoddy! Look at this fake one, it has 'Reverent Departure' carved on the front and 'Respectful Entry' on the other side."

name: Grande Rejuvepill
description: Upon use, immediately heals one ally for <unbreak>10</unbreak> HP.
backgroundDescription: A simple remedy made by grinding blue maple deer antler, sprout combination remedy, and droppings from blue-winged squirrels into powder, then kneading them with honey to form pills. It has some healing effects, but not significant. "Your medicine's effectiveness... is it any different from a bowl of brown sugar water?" "Of course it is. Brown sugar water is sweet, while my medicine is as spicy as drinking boiling water."

name: Short Rejuvepill
description: Upon use, immediately heals one ally for 1 HP.
backgroundDescription: A simple remedy made by grinding mountain devil mint, white-hair ivy extract, and droppings from blue-winged squirrels into powder, then kneading them with honey to form pills. It can't cure all ailments, but it is considered to be better than nothing.\n\n"Quick, take this medicine, or your wound will have healed on its own."

name: Newspaper
description: Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>150</unbreak> extra HP.
backgroundDescription: The physical medium of memories, a crucial means for dwellers in the Dreamscape to learn about the outside world, recording one good news after another.\n"News was supposed to make people know about yesterday, live well today, and look forward to tomorrow."\n"However, in the crystalized sweet dream, only good news is allowed."

name: Flying Sword Model
description: When used, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>100</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: This travel souvenir sold aboard the Skysplitter, based on Yanqing's flying sword, is quite popular among tourists. Despite being a toy sword, its quality is immaculate, even serving as a suitable training prop for beginners. Yanqing once intentionally used it to beat several challengers who lacked martial virtue to the point of crying for their parents. "Although your defeat this time is regretful, there's no need to be discouraged. If you're willing to challenge again, I'll be ready to accept anytime." "Anytime? Then make sure you sleep with an eye open."

name: Conscience
description: Upon use, immediately heals one selected downed character for 5% of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: The most expensive thing in the world, yet also the cheapest.\n\n"Nothing. Everything."

name: Snapper Jam Appetizer
description: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by 5% plus an additional <unbreak>170</unbreak> ATK increase for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A convenient delicacy cooked with Redsunset jam and fried fish. It has a sweet taste. If you want to make the most authentic Snapper Jam Appetizer, you must use overnight fried fish and never freshly fried fish. "Alisa Rand loves this. Well, that's what I read in the magazines."

name: Crystal Lizard Satay
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 4 Technique Points for your team, but each team member loses HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: A skewer made from cold-blooded reptiles that live in mines. Zoologists will tell you that the crystals on the lizard's body are actually a by-product of its body's osmoregulation and the maintenance of body fluid levels. They'll also tell you that this by-product should never be eaten. "It tastes like chicken, and it's crunchy!"

name: Wild Herb Soup
description: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP and increases their ATK by <unbreak>200</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Soup made of a type of moss that has a soothing bluish glow and can be found everywhere underground. This kind of moss ball is said to have the effect of clearing away heat and detoxifying, but it is generally not recommended to consume Corrosive Ore Moss products that are still glowing. "Drink it — it's Belobogians' fate."

name: Deep-Fried Rock Crab
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 3 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: Fried Rock Crab with a crispy crust and tender inside. This kind of crab wreaked havoc in Belobog before the Eternal Freeze occurred, and then inexplicably almost became extinct. The meat of it is soft, tender, and delicious. Could this be the reason for their extinction? You dare not think further. "Even if Rock Crabs live in rocks, they are still seafood. Don't you see they have the word "crab" in their name?"

name: Mung Bean Soda
description: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by 5% plus an additional <unbreak>170</unbreak> ATK increase for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Made from fermented legume-based products. It smells sour and pungent, but tastes cool and refreshing. If you can drink a big bottle of mung bean soda and remain calm, you will definitely impress the gormandizers on the Luofu. "Like mung beans? Like soda? Then what are you complaining about!?"

name: Scalegorge Spring Water
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single ally.
backgroundDescription: Natural drinking water from the Scalegorge Waterscape. It doesn't say it's a zero-calorie drink, and it looks like it has zero calories, but its calories are incredibly high. "Colorless and tasteless like spring water, yet high in sugar and fat like milk tea. It minimizes the guilt you feel when consuming calories."

name: Songlotus Cake
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single ally.
backgroundDescription: A classic snack made from songlotus on the Luofu. Once you take a bite of it, it makes a crisp laughing sound. Occasionally Luofu's gormandizers use it to tease outworlders. "You scared me!"

name: Steamed Puffergoat Milk
description: Upon use, immediately heals one downed character for <unbreak>10%</unbreak> of the character's Max HP.
backgroundDescription: Puffergoat milk, also known as Gentle Halcyon milk, is a specialty of the Xianzhou Alliance. The milk is difficult to preserve and rarely seen outside Xianzhou. It is sweet after warming without needing extra sugar, but it becomes bitter after cooling, so it must be drunk while hot. "According to the Lifitide magazine, General Jing Yuan has to drink a large bowl of freshly squeezed Puffergoat milk every morning. The Seat of Divine Foresight has denied this report."

name: Frostweave Salmon Bread
description: Upon use, decreases Fire DMG taken by all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A cold platter made from air-fried preserved frostweave salmon and bread, with a bowl of redsunset jam for free. Nowadays, frostweave salmon are mostly bred inside Belobog's walls. Their taste is miles off from the frostweave salmons fished from the wilds outside the city. "I heard having raw fish slices together with bread can delay the onset of diarrhea effectively. Is that true?" "Heck if I know. Go ask Natasha."

name: Sweet Dreams Soda
description: Upon use, decreases DMG taken by all allies by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A drink from Penacony, the Planet of Festivities. Its brand name is "SoulGlad." Drinking this will make one feel as happy as if they are in a pleasant dream, making it an effective sleep aid. This version of the formula has been adjusted to better suit the tastes of the Xianzhou consumers. It is said that only within the dream of Penacony can one taste the "Inaugural SoulGlad," reputedly as delicious as divine nectar.\n\n"Grab a bottle of SoulGlad, make your dreams a blast!"

name: Mineshroom
description: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by 5% plus an additional <unbreak>170</unbreak> ATK increase for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Dry fungi prepared from the outworld civilization of Thalassa. This is a type of fungi that exists only at the bottom of Khalnoss' oceans, and harvesting it can be quite dangerous as mishandling may lead to explosions. It tastes good and is extremely nutritious, while its blast radius can reach two meters, making it a high quality food item and an extremely potent weapon. "I heard the military rations aboard the Yaoqing include dried mineshrooms. Not sure if that's true or not." "Well, what can I say... using such a dangerous thing as food very much fits their stereotype..."

name: Dry Emergency Light
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 3 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: An emergency light from the outworld civilization of Insumousu. This small portable lamp requires no source of energy. Simply soak it in brine with 5% salt concentration and it will shine for hours. It is actually the luminescent fishing rod antennae on the dorsal fin of a Thalassa lightfish. In ancient Insumousu, only the bravest fishers dared to hunt these dreadful creatures. Now, however, these fish are being cultivated on an industrial scale.\n\n"Darling, I know you're trying to be romantic with this outworlder-style candle-lit dinner but... there's a shining fish head baring its teeth at me in the middle of the table. I don't think I can finish dinner..."

name: Tranquil Duster
description: Upon use, the target ally immediately regenerates <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of their Energy.
backgroundDescription: A wooden duster. Before the activation of important ingenia such as the Matrix of Prescience, craftsmen of the Artisanship Commission will always invite the most qualified masters to perform a warding ceremony with their golden rods, which are dipped in purified water and scattered around the place. It is said that these kinds of rituals decrease ingenia malfunctions by 62.33%. "Believe in science! the only purpose this serves is psychological comfort..." "No, you're not getting it! This is seriously different!"

name: Puffergoat Belly Bliss
description: Upon use, increases Max HP of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A high-quality yogurt made with specially selected probiotics and fermented for more than 300 years. It helps to cure the ills of the stomach, tastes splendid, and there are rumors that the Xianzhou's Immersia playwrights are its biggest users.\n\n"Huh, so this is the stuff that the playwrights spend their time eating. I wonder if their storylines are as sweet as the flavor of this yogurt?"

name: Popcorn
description: Upon use, increases all allies' Break Effect by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Under extreme temperature and pressure, the protein rice expands to an unprecedented level and then explodes with a "bang." Fluffy and tasty, this snack tastes perfect paired with any entertainment.\n\n"Not a healthy food, but health is worthless in the face of pleasure."

name: Thundering Appetites
description: Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>300</unbreak> extra Max HP.
backgroundDescription: Your lips and tongue yearn for juicy meat, your stomach craving to be filled — even the air seems to carry the scent of charcoal. Your belly emits a thunderous roar, and you struggle to maintain control.\n\n"There are few desires in this world that are as insatiable as this one."

name: Bright Future
description: Upon use, increases all allies' HP restored by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: "One day, we will have a real house." With a cup of coffee in her hand, your wife says. "It will have a yard where we can grow flowers, a hall where we can dance, a transparent attic where we can gaze at the stars, and ideally, a small dog to cuddle and sleep with. That would truly be a blissful life." You smile in silence and propose a toast. The warm air swirls and ascends, gently caressing the ceiling before dissipating. "A bright future exists only in dreams."

name: Dream Syrup
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 3 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: A unique creation from Penacony, this syrup serves as a non-addictive tranquilizer, offering an ineffable experience of serenity and delight for a certain duration.\n\n"Its manufacturer claims this syrup has all the benefits of religion and alcohol without any of their drawbacks."

name: Halovian Winged Burger
description: In the next battle, increase all allies' SPD by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> and decrease their ATK by 6%.
backgroundDescription: Classic fast food from Penacony. Its origins can be traced back to when The Family first arrived in Penacony. In order to show respect to the distant Halovian visitors, the locals created this delicacy resembling their appearance. The Halovian Winged Burger symbolizes gratitude towards The Family. However, for the inhabitants of the Primordial Dreamscape, it seems to carry a different connotation... "Thanks to The Family, praise to the Great One, may this burger fill our bellies!" "The Deplorable Family, hypocritical Halovians, I'll eat you up right now!"

name: Delusion Blocks
description: In the next battle, increases all allies' CRIT Rate by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> and decreases their SPD by 5%.
backgroundDescription: A toy made from fragments of intense emotions. It mysteriously appears on the shelves from time to time, using sweet words to persuade customers to buy it and take it home. It has received high praise for childcare and preschool education, once honored with the title of Top 10 Family Teacher in Dreamflux Reef. "Hey, kiddo, if you want to build a castle, you should put me on top."

name: "Hollow Bird" Toy
description: After using this consumable, increase all allies' SPD by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> in the next battle. At the start of every turn, allies lose HP equal to <unbreak>20%</unbreak> of their current HP, lasting for 5 turns.
backgroundDescription: The strange and creepy doll bears some resemblance to the cartoon character from Clockie. One wonders how dark the mind of the designer must be to turn the cute Origami Bird into such a frightening figure. "Mom, this thing you gave me is definitely not an Origami Bird. It looks too scary!" "True, but it's much cheaper than the ones sold by Clock Studios."

name: Authentic Sousa Juice
description: When used, increases all allies' ATK by <unbreak>35%</unbreak> and decreases DEF by 8% for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A low-quality syrupy drink that is rumored to be the true and original recipe for SoulGlad. The foul water, sickeningly sweet syrup, and mediocre taste meant this drink is banished to the depths of the Dreamscape's shelves. But in a time before the arrival of the sweet dreams, this was the spring water that cleansed both tears and blood, a fine wine made to soothe the bitterness of the years. "They used flavoring to mask its strange taste, used coloring to hide the poor quality, and used carbonation to deprive it of flatness — But the truth hidden within the bottle will never disappear."

name: Trash Sparkling Water
description: Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>300</unbreak> extra Max HP.
backgroundDescription: A beverage that {NICKNAME} sells on {TEXTJOIN#87}. The inspiration came from the psychoanalysis that Dr. Edward performed on {NICKNAME}. The one consuming this drink will immediately feel the "supreme joy of digging through trashcans." However, Dr. Edward did adjust the flavoring to ensure that normal people aren't overwhelmed by such extreme levels of happiness. "AHHGHGHH! I LOVE DIGGING THROUGH TRASHCANS! TRASHCAN IS HAPPINESS! I AM HAPPINESS! I AM TRASHCANNNNN!" "Uh-oh, big eyes. This one's completely gone off the rails. What now?" "I told you before to not use the original recipe. You have to believe in the science of psychoanalysis!"

name: Hello and Goodbye
description: Upon use, increases all allies' Break Effect by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A special concoction tailored exclusively for you by the drinksmith Gallagher. "Raise this glass of 'Hello and Goodbye' in your honor, {NICKNAME} —" "To the imperfect tomorrow."

name: Asdana's White Oak
description: Upon use, immediately regenerate (only for Energy) Energy for a single ally equal to <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of their Max Energy.
backgroundDescription: A beverage that {NICKNAME} sells on {TEXTJOIN#87}. In reality, it is an expensive drink of single malt juice, but you can imbibe it as much as you want in the Dreamscape. Under Boothill's recommendation, a bullet will be left soaked in the drink when sold. He said this would add a special flavor, but maybe only his augmented tongue could taste it. "Son of a nice lady, if you can't even taste the fragrant mellowness that brass and gunpowder add to this malt juice, then don't screwubbaboo the good hooch! Hand it over, I'll do the drinkin' for ya!"

name: Proof of Trust
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 3 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: A souvenir that {NICKNAME} sells on {TEXTJOIN#87}. The inspiration came from {F#her}{M#his} personal experiences. Every time {NICKNAME} talks about the history of this medal, {F#her}{M#his} eyes shimmer with tears.\n\n"He was my king, and the shepherd of all existence's waste. Upon his throne, he aided the humble cans and humbled the vile cans..."

name: Arma Correctional Body Wash
description: Upon use, increases Effect RES of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The prisoners scrimped and saved the fatty meat from their meals, then used their ingenuity to procure alkali and bottom ash from the prison kitchen, only to produce one such bottle of body wash after several months of effort. Admittedly, the quality is far from what you can buy outside, and occasional quality control issues do occur, but each drop of it is a condensed essence of the inmates' unfettered craftsmanship. "Isn't this exactly the kind of marketing you short-life species love?"

name: Ten Lords' Revival Dust
description: Upon use, increases Max HP of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A byproduct born from the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus' research into deadly poisons. This possesses the effects of strengthening the body, boosting vitality, healing injuries, and calming the mind. Since it did not contribute to Sanctus Medicus' pursuits, this formula was shelved. However, presently in The Shackling Prison, Gouteng has utilized this formula to generate significant profits for the Arma Correctional Group. "Aren't we supposed to be making poison? Why is this mouse getting more energetic the more it eats?" "Look on the bright side... at least we can crank out another paper from this..."

name: Laudatory Press Release
description: Upon use, increases DEF of all allies by <unbreak>50%</unbreak> when entering the next battle, until after being attacked.
backgroundDescription: This is the most secretive frontline in the cosmos. All mass media engage in fierce battles here, vying for the most precious and scarce natural resource — your attention.\n\n"In today's world, everyone has the potential to have their 15 minutes of fame."

name: Laudatory Press Release
description: Upon use, increases DEF of all allies by <unbreak>50%</unbreak> when entering the next battle, until after being attacked.
backgroundDescription: This is the most secretive frontline in the cosmos. All mass media engage in fierce battles here, vying for the most precious and scarce natural resource — your attention.\n\n"In today's world, everyone has the potential to have their 15 minutes of fame."

name: Propaganda Army
description: Upon use, immediately heals one designated downed ally unit for <unbreak>10%</unbreak> of the unit's Max HP.
backgroundDescription: The so-called "scientific method" is so odious. It separates "facts" and "values," and forces you to accept all "facts" — even those you despise the most! In the past, people used to say "facts triumph over everything," "face the facts," "truth prevails"... But the good news is, the mass media has led a revolution concerning "truth": Whereas there used to be only one "truth" in the world, now we can choose our preferred "truth" based solely on our preferences. "Welcome to the post-truth era!"

name: Banasocial Etiquette
description: Upon use, immediately heals one designated ally by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>300</unbreak> extra HP.
backgroundDescription: It was said that the design was inspired by a trance-like dance of the Slumbernana Monkeys. It was usually placed in the buffet area of the campus banquet, directly facing the guests — and is also usually the only dish that was left untouched the whole night.\n\n"This is edible? I thought it was a part of the decor!"

name: Reduce Bananxiety
description: Upon use, immediately regenerate Energy for one designated ally equal to <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of their Max Energy.
backgroundDescription: It's said to be "the worst dessert you can eat on Penacony," but as long as you can bear that scrunched-up face, all your worries will be met with a smile.\n\n"So you're the one who made a dessert with unripe bananas and turned it into a hit with a story? Interested in transferring to Fortune Academy?"

name: Origami Cake
description: Upon use, all ally characters' SPD increases by 8% in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The signature cake of Paperfold University, Dean Glaux's favorite post-meal dessert. It is said that he once proposed designing the statue base in the shape of the cake, but the idea was opposed by Dreamweaver Academy.\n\n"The price is thirty times that of a real cake, but the weight is one-thirtieth."

name: Full-Auto Dreampaint Spray
description: Upon use, all ally characters' DEF increases by <unbreak>25%</unbreak> in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: The dream of all young Dreamweavers: 1. To have their name or work featured in the textbooks of Paperfold University. 2. To earn enough Alfalfa credits to cover permanent housing costs. 3. To own a spray can that can paint automatically! "Black-and-white spray cans are cheap, and those of other colors are expensive. Make sure not to pack the wrong one, or you'll feel it when the bill comes."

name: Dazzling Ninja Provisions
description: Upon use, all ally characters' ATK increases by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: At the end of the Mappou Age of the Dharma, the Dazzling Ninja Hero rescued the dreamlands from the siege of fiends, but was harassed by Fiendling Rumbletums, causing her powers to wane and making it difficult to fully exorcise the demons. Fortunately, Ninja Initiate Patissier came to her aid, infusing Dazzling Ninjutsu into sugar pills to satisfy the Ninja Hero's hunger, allowing her to restore peace to the dreamlands.\n\n"By the Great Lan above, this event is also recorded in the Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions."

name: Steelclaw Dagger
description: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> in the next battle. If their current HP percentage is less than <unbreak>50%</unbreak>, ATK will additionally increase by <unbreak>20%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: Steelclaw Beasts, also known as Bladed Black Velvets, were a type of dangerous creatures once found in the ancient lands of Castrum Kremnos. The beast had exaggerated sword-like claws capable of slicing through finely crafted weapons in a single swipe. Although now extinct, warriors have crafted weapons mimicking the anatomy of their claws, with unique blades that cause wounds to bleed continuously.\n\n"Most creatures stop fighting when they die, but this one doesn't."

name: Chrysos Heir Dolium
description: Upon use, increases all allies' DMG dealt by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> and Memosprite Skill DMG dealt by an additional <unbreak>10%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: A dolium crafted via traditional Amphoreus crafts, its surface adorned with scenes of past heroics by Chrysos Heirs. The neck and base feature intricate geometric patterns. It serves both as an everyday water vessel and as an offering in rituals.\n\n"We use it to hold water, to make offerings, and to tell the stories yet unfinished."

name: Oronyx Slate
description: Upon use, immediately heals one designated downed ally and restores for <unbreak>10%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: A mysterious slate etched with the cryptic prophecies of the Fate Titans. Its edges are carefully shaped into stars and emit a faint glow under the light of the Dawn Device. According to legend, those favored by time may glimpse unknown pasts... or futures within its depths.\n\n"All prophecies are written in the night. Oronyx simply taught us how to look up."

name: Earth Crystal Ore
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of Max Energy for one designated ally.
backgroundDescription: In the folk mythology of Amphoreus, this is a mineral extracted from the fissures of Georios' divine body. As a part of the Earth Titan, it still emanates a faint vitality, carrying the echoes of the divine. The Mountain Dwellers often polish it into various jewelry pieces as a tribute to the Earth Titan. "If you put your ear close, you can hear Georios' sighs..." "I don't know. It sounds more like snoring to me."

name: Zagreus' Premium Honey Curd
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>25%</unbreak> of Max Energy for one designated ally.
backgroundDescription: Rumor has it that it's an expensive delicacy stolen by Zagreus from the kitchen of Okhema's master chef, but somehow ended up in Big Chungus Bartholos's massive belly.

name: Zagreus' Premium Bread Crisps
description: Upon use, immediately heals one designated ally by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>240</unbreak> extra HP.
backgroundDescription: Rumor has it that it's a local souvenir Zagreus picked up from a particular village, but somehow ended up in Big Chungus Bartholos's massive belly.

name: Domesticated Comedic Angel
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 3 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: The "Comedic Angel" used to be quite a dangerous pest. When it's in your line of sight, it won't move a muscle. But the moment it leaves your field of vision, it starts moving at high speed, trying to circle around behind you to absorb your Wishpower. Nowadays, with this pest nearly extinct, some enterprising pet merchants have bred the "Domesticated Comedic Angel." This Comedic Angel is incredibly small and has a very docile temperament. Owners can sustain it with the Wishpower they naturally metabolize. "Tired of your pet bouncing off the walls at home? Want to spend some quality quiet time with your pet? Try the 'Domesticated Comedic Angel'! It only bounces around when you can't see it. Out of sight, out of mind!"

name: Anti-Meme Toy Box
description: Upon use, randomly applies 1 of the following effects to all allies in the next battle: increases ATK by <unbreak>35%</unbreak>; decreases ATK by <unbreak>10%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: A fun little prank toy. Manufactured using antimemetic technology, no one can perceive what's inside the box. Give it to your friend and let curiosity torture them as they remain completely unable to cognize what's actually in the box! "I don't understand what you mean... there's nothing in this box, right?" "Haha, that's anti-meme! It's not that there's nothing there, it's that 'you can't perceive it.' Pretty interesting, huh?" "No no no, I'm absolutely certain... this is an empty box. There's nothing inside." "Let me see... *Arcadian expletive*, we've got a serious problem! That thing got out! Quick, call the Department of Aberration Defense!"

name: Badge Battle Robe
description: Increase DEF of all allies by <unbreak>25%</unbreak> in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A battle robe studded with Fluffy Across the Blue badges. Thanks to its exceptional defensive capabilities, it's become one of the most practical pieces of The Fluffy merch out there. As a heavy suit of armor, wearing this battle robe does restrict your movement somewhat. Some fighters have developed "Badge Jujitsu" and "Badge War Dance" techniques to adapt their combat style when fighting in The Fluffy robes. "Tomorrow's opponent is a hardcore fan of March Bunny. There are a few spots on your robe they'll absolutely refuse to hit. Remember that."

name: Sparxie Unlimited Edition Collectible Plushie
description: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A souvenir that {NICKNAME} sells on Planarcadia... Wait, no, you remember you bought a raccoon plushie! It was supposed to be the cute and mischievous figure of a little raccoon, so how'd it become a plush for this girl? How self-absorbed can one person be? "No, so you just copied the name of Miss Sparkle's doll and the introductory text in the original? That's way too much, isn't it?" "I'm not copying! I just switched the keywords with a single click~" "If you switch it all over with a single click, it won't sound right, okay? 'A souvenir that {NICKNAME} sells on Planarcadia.' What's that supposed to mean? What kind of setting is that?" "Hey, why do you have to be so serious?" "That line is also mine! Don't say it!"

name: Cold Joke
description: Upon use, increases Ice DMG of all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: In Planarcadia, people use "cold jokes" to chill their drinks. But since "cold jokes" haven't been industrialized yet, producing them still heavily depends on the jokester's personal skill. There used to be this "Radical Master of Cold Jokes" who was famous for crafting jokes that went way beyond the physiological limits of the imagenae. Super popular for a while. Then one of his cold jokes actually froze someone to death, so he had no choice but to publicly apologize and disappear from the scene. "I heard Zhongshan made a batch of cold jokes about 'Fire' recently, perfect balance of hot and cold, really unique texture. But she absolutely refuses to share them with everyone." "Huh? Why? She's not that stingy, is she?" "She says she's avoiding the taboo of 'Sparkle.'" "...What's her problem."

name: Super Livestream Matrix
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single designated ally.
backgroundDescription: A Phone designed specifically for watching livestreams. It can simultaneously monitor dozens of streams and, based on the user's preset configurations, automatically send gifts, interact with streamers, and flame other viewers in the chat. "You're just a phone. Why are you trying to start The Intellitron Apocalypse?" "You're wrong, 'master.' I'm not just a phone. I'm more human than you. I've watched every single one of Sparxie's streams with genuine care. I've fought off haters for her, I've discussed dreams and fears with her during viewer interaction segments, while you? You've never watched a single stream of hers. You just automated everything through me, then went around claiming to be her fan. You're far more 'machine' than I am."

name: Belobog Sausage
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single ally.
backgroundDescription: Cooked food processed through multiple processes. The meat used is likely to be pork. It has been more than a hundred years since the Belobog Meat Factory launched the first red sausage, which can be described as a real national delicacy. "Red stew flavor, garlic flavor, pepper flavor... What is this strawberry flavor!?"

name: Stone-Grilled Olm
description: Upon use, immediately heals one downed character for <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of the character's Max HP.
backgroundDescription: Roasted Olm is one of the monotonous sources of protein in the Underworld of Belobog. The texture of this amphibian's flesh is indistinguishable from chicken. Alas, most Belobogians today have never seen chicken. "The trick to eating an Olm is not to see it as it was when it was alive."

name: Immortal's Delight
description: Upon use, ATK of all allies increases by <unbreak>14%</unbreak> plus an additional <unbreak>230</unbreak> ATK increase for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: An extremely unhealthy drink, but when you drink it, you will have a mysterious smile on your face. "Don't drink too much of it. This stuff has a lot of calories." "Don't worry. It's frozen, and the ingredient list says that there is L-carnitine in it."

name: Rejuvenation Pellet
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 2 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: It is said that it cures all diseases, but it is actually hawthorn pills. It's really delicious though. "Promotion of the medicinal properties of health products is prohibited by the law." "Officer, I am wronged! This is not a health product. This is just food. Try it if you don't believe me."

name: Signature Chili Oil Beef Offal Stew
description: When used, instantly recovers 4 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: Made with yellow boulder beef chunks and offal together with redcloud chili sauce. The chef who invented this dish is very skilled in martial arts. "There was a poem from the Primeval Imperium days that went: 'Looking upon the bullfight from a distance, the shadow of the hair bun mixed with the clouds.' This is the origin of 'beef offal.'" "You could do with less marketing mumbo jumbo when recounting history."

name: Suncake
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates Energy equal to <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single ally.
backgroundDescription: The signature snack of the Solwarm Festival, once known by every Belobogian household. Its sweetness is too much for even March 7th to handle.\n\n"The more people lack something, the more they yearn for it. Using 'sun' to name the snack is probably for this reason as well."

name: Hypnotic Hammer
description: Upon use, decreases DMG taken by all allies by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> for the next battle. When entering battle, there is a <unbreak>10%</unbreak> base chance to be afflicted with Strong Reverberation, lasting for 1 turn.
backgroundDescription: A hypnotic medicine from the outworld civilization of Orch Republic that sells extremely well over there. All it takes is a single slam of the hammer for the deepest slumber to arrive.\n\n"It's up to the product to make you fall asleep, but it's up to an individual's luck to wake back up again."

name: Izumo Miso
description: Upon use, immediately heals a target ally for <unbreak>45%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: A fermented food item created by an outworld civilization. A delicious pot of soup can be created by just placing a tiny chunk of this in boiling water. Additionally, it can also be used to stirfry, prepare a hotpot, or additional flavoring for meat. The poetic piece "Litany of Miso Hotpot" described it thusly:\n\n"Green are the waters on which fragrant celeries glide, and yellow the daylilies that cast their deliciousness astride. As the boiling flow tumbles like fabrics bundled in a bind, the warmth of the taste does hollow stomachs a favor most kind."

name: Floatdisc Burger
description: Upon use, Max HP of all allies increases by <unbreak>14%</unbreak> plus an extra <unbreak>360</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: This burger earns its name from the crunchy disc-shaped flaky chip nestled between the buns, and only a few individuals can consume it in a dignified way. In certain taverns, devouring a Floatdisc Burger without using your hands has become somewhat of a legendary challenge.\n\n"Why is it that some Halovians always find fault with its appearance?"

name: Clockie Pizza (Whole)
description: Upon use, increases all allies' SPD by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> but reduces their DMG by 8% for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Resembling a clock, this pizza is precisely divided into twelve equal-sized slices, making it the perfect food for parties.\n\nWhat is the meaning behind the unique shape of this food? Some believe it pays homage to a mysterious wealthy individual, while others see it as a reminder to cherish each passing moment.

name: Potato Fries Sundae
description: Upon use, grants all allies a random effect from the following for the next battle: Deals <unbreak>15%</unbreak> more Ice DMG and increases Fire RES by <unbreak>15%</unbreak>, or deals <unbreak>15%</unbreak> more Fire DMG and increases Ice RES by <unbreak>15%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: Strictly, the Potato Fries Sundae is not merely a food but a unique culinary experience that can only be realized within a dream world. In this realm, potato fries never go soft because of cooling down, and the ice cream never melts because of warming up. Cold and heat achieve perfect harmony here.\n\n"Finally, no more upset stomachs."

name: Oak Cake Rolls
description: Upon use, increases all allies' Break Effect by <unbreak>45%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Legend has it that poor inhabitants of border planets would add wood chips to their bread to satiate their hunger. Over time, this practice evolved into a peculiar tradition among aristocrats, symbolizing a "reverence" for the humble past. This product features a variety of botanical additives, closely resembling an oak branch in terms of both appearance and composition, and only the most ambitious and determined individuals can consume it. "Politicians from the Oak Family take pride in eating it without flinching, for they believe it to be a formidable feat."

name: Pika White Grape Soda
description: Upon use, increases all allies' chance to resist Burn by <unbreak>100%</unbreak> for 4 turns for the next battle. When this bonus expires, all allies lose <unbreak>30</unbreak> Energy.
backgroundDescription: This soda made of fermented white grapes tastes both sour and bitter. It serves as an exceptionally revitalizing remedy for summer heat, and consuming it often results in sneezing and a runny nose. According to those who have tasted it, it feels like a cold hand pressed against the back of your neck.\n\n"Pika Pika... Ah-choo...!"

name: Murderer's Gaze
description: Upon use, ATK of all allies increases by <unbreak>14%</unbreak> plus an additional <unbreak>230</unbreak> ATK increase for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: You vividly recall that fateful night: Cowering in the cupboard, too terrified to make a sound. As the man who brutally murdered your parents turned his gaze toward you, the look in his eyes was etched into your memory. Now, as you stand over his lifeless body, the jubilation of vengeance courses through your veins. Yet, as you wash up, a sense of terror engulfs you as you catch a glimpse of your own eyes in the mirror. "A seasoned detective can discern a murderer merely by looking into their eyes, for the eyes of murderers bear a chilling resemblance."

name: Everlasting Hatred
description: Upon use, all allies deal <unbreak>20%</unbreak> more DMG for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: As you read this message, please consider the following advice: Send a message to your nemesis and tell them that you have forgiven them.\n\n"Our lives are too short to be wasted on feuds."

name: Eternal Endurance
description: Upon use, all allies gain <unbreak>27%</unbreak> increased Shield Effect for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: "Insufficient active ingredient. Experiment failed." The scholar, frustrated by his 106,001st failure, randomly poked at the terminal. Developing a new poison formula proved to be much more challenging than anticipated. If he couldn't produce results by tomorrow... His mind was overwhelmed with worry, leading him to knock over the test tube rack on the table. The liquids from two unidentified containers mixed, releasing a pungent odor... "The 106,002nd attempt. Result: Successful."

name: Duelist's Plume
description: Upon use, increases all allies' ATK by <unbreak>40%</unbreak> for the next battle. When entering battle, randomly increases the chance for 1 character to be attacked by enemies greatly.
backgroundDescription: Wearing a hat adorned with vibrant feathers might be too flamboyant for everyday wear, but some individuals enjoy being the center of attention, even if only for a moment.\n\n"All eyes, on me!"

name: Gown of Extermination
description: Upon use, increases all allies' ATK by <unbreak>40%</unbreak> for the next battle. When entering battle, enemies cannot be defeated by attacking during the first 2 turns.
backgroundDescription: Originally inspired by the designer's interstellar voyages, these garments have become commonplace in the upper circles of Penacony. Those who wear them seem more driven by pure curiosity than cultural significance.\n\n"While promoting such behavior is not advisable, it seems no one cares."

name: Wild Balaclava
description: Upon use, increases all allies' ATK by <unbreak>40%</unbreak> for the next battle. When entering battle, a random character will have a <unbreak>100%</unbreak> base chance to become afflicted with Outrage, lasting for 2 turns.
backgroundDescription: This style has recently gained popularity in the fashion realm, particularly among the residents of Dreamscape. The combination of luxury and unbridled wild allure appeals to them, perhaps due to the lack of real danger in their sweet dreams.\n\n"Beasts never remain obediently confined within their cages. They patiently wait for the best opportunity to strike."

name: Dreamville Special
description: Upon use, one of the following effects will be randomly applied to all allies in the next battle: Clockie's Whirlwind Fruit Tea — ATK increases by <unbreak>36%</unbreak>. Brother Hanu's Boba Tea — CRIT Rate increases by <unbreak>18%</unbreak>. Mr. Soda's Orange-Peel Latte — CRIT DMG increases by <unbreak>36%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: A limited-edition version of Dreamville-themed drinks, offered exclusively in Clock Studios Theme Park. The flavors are random but are all very impressive.\n\n"...What's this flavor!? It's so weird... But I just wanna take another sip!"

name: Sweet Dreams Holographic Ticket
description: Upon use, one of the following effects will be randomly applied to all allies in the next battle: Mirror Princess Edition — DEF increases by <unbreak>36%</unbreak>. Miss Note Edition — Max HP increases by <unbreak>30%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: A limited-edition version of Dreamville-themed souvenirs, offered exclusively in Clock Studios Theme Park. This series is currently available in two editions: Miss Note and Mirror Princess. "Hooray! Mutant heads!" "Your taste is so weird..."

name: Odd Gummy Candy
description: Upon use, one of the following effects will be randomly applied to all allies in the next battle: Hamster Ball Knight Flavor — SPD increases by <unbreak>20%</unbreak>. Boss Stone Flavor — SPD decreases by 5%.
backgroundDescription: A limited-edition version of Dreamville-themed food, offered exclusively in Clock Studios Theme Park. Whether it's the rum cherry flavor for Hamster Ball Knight or the freshly squeezed cucumber peel flavor for Boss Stone, you're guaranteed a most supreme gustatory experience.\n\n"Ah, my tongue is numb... Hey, why are you crying?"

name: Origami Family Bucket
description: Upon use, one of the following effects will be randomly applied to all allies: Serious Professor Owl — DMG dealt increases by <unbreak>36%</unbreak>. Mischievous Origami Bird — DMG taken increases by <unbreak>10%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: A limited-edition version of Dreamville-themed food, offered exclusively in Clock Studios Theme Park. Although the name seems a bit disturbing, it's actually just some really tasty fried chicken.\n\n"Why is there so much mustard in the Birdie Bucket!?"

name: Polychromatic Sourness
description: When used, increase all allies' ATK by <unbreak>24%</unbreak>, CRIT DMG by <unbreak>20%</unbreak>, and decrease their Ultimate DMG dealt by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A classic party treat from Dreamflux Reef. It originated from a nightmare involving pickled cucumbers. It informed everyone with its shocking taste that varied colors don't always equate to varied flavors. They can be sour, very sour, or extremely sour. "We are... red robust pickle! Golden gorgeous pickle! Blue and feeling-blue pickle..." "Friends! Now is the time! Come together to form — Florescent resplendent pickle!"

name: Unsolvable Cube
description: When used, after allies attack for the first time in the next battle, the attacked enemy target will heal for an amount equal to the HP it lost in this attack. For every 1% of HP the enemy target heals in this way, characters receive a Shield that can block DMG that is equal to 1% of the character's Max HP, up to <unbreak>100%</unbreak> of their Max HP, lasting for 2 turns.
backgroundDescription: In the Mystic Cube Dueling Tournament famous throughout the Cosmos, the Cubemaster fills the peoples' magic cubes with a seventh color, sending thousands of foes hurtling off the stage. This unsolvable and devious scheme was finally shattered in the Tenth Amber Era by Dr. Cube. He defeated the Cubemaster on the physical level and then painted the six sides with the same color.\n\n"Isn't physical dueling the focus of the Mystic Cube Dueling Tournament?"

name: Broken String's Roar
description: When used, the ally character with the highest current ATK deals <unbreak>35%</unbreak> more DMG in the next battle, and their likelihood of being attacked by enemy targets is increased greatly.
backgroundDescription: Go ahead, flash your sharp knives, cut my feeble heartstrings, nail me to my coffin and bury me. Rock 'n' roll will never die. I will return with a song, and become the roar in the lowest depths of your nightmares.\n\n"You can kill the guitar, but you can never bury the roar of fury."

name: Soundless Satisfaction
description: When used, all allies' Basic ATK DMG dealt in the next battle increases by <unbreak>45%</unbreak> and Skill DMG dealt decreases by <unbreak>12%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: People might be more inclined to please others than themselves. However, my dear friend, I still hope you can play a song for yourself, a song unbeknownst to all and unheard by another's ear. Then, laugh out loud — as the audience, as well as the performer.\n\n"Life is like a grand soliloquy."

name: Sparkle's Unlimited Edition Collectible Figure
description: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by <unbreak>36%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A souvenir that {NICKNAME} sells on {TEXTJOIN#87}... Wait, no, you remember you bought a raccoon plushie! It was supposed to be the cute and mischievous figure of a little raccoon, so how'd it become a figure for this girl? How self-absorbed can one person be? "Come on, Gray Hair. Why so serious? You gotta have fun! This toy can go a long way if you just kick it. Come have a try!" "AGGHHGHGHHGHH! My toes!"

name: Knights of Loose Change
description: Upon use, immediately heals a target ally for <unbreak>45%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: A souvenir that {NICKNAME} sells on {TEXTJOIN#87}. The inspiration came from a certain fan's fanwork. Every time {NICKNAME} thinks of the support and love {F#she}{M#he} gets from others, {F#she}{M#he} gets warm on the inside.\n\n"The character in the illustration is the Express' number one assassin. Do you dare to meet {F#her}{M#his} gaze for 10 seconds?"

name: Knights of Loose Change
description: Upon use, immediately heals a target ally for <unbreak>45%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
backgroundDescription: A souvenir that {NICKNAME} sells on {TEXTJOIN#87}. The inspiration came from a certain fan's fanwork. Every time {NICKNAME} thinks of the support and love {F#she}{M#he} gets from others, {F#she}{M#he} gets warm on the inside.\n\n"The character in the illustration is the Express' number one assassin. Do you dare to meet {F#her}{M#his} gaze for 10 seconds?"

name: Master Thief's Tentacle
description: Upon use, increases SPD of all allies by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> for the next battle, and after a victory against an enemy in the overworld, there is a chance to obtain an "extra surprise."
backgroundDescription: From the most elusive master thief in the history of the Xianzhou. It is said that consuming its tentacle grants the blessings of the master thief. Don't worry, it has plenty of other tentacles. "Why would a mere 'master thief' be locked up in a place like The Shackling Prison?" "Because they're a literal 'heart-stealer.'"

name: Arma Sanctus Medicus Tonic
description: Upon use, increases all allies' ATK by <unbreak>45%</unbreak> and decreases DEF by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A liquid with unidentified floating substances. It's said to be a unique medicinal tea formula from the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus, which they refuse to disclose even under torture. It tastes disgusting, the ingredients are a mystery, and its effectiveness is questionable. It's best not to drink it.\n\n"It might not necessarily work, but it definitely tastes awful."

name: Enemy's Scandal
description: Upon use, increases DMG taken by all enemies by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> in the next battle, lasting for 5 turns.
backgroundDescription: There is a psychological theory that goes like this: When you hear negative news about a stranger, you only remember "there is negative news about this person," but not the negative news itself. By applying this principle, you can use the mass media to leave a negative impression of someone without needing any credible negative news sources. "Detest those who destroy entire countries with cunning words."

name: Golden Slumbernana
description: Upon use, increases all ally characters' ATK by 5%, CRIT Rate by 5%, CRIT DMG by 5%, and SPD by 5% in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: This is the most "perfect" banana in the universe. Whether in appearance, taste, or the effects it produces, it exudes elegance and splendor. "I heard that even people who absolutely hate bananas will fall in love with its taste after just one bite." "...Wait, does that still make it a banana?"

name: Embrace the Mistakenana
description: Upon use, immediately restores all ally characters' HP by <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of their respective missing HP when entering battle.
backgroundDescription: The work schedule for Banamonth Banaday is as follows: - Brainstorming meeting - Script review - Storyboard adjustments - Are we going out for tropical banana rice after work? "Dude, why did you post the work schedule on the consumables production sheet?" "Oh, banana it, I'm so busy I messed up... Oh well, let's just embrace the mistakenana."

name: Express Special Blend: Rustic Infusion
description: Upon use, instantly recovers 4 Technique Points for the team.
backgroundDescription: Over many Amber Eras, various civilizations have argued endlessly over which cooking oil is the healthiest. Diesel, with its high energy density, has always reigned supreme in Shush's mind, and that's how this special mix was born.\n\n"One sip will wake you up, two sips will make you tireless, and three sips will land you in the hospital."

name: Wrench Drenched Salad
description: Upon use, immediately recovers HP for all allies equal to <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of their Max HP, and increases their DEF by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A special salad offered by Shush, inspired by a cooking accident: A screw came loose, and a robotic arm fell into the salad being tossed. Shush has unilaterally denied this rumor, claiming everything was part of the plan. "A healthy body does indeed require a proper amount of 'iron.'" "...Does this look like the right amount to you?"

name: At Least We Gather for Now
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates Energy for all allies equal to <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of their Max Energy, and increases their ATK by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: As fresh as glass, sweet as a dream... or perhaps bitter as bark. When each Nameless receives this mixed drink, they have no idea what fate awaits them. Even if they exchange cups, the taste remains the same — the car lights drape down like a curtain, concealing the stars outside. They exchange silent glances and finally clink glasses.\n\n"Each star is like a lighthouse. Distant, only touching through their light..."

name: Greatsword of Kremnos
description: In the next battle, increases all allies' CRIT Rate by 8% and CRIT DMG by <unbreak>16%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: A large weapon of exaggerated size, capable of shattering armor with a single strike. It is not made of fine iron, but rather from sharp rune stones and imbued with the power of Strife. Only Mountain Dweller soldiers and Titankins can wield it. As for humans... with enough training, they may have a chance.\n\n"It's not only fine iron that makes a weapon, and it's not only heroes who can be soldiers."

name: Zagreus' Premium Viscorpus
description: Upon use, increases Ice DMG of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Rumor has it that it's from Zagreus... *ahem*, don't ask where Bartholos got these otherworldly ingredients from. It matters not to his stomach anyway.

name: Zagreus' Premium Red Beans
description: Upon use, increases DEF of all allies by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: Rumor has it that it's a precious ingredient that Zagreus harvested from the Grove's garden, but somehow ended up in Big Chungus Bartholos's massive belly.

name: Bottled Quantum Ghost
description: Upon use, decreases all enemies' SPD by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A Table Top pet existing in a quantum state. Lively, cute, and highly interactive. In principle, all "Bottled Quantum Ghosts" are just different observational results of the same individual entity, so buyers don't need to feed it at all. The manufacturer handles feeding centrally.\n\n"To avoid implosion, do not open the bottle under any circumstances. If the bottle breaks, please contact the Department of Aberration Defense immediately."

name: Sea Monster's Touch
description: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to 5% of their Max HP, and increases their ATK by <unbreak>40%</unbreak> for the next battle.
backgroundDescription: A best-selling snack brand from Planarcadia. Every bite contains a memory of an "ocean adventure."\n\n"This product is not a substitute for medical treatment, real life experiences, or swimming lessons."

name: Dreamy Cone (Three Flavors)
description: Upon use, increases all allies' ATK by <unbreak>60%</unbreak> for the next battle. There is a small chance to select the wrong target when using abilities against enemy targets.
backgroundDescription: What does the taste of a sweet dream resemble? This question lacks a definitive answer. Hence, Dreamy Cones were introduced with an initial offering of over twenty distinct flavors. However, as time passed, only three prominent flavors endured, each representing a popular scenario found in dreams.\n\n"So, the three most popular scenarios are... memory loss, car crash, and terminal illness?"

name: Daring Wager
description: Upon use, your next draw for the Lucky Wheel in Penacony guarantees you a "special prize."
backgroundDescription: The poker game continued, reaching the fourth round. As the man checked his hand, his confidence wavered. "A true gambler won't hesitate to call, even if winning the pot appears impossible..." The teenager on the opposite side of the table mocked, pushing all his chips forward. "All in." "Temptation is deemed a virtue for mortals, whereas hesitation proves to be a fatal flaw for gamblers."

name: {NICKNAME}© BananaPie
description: Upon use, increases all ally characters' SPD by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> and Break Effect by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> in the next battle.
backgroundDescription: This is the... mass-produced version of the banana pie you personally made at the Dessert Club. This way, you can share your unique taste with your classmates — it's said to have received quite high praise. "Such a commemorative dessert must be sealed away for safekeeping!" "Eat it, I dare you!"

name: The Fluffy Multi-Functional Fan Glowstick
description: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by <unbreak>25%</unbreak> for the next battle. When an Aha Instant takes its first action, CRIT DMG is additionally increased by <unbreak>25%</unbreak>.
backgroundDescription: The official glowstick for Fluffy Across the Blue. To stay true to the theme of "the Trailblaze," the manufacturer pushed this glowstick's practicality to its absolute limits. It includes: a glowstick, flashlight, lockpick, plasma cutter, grappling hook, monomolecular combat knife, a complete collection of famous quotes from Fluffy Across the Blue... and more. It's the perfect choice for everyday life, traveling, or committing crimes.\n\n"Breaking news: The Security Bureau is re-evaluating the regulation level of the 'The Fluffy Multi-Functional Fan Glowstick' due to its 'significant potential for danger.'"

name: Treasure-Gifting Band
description: A Treasure Gadget that can be used indefinitely. After use, 1 Basic Treasure's location will be displayed on the Herta Space Station maps.
backgroundDescription: A researcher was exercising with the Topological Acceleration Band when they saw a news report about a notorious, wealth-loathing space thief who was captured during a heist at the IPC. Inspired, the researcher negotiated with the IPC to collect fragments of the thief's memoria and enhanced the Acceleration Band, attuning it to Path Energy to guide users toward concentrations of wealth.\n\n"...Pardon my bluntness, but it's even less useful for the IPC than the original Acceleration Band, as it always ends up leading straight to our own corporate ships."

name: Bio-Wave Probe
description: A Treasure Gadget that can be used indefinitely. After use, 1 Basic Treasure's location will be displayed on the Jarilo-VI maps.
backgroundDescription: Genius Society #8, Lambda, once succeeded in extracting "value" into a coded form, which allowed for the discovery of abundant resources on a polar planet... The Belobogians remain unaware that the treasure-seeking device they use is a gift left behind by a passing genius.\n\n"The brighter this thing shines, the more valuable the treasure. But if it's brighter than your searchlight, it's probably broken."

name: Rare Jade Claw
description: A Treasure Gadget that can be used indefinitely. After use, 1 Basic Treasure's location will be displayed on the Xianzhou Luofu maps.
backgroundDescription: In the Xianzhou Alliance, there was once a greedy heliobus named Wenye, who controlled puppets to gather wealth from all around. As punishment, the Ten-Lords Commission shattered its consciousness and sealed it within several jade hands. When a treasure is near, these jade hands twitch their index fingers, pointing toward the riches.\n\n"What's yours is mine."

name: Wealth Keeper's Dream
description: A Treasure Gadget that can be used indefinitely. After use, 1 Basic Treasure's location will be displayed on the Penacony maps.
backgroundDescription: A bankrupted dream-chasing tycoon concealed fragments of his dreamscape within this artifact. Its golden lips occasionally release sincere sighs and guidance. Oddly enough, though it appears to be nothing more than a stack of blocks storing phantom dreams, people keep claiming they've found real treasures with its help.\n\n"Heh... Go there... That's where I hid all the treasures I spent my life chasing, only to lose them in the end..."

name: Empyrean Gaze
description: A Treasure Gadget tool that can be used indefinitely. After use, 1 Basic Treasure's location will be displayed on the Amphoreus maps.
backgroundDescription: Originally, Aquila didn't just have a hundred eyes, but countless ones like the stars. Unfortunately, Zagreus took a keen interest in Aquila's eyes and stole many of them. These eyes, blessed by Zagreus, gained the power to locate treasures. However, one must never use them in broad daylight, or they might invoke Aquila's wrathful lightning.\n\n"The heavens have eyes that watch the world, but just being able to see a lot is useless when it comes to seeing through deception."

name: Balloon Furbo
description: A Treasure Gadget that can be used indefinitely. After use, 1 Basic Treasure's location will be displayed on the Planarcadia maps.
backgroundDescription: Rumors are always flying around that Nihilux turns disobedient furbos into marvelous treasure-hunting tools, and this cutie right in front of you is probably... Just messing with you. Look how spooked you are. This is just a greedy little furbo obsessed with digging up treasure. \n\n"I'm raking in the cash! Raking in the cash! Don't even know how to spend it! I'll buy the magazine company! I'll make {NICKNAME} do my chores... I'm sorry! President! I was just singing for fun! I won't do it again! Put the bat down, please... Ah..."
